companies.name: Callab AI
companies.originalOneLiner: Human-centered AI for contact centers.
companies.originalDescription: Callab AI is a human-centered customer engagement platform for enterprise contact centers. It lets teams deploy AI agents that handle inbound and outbound conversations across voice, chat, and messaging, while human agents and supervisors stay in control of every interaction. The platform has two sides. The AI side lets teams build, deploy, and evaluate voice and text agents using a shared knowledge base, embedded evaluations, post-call analysis, data extraction, batch calling, and call transfer. The human side provides a dialer and a live supervision dashboard, from which a person can watch any AI conversation in real time, step in, and hand it back without the customer repeating a word. Every agent retains memory across channels, so a customer who called yesterday and writes today is recognized and picked up where they left off. The system learns from each human intervention and improves in the direction the team chooses. Callab AI runs on its own carrier-grade telephony stack and connects natively to Cisco, Mitel, Avaya, SIP trunks, and on-premises PBX systems. Enterprises can adopt it without migrating to the cloud first. The platform maintains SOC 2 controls and serves customers in financial services, healthcare, hospitality, and retail. Key features: - AI voice and text agents: Agents handle inbound and outbound conversations across phone, chat, and messaging from a single configuration. - Live human supervision: Supervisors watch any AI conversation in real time and take over without the customer repeating a word. - Persistent memory: Every customer's full context is retained across channels and over time. - AI builder: Teams design, test, and deploy agents without engineering support. - Embedded evaluations: Every conversation is scored continuously, so performance is measured rather than assumed. - Self-improving agents: Agents learn from human interventions and get better with every conversation. - Post-call analysis and data extraction: Every conversation becomes structured, searchable records. - Batch calling and call transfer: Outbound campaigns run at scale, and conversations move to a human with full context attached. - Native telephony integration: The platform connects directly to Cisco, Mitel, Avaya, SIP trunks, and on-premises PBX without cloud migration. - SOC 2 controls: Security and compliance support deployments in regulated industries. Callab AI delivers every agent production-ready. Our team studies the customer's workflows, internal processes, and existing systems, then builds, tests, and implements the agent on that foundation, so it performs to the organization's own standard from the first live conversation.
companies.story: 这是做企业客服中心智能体的公司。假如你是一家大型企业的客服运营负责人，某天上午发现电话和在线聊天同时爆单，人手不够，客户还在反复描述同一个问题。Callab AI 让团队部署能接听和拨出电话、处理聊天与消息的智能体，同时提供拨号器和实时监督面板，你可以随时旁听任何一通人工智能对话，必要时介入，再把对话交还给智能体，客户不用重复说明。智能体跨渠道保留记忆，昨天打过电话、今天发消息的客户会被认出来接着处理，系统还会从每次人工介入中学习。它来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队七人，场景本身值得看：客服是人工智能落地最直接、也最考验人机协作的地方。

companies.name: Cumulus Labs
companies.originalOneLiner: The Fastest Multimodal Inference OS
companies.originalDescription: Cumulus Labs lets engineering teams ship AI in production without needing a dedicated ML platform team. Right now, companies building AI products are forced to stitch together separate vendors for routing, observability, evaluation, fine-tuning, and inference. This fragmented approach is brittle, expensive, and is a common reason enterprises fail with AI. We replace that entire stack with a single unified platform. Developers can keep their existing code while instantly upgrading to a unified platform that handles routing, semantic caching, continuous shadow evaluation, simulated data, and one-click fine-tuning. Behind the platform is Ion, our proprietary inference engine running on a custom NVIDIA Grace GPU fleet. Ion uses in-house custom GPU kernels to deliver 30 to 50 percent more throughput than standard vLLM or SGLang, giving our customers SOTA inference economics.
companies.story: 这家公司切的是人工智能推理基础设施。想象你是一个工程负责人，产品要上线，却得把路由、监控、评测、微调和推理分别接给不同供应商，任何一环出问题都要跨团队排查，既脆弱又费钱。Cumulus Labs 把这些环节收进一个统一平台，开发者保留原有代码就能升级，平台负责路由、语义缓存、持续影子评测、模拟数据和一键微调。底层是自研推理引擎 Ion，跑在定制的英伟达 Grace 显卡集群上，用自家显卡内核实现比常见方案高百分之三十到五十的吞吐。它来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，团队两人，正在招聘。对没有专门机器学习平台团队的公司来说，这种把碎片化工具链合一的思路值得关注。

companies.name: Cotool
companies.originalOneLiner: Security operations optimized for agents.
companies.originalDescription: Cotool builds AI agents and the infrastructure around them to help security teams detect threats, investigate alerts, hunt for attacks, and respond. Our agents work across a team's security tools and data. They investigate alerts, write and tune Python detections, and turn threat intelligence into hunts and new coverage. Teams can customize agents around their workflows, inspect the evidence, edit detection logic, and bring humans in when judgment or approval matters. Underneath the agents, Cotool provides log storage and search built for their workloads, with access to data where it already lives. The goal is to give security teams more capacity to defend their companies as their environments and workloads grow. Teams at Ramp, EliseAI, ClickHouse, Legora, and many more use Cotool.
companies.story: 这是为安全运营团队打造智能体和配套基础设施的公司。一个安全分析师每天上班，面对的是成百上千条告警：要逐条判断真假、翻日志、写检测规则，真正追查攻击的时间反而被挤掉。Cotool 的智能体在团队已有的安全工具和数据之间工作，调查告警、编写和调整 Python 检测逻辑、把威胁情报变成主动狩猎和新覆盖范围。团队可以按自己的流程定制智能体，查看证据，修改检测逻辑，在需要判断或审批时把人拉进来。底层还提供为这类负载设计的日志存储和搜索。它来自 YC 春季 2025 批次，团队八人，正在招聘，Ramp、EliseAI、ClickHouse、Legora 等团队在使用，说明它已经在真实安全场景里跑起来。

companies.name: Soria
companies.originalOneLiner: AI Financial Research Terminal built for Healthcare (and beyond)
companies.originalDescription: Soria is an AI-native Financial Terminal for investors who specialize in a particular sector, starting with healthcare. Our agents convert hundreds of the most important public and private sources into an always-on financial model, reviewed by domain experts and delivered to hedge funds, banks, and asset managers through a terminal UI, MCP, API, warehouse sync, and research feed. Unlike our competitors, we own the data layer and expand bottom-up, one sector at a time - additionally our agents proactively do research on behalf of our clients without them lifting a finger or sharing any data.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是面向特定行业投资者的金融研究终端，先从医疗健康起步。如果你是一名覆盖医疗板块的对冲基金分析师，每天要在大量公开和私有信息源之间来回翻找，还要维护财务模型，时间总是不够。Soria 的智能体把数百个重要信息源转成持续更新的财务模型，由领域专家审阅，再通过终端界面、接口、数据仓库同步和研究信息流交付给对冲基金、银行和资产管理机构。它自己掌握数据层，按行业自下而上逐个扩展，智能体还会主动替客户做研究，客户不必上传自己的数据。它来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队三人，正在招聘。垂直行业金融数据这条路的难点在于数据质量和专家审阅，这正是它值得看的地方。

companies.name: Moonshot
companies.originalOneLiner: agents for the rest of us
companies.originalDescription: We want to bring AI agents to a billion people. To do this, we believe it needs to be 1. proactive and 2. personal. A billion people already carry the right device, but none of them have the right connector. Moonshot is personal intelligence that lives on your iPhone and listens to you 24/7. It continuously builds up a greater understanding of you through constantly listening and building context. It just pays deep attention, the way a good friend does. Through this, Moonshot monitors your conscious and subconscious life, figuring out what you need before you know, reminding you about open loops, identifying life and emotional trends before you recognize it, and covering a lot more of what we gloss over in daily life. For fifty years, software has waited to be asked. We think tools are just good enough to flip this, and the next great software will provide value before asking for something first. We're doing it through Moonshot. Our thesis is simple: you're only living half your life. The half that you actively remember. The other half just evaporates into your subconscious: what you said, felt, promised, and forgot. It's the more interesting half, and until now nothing could catch it, making it not actionable. Moonshot catches your subconscious half and understands you well enough to take actions on your behalf. Take life personally. The iOS app is designed around ambient listening and clear user control. Short microphone chunks are sent securely to Moonshot's private transcription service and deleted when transcription finishes. Text and selected context can be sent through Moonshot's server to a model when the app needs to understand a moment. Nothing leaves without your yes. The privacy policy explains every data path, stored copy, permission, and deletion control in detail. Moonshot is in early access. Join the waitlist to hear when access opens, read more about the team and product on the About page, or use the Contact page for a direct written response from the Moonshot team. Let's make it a Moonshot.
companies.story: 这是把个人智能体放进手机随身场景的消费产品。想象你是一个每天会议很多、待办事项散落在各处的咨询顾问，很多承诺和念头说完就忘，等想起来时已经错过时机。Moonshot 装在苹果手机上，持续聆听并积累对你的理解，像一位很用心的朋友那样关注你：提醒未闭环的事情，发现你自己还没察觉的生活和情绪趋势，在你开口之前就提供价值。它不只是一个手机应用，而是把持续感知和理解能力放进随身设备里，让软件从等待被询问变成主动关心。它来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队三人。这个方向值得看的地方在于，它押注的是智能体从被动工具转向主动陪伴的形态变化。

companies.name: Prana
companies.originalOneLiner: An AI primary care doctor in your pocket
companies.originalDescription: Prana replaces the reactive, 15-minute annual physical with continuous, proactive care. We connect to your medical records and wearables to watch for "clinical drift," catching subtle declines in health that human doctors miss between visits. Most AI health apps are just chatbots. Prana is a full-stack medical provider. Our AI acts as a always-on physician that watches your data, explains your labs, and manages your prescriptions. Safety & Scale: We automate 90% of the "grunt work" (history taking, logistics, triage) so our human doctors can focus purely on high-leverage decisions. This allows us to offer 24/7 physician care for a fraction of the cost of traditional care. The Team: - Meer Patel (CEO): JHU BME. Deferred Brown Medical School to build Prana because code scales better than appointments. - Vishvam Rawal (CTO): Ex-Quant. Building high-frequency data infrastructure for health signals. - Sanjit Menon (CHO): Graduating MD Candidate. Deep clinical expertise to ensure our models practice good medicine. Traction: Live in beta with early users.
companies.story: 这是做人工智能初级医疗服务的公司。假如你是一位工作繁忙、每年只做一次十五分钟体检的上班族，两次就诊之间的细微健康下滑往往没人发现。Prana 连接你的医疗记录和可穿戴设备，持续观察所谓临床漂移，捕捉人类医生在就诊间隔里容易漏掉的缓慢变化。它不只是聊天机器人，而是完整的医疗服务提供方：人工智能医生全天候盯数据、解释化验结果、管理处方，同时自动化病史采集、后勤和分诊等大量基础工作，让人工医生专注高价值决策，从而以远低于传统护理的成本提供全天候医生服务。它来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，团队四人。把可穿戴数据和真实医疗服务结合，是它区别于普通健康应用的地方。

companies.name: BioStack Platforms
companies.originalOneLiner: Real world training envs for healthcare AI models
companies.originalDescription: BioStack is building the data engine for healthcare and drug discovery AI. The bottleneck is not models. It is access to high-quality biological data. Clinical and experimental data is fragmented, unstructured, and locked inside hospitals, labs, and CROs, while generating new data is slow and expensive. BioStack fixes this with proprietary clinical and preclinical data pipelines that turn real biomedical workflows into ML-ready training environments. We structure longitudinal multimodal data across imaging, EHR, and experimental assays, then package it for post-training and reinforcement learning so models can learn how research and care actually happen. Instead of static datasets, BioStack gives AI labs workflow-aligned data and environments that improve reasoning, decision-making, and real-world performance in biology and medicine.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是医疗健康和药物发现人工智能模型的数据引擎。一个研究实验室的机器学习负责人常常发现，卡住进度的不是模型结构，而是拿不到高质量生物数据：临床和实验数据散在医院、实验室和合同研究组织里，格式混乱，重新生成又慢又贵。BioStack 用自有的临床和临床前数据管线，把真实生物医学工作流转成可供训练的环境，将影像、电子病历和实验检测等纵向多模态数据结构化，再打包用于后训练和强化学习，让模型学习研究和诊疗实际如何发生。它提供的是与工作流对齐的数据和环境，而不是静态数据集。它来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队十三人，正在招聘。数据瓶颈是行业公认的痛点，这个切入点值得看。

companies.name: GRU Space
companies.originalOneLiner: Moon Hotel -> The Intergalactic Construction Company of Earth
companies.originalDescription: GRU Space is building permanent lunar infrastructure to make humanity interplanetary within our lifetime, starting with the first hotel on the Moon. In just 6 weeks, we built the world's first Moon factory: patent-pending hardware that turns lunar regolith into bricks and inflates modular pressurized habitats designed to withstand lunar temperature and pressure extremes. Our first mission lands on the Moon in 2027 to demonstrate in-situ brick manufacturing and habitat deployment. A second mission lays the hotel's foundation inside a lunar cave, and a third opens the first lunar hotel, targeted for 2032. We don’t stop at Moon hotels. GRU’s long-term plan: 1. Build the first hotel on the Moon. GRU solves off‑world surface habitation. 2. Become the Moon Base Company of America: build roads, mass drivers, warehouses, and physical infrastructure. 3. Repeat on Mars and build the first cities there. 4. Own property on the Moon and Mars as these economies grow. 5. Reinvest profits into resource utilization systems on the Moon, Mars, asteroids, and beyond—reaching our final form: Galactic Resource Utilization. GRU Space is backed by investors in SpaceX and Anduril, is part of Nvidia's Inception program, and our launch generated 1B+ views across 60+ countries, earning invitations to the White House, Senate, and Pentagon.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是月球上的永久基础设施，起点是月球酒店。想象你是一名负责地外栖息地建设的工程师，要在没有建材供应链的月球表面造出能承受极端温度和压力的结构，每运一公斤物资上去都极其昂贵。GRU Space 用六周时间造出他们所说的世界首个月球工厂：正在申请专利的硬件把月壤变成砖块，并充气展开模块化加压栖息舱。首个任务计划 2027 年登月，演示原位制砖和栖息舱部署，第二个任务在月球洞穴内铺设酒店地基，第三个任务目标 2032 年开出首个月球酒店。长期看它想成为月球基地公司，再把这套能力复制到火星。它来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，团队五人，正在招聘。把制造能力放进月球现场，而不是只做软件规划，是这个项目最值得看的地方。

companies.name: Archgen Labs
companies.originalOneLiner: AI-powered EDA tools for faster, cooler 3D chips
companies.originalDescription: Archgen Labs builds AI-powered chip design tools for the next generation of 3D semiconductors. Stacking compute vertically shortens connections and reduces the energy and delay of moving data. But it also makes heat harder to remove. Our tools help engineers optimize placement, timing, and temperature together so they can build faster, more power-efficient 3D chips. Our GPU-accelerated placement engine ranked first in the Hudson River Trading macro-placement challenge. LayerTherm, our thermal analysis tool, predicts chip temperatures roughly 5,000× faster than conventional simulation in our benchmarks, helping engineers explore more designs and identify hotspots earlier. Newton, our AI chip design engineer, automates work across placement, routing, design-rule fixes, and timing closure. We’re working with GlobalFoundries on 3D chip development, targeting our first tapeout in 2027.
companies.story: 这是做人工智能芯片设计工具的公司，瞄准下一代三维半导体。如果你是一名芯片设计工程师，把计算单元垂直堆叠能缩短连线、降低数据搬运的能耗和延迟，但散热会变得更难，布局、时序和温度往往要分开反复试。Archgen Labs 的工具让工程师把这三者放在一起优化。它的显卡加速布局引擎在 Hudson River Trading 的宏观布局挑战赛中排名第一，热分析工具 LayerTherm 在自家基准里预测芯片温度比传统仿真快约五千倍，人工智能芯片设计工程师 Newton 则自动处理布局、布线、设计规则修复和时序收敛。它来自 YC 秋季 2026 批次，团队两人，正与 GlobalFoundries 合作开发三维芯片，目标 2027 年首次流片。

companies.name: Neuromorphic
companies.originalOneLiner: Building robots to automate wetlabs
companies.originalDescription: We are building robots that can work autonomously in existing wet labs. Unlike traditional lab automation, which requires dedicated equipment and fixed workflows, our robot moves between workstations, manipulates existing scientific equipment, transports lab materials, and executes experiments using the same lab infrastructure as a human technician. We make the robots easy to manage through natural interfaces like Slack, email, and phone. Our goal is to make deploying robots in wet labs as easy as onboarding a new employee, and to accelerate scientific research!
companies.story: 这是做湿实验室自动化机器人的公司。如果你是一个实验室的技术员，每天要在不同工作站之间搬样品、操作现有仪器、重复执行同一套实验流程，时间都耗在走动和等待上。Neuromorphic 的机器人能在现有湿实验室里自主工作，在工位之间移动，操作已有的科学设备，运送实验材料，用和人类技术员相同的实验室基础设施执行实验。团队可以通过 Slack、邮件和电话这类自然界面管理机器人，目标是把机器人部署进湿实验室做得像给新员工办入职一样简单。它来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队三人，正在招聘，切入的是传统实验室自动化需要专用设备和固定流程之外的那部分空间。

readings.title: The Gemini app is now available on lower-memory Android devices.
readings.story: 如果你用过手机上的 人工智能 助手，大概会有一个直觉：功能越强，对设备的要求越高，于是很多人的旧手机就被悄悄排除在外。这种落差在硬件更新没那么快的市场里尤其明显，用户看着新功能发布，却发现自己用不上。这篇值得读的地方，是它把注意力放在“谁能用上”这个问题上，而不是又加了什么能力。读的时候可以留意作者怎么描述设备门槛的变化，以及这个变化会怎样影响普通用户的选择：是换设备，还是继续等。

readings.title: ElevenLabs Down
readings.story: 做产品的团队大概都经历过这样的时刻：某个外部服务突然不可用，自己的功能跟着一起停摆，客服和工程师同时被问同一个问题。技术社区里出现“某服务挂了”的讨论，往往就是这种时刻的公共版本。这条值得看，是因为它让人看到依赖别人的基础设施意味着什么，也让人看到故障发生时大家第一反应去查什么、说什么。读的时候不妨顺着讨论看：人们是在确认影响范围，还是在猜原因，谁的说法更接近事实。

readings.title: Sony’s updated turntable is an easy entry into the world of vinyl
readings.story: 很多人家里可能还留着几张旧唱片，却因为唱机太麻烦、太贵或者太讲究而一直没打开。黑胶这几年重新流行，厂商面对的就是这样一群人：有兴趣，但不想一上来就研究一堆参数。这篇值得读，是因为它谈的是一款产品怎么降低入门的门槛，而不是追求发烧友的极致。读的时候可以看作者怎么判断“容易上手”这件事，哪些设计被当作关键，哪些妥协被接受，以及这种取舍对第一次接触的人意味着什么。

companies.name: Socratix AI
companies.originalOneLiner: AI coworkers for fraud and compliance teams.
companies.originalDescription: Socratix builds AI coworkers for fraud and compliance teams so that humans don't have to spend their days drowning in alerts and spreadsheets. Today, fraud and risk teams at fintechs and banks are overwhelmed. Analysts jump between tools, manually stitch together context, and make judgment calls under pressure, often for hundreds of alerts a week. Too much of their work is slow, repetitive, and error-prone. We're here to change that. Socratix gives fraud and risk teams AI coworkers that investigate alerts in real time, replacing manual reviews with fast, explainable decisions. Socratix agents plug into existing workflows and reason across signals just like human analysts to help teams reduce fraud losses, minimize false positives, and scale operations without scaling headcount. We've seen this problem firsthand. At DoorDash, Riya helped save $30M+ a year by building smarter fraud detection and investigation tooling, and at Unit21, she built products for analysts that made them 3X faster. We're able to build and sell enterprise-grade software. At Cruise, Satya built scalable AI systems powering petabyte-scale data, and at LinkedIn, he built enterprise products from 0 to 1 generating $50M+ in incremental revenue. Now, the two of us are teaming up to eliminate the manual toil in fraud and compliance. We're obsessed with fraud, LLMs, real-world automation, and the messy edge cases traditional ML has trouble handling. We believe that every fraud analyst should have an AI coworker - and the future of fraud will involve combining human-level reasoning with machine-speed execution.
companies.story: 这是做金融风控与合规智能体的公司。假如你是一名金融科技公司的风控分析师，每周要面对几百条欺诈警报，在不同工具之间来回切换，手动拼凑上下文，再顶着压力做出判断。Socratix 想做的就是给你配一个能实时调查警报的智能体同事，它接入现有工作流程，像人类分析师一样跨信号推理，把大量人工复核换成快速且可解释的决策，帮团队减少欺诈损失、压低误报，并在不增加人手的情况下扩大运营规模。这个方向值得看的地方在于，欺诈与合规团队长期被人手不足和警报过载困扰，而它选择直接嵌入既有流程来解决，且团队目前只有五人、正在招聘，处于 YC 夏季批次。

companies.name: Orikata Bio PBC
companies.originalOneLiner: A multiplayer discovery workspace for human and agentic scientists
companies.originalDescription: A new agent, tool, or generative model alone doesn’t solve the whole problem for most research questions. Someone still has to assemble the data, work out which methods to use and get the tools and datasets working together. We’re building Noto, a multiplayer discovery workbench for human and agentic scientists, to bring everyone's favorite frontier models, agents, tools, and scientific models into one shared workspace, so that you can focus on making your next discovery, rather than wrestling with your Python environment or finding GPUs. Plan an experiment, work with its generated data, run an analysis or model, maybe even train a new model, and keep the results in the notebook. We designed Noto so that the inputs, code, methods and results stay connected across local and hosted compute. Both people and agents need to see how a result was produced and build on it. Biology is where we’re starting, with the workbench being built for more general research across many scientific disciplines. Available now: our first biological analysis tools, hosted model inference, and an initial agent interface. Free usage is available within limits, alongside paid model runs and individual and team plans. Researchers can run sequence and structure analyses and hosted scientific models without provisioning GPUs or maintaining each model’s dependencies. In development: the full multiplayer notebook and wider agent workflows and integrations. Orikata Bio Public Benefit Corporation, or Orikata Bio PBC, is the company. We work under two brands: Orikata Bio for biological discovery and Megure Labs for scientific software. Biological discovery with Orikata Bio We’re developing Ibuki, a world-model family for biology, to learn how evolution, sequence, structure and function relate and use those relationships to understand and engineer living systems. We’re pretraining our own protein language models, and developing coordinate and multimodal models for prediction, inverse folding, alignment and generative design. Proteins are our starting point; DNA, RNA, small molecules, and other biological modalities are part of the longer-term direction. Along the way, we assembled Umi, with over 100 billion unique protein sequences, and Sora, with nearly two billion protein structure records. Having that much data only helps if we can organize it, compare it and find the biology relevant to a particular question. We’re building the full-corpus embedding, indexing and customer access that will bring more of those collections into research workflows. Our key insight was that the fixed substitution tables used to compare biological sequences are the simplest example of a neural network. Replacing them with contextual substitution operators lets us learn how positions correspond, from reference alignments and directly from molecular geometry. Hikoboshi (open source) turns those learned relationships into tools for sequence and structure alignment, search, clustering and many other evolutionary analysis pipelines. GitHub: https://github.com/orikata-bio/hikoboshi Scientific software with Megure Labs Learning those relationships meant making the alignment calculation itself trainable. Orihime (open source), our differentiable-alignment and structured-attention library, lets neural networks learn through scientific algorithms on CPUs and GPUs. It supplies the training machinery behind our learned alignment methods. GitHub: https://github.com/megure-labs/orihime Running the models efficiently is its own problem. Hataya (private evaluation), our inference engine and compiler for scientific models, turns trained models and their dependencies into standalone CPU and GPU programs, carrying the exact weights, identity and verification evidence with them. We’re building it to make both our models and public scientific models cheaper to run, including through Noto’s hosted service. Kaname coordinates long-running agent work across every model provider: tasks, compute, permissions, retries and the record of what happened. We’re bringing that coordination and provenance into Noto’s research workflows so work can continue across people, agents and machines. Researchers can start with a single analysis or hosted model run today. Noto is where we’re bringing them together so an analysis or model run can become part of a continuing research project, with the data, methods and results kept alongside it. Try Noto’s live tools: https://megure.ai/noto/workspace/ Biological tools: https://orikata.ai/tools/ Scientific software: https://megure.ai/ Biological discovery: https://orikata.ai/ Open source: https://github.com/megure-labs and https://github.com/orikata-bio For research use, questions about the data or private evaluations: casey@orikata.ai
companies.story: 这是做金融反欺诈与合规运营的公司。假如你是某家金融科技公司的风控分析师，每天早上打开系统就是几百条待处理警报，你需要在几个工具之间来回切换，手动拼凑上下文，再顶着时限做出判断。Socratix 想用智能体接手这类调查工作，让它们在现有工作流里实时核查警报，给出快速且可解释的结论，从而减少人工逐条复核、压低误报、在不扩编的情况下扩大运营规模。它来自 YC 夏季 2025 批次，团队 5 人，正在招聘，值得关注的是它切入的正是欺诈与合规团队长期被警报淹没这个真实痛点。

companies.name: Sentrial
companies.originalOneLiner: Datadog for Agent Reliability
companies.originalDescription: Sentrial is the monitoring platform for AI products in production. When your AI product/agent loops indefinitely, hallucinates, or frustrates users, Sentrial detects it in real-time, diagnoses the root cause, and recommends specific fixes. We provide the monitoring, evaluation, and debugging infrastructure that traditional tools weren't built for, so teams iterate based on production reality, not just offline evals.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是面向科研的协作式发现工作台。想象你是一位每天要跑实验的研究员，手头有前沿模型、智能体和各种科学工具，但光是配好环境、找算力、把数据和代码串起来就耗掉大半精力。Orikata Bio 正在做的 Noto 把人和智能体放进同一个共享空间，让实验计划、生成的数据、分析和模型训练都留在同一份笔记本里，输入、方法、代码和结果始终连在一起，人和智能体都能看清一个结果是怎么来的。它来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队仅 1 人，目前不招聘，场景本身值得看：科研协作里工具割裂的问题真实而普遍。

companies.name: OS3
companies.originalOneLiner: Affordable, intelligent humanoid robots built to deploy at scale
companies.originalDescription: OS3 is building the platform that makes intelligent robots accessible to every business. Today, robotics is constrained by two fundamental bottlenecks: hardware is too expensive to deploy at scale, and robots are difficult to train because high-quality robotics data is scarce and costly to collect. We built OS3 to solve both. Our two-person team designed and a US-made mobile humanoid robot for a fraction of the cost of commercial alternatives. On the intelligence side, instead of relying on expensive robot-generated training data, we trained our own video-action model on 150,000 hours of real-world video spanning more than 2,000 tasks. Every deployed robot feeds new experience into our reinforcement learning pipeline, self improving robot fleet over time. This creates a robot that can be deployed across industries to automate repetitive, physical work without requiring a new robot or training pipeline for every task. Our robots are already deployed in hotels, with customers now expanding the platform into biotech, hospitals, and data centers, including a wet lab at Stanford. Our mission is to do for robotics what Apple did for personal computing: take technology that was once expensive, specialized, and inaccessible and make it powerful and usable at massive scale. We’re building toward a world with billions of intelligent robots, and OS3 is the platform that makes that possible.
companies.story: 这是给生产环境里的人工智能产品做监控的公司。如果你负责一个已经上线的人工智能产品，最怕的就是智能体陷入死循环、开始胡编，或者把用户惹恼，而你只能等用户投诉才知道。Sentrial 做的是实时监测这类异常，定位根因并给出具体修复建议，提供传统工具没有为人工智能产品准备的监控、评估和调试基础设施，让团队依据生产中的真实表现迭代，而不只是看离线评测。它来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，团队 2 人，目前不招聘，值得看的地方在于人工智能产品上线后的可靠性问题正变得越来越普遍。

companies.name: Pocket
companies.originalOneLiner: Take Notes in the Real World
companies.originalDescription: Pocket is a Y Combinator W26 company building a premium hardware plus software product in the AI voice recorder space. We are obsessed with quality and speed. We are scaling very fast in the US and now European markets and building a device experience that can become the category leader.
companies.story: 这家公司切的是人形机器人硬件与训练平台。假如你是一家工厂的运营负责人，想用机器人接手重复的体力活，却发现商用机器人贵到无法规模化部署，训练数据也又少又贵。OS3 用两人团队设计出美国制造的移动人形机器人，成本远低于同类商用产品，并用 15 万小时真实视频、覆盖 2000 多个任务训练自己的视频动作模型，每台部署的机器人还会把新经验回流到强化学习流程里，让机队逐步自我改进。它来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队 2 人，正在招聘，值得关注的是它同时压低硬件成本并绕开机器人数据稀缺这两个瓶颈。

companies.name: Opalite Health
companies.originalOneLiner: Helping Healthcare Providers Speak Any Language
companies.originalDescription: Opalite makes it easy for healthcare providers to communicate with non-English speaking patients. We’re built to work inside existing clinical workflows, so providers can communicate in real time without waiting for an interpreter or delaying care. Opalite is available instantly, 24/7, and replaces traditional interpretation services with software that’s more reliable and saves millions of dollars per year. We've built a voice AI system that is the safest, most compliant, and most accurate medical interpreter in the world.
companies.story: 这是做人工智能录音硬件加软件产品的公司。想象你是一位会议很多的咨询顾问，一天连开几场会，边听边记根本跟不上，事后整理纪要又要花掉整个晚上。Pocket 把录音和笔记能力放进一台随身设备里，而不是只做一个手机应用，让你在真实世界里随手记下内容，再交给软件整理。它来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，团队 35 人，正在招聘，并且正在美国市场快速扩张、同时进入欧洲市场，值得关注的是它在人工智能录音设备这个品类里追求品质与速度，想做出品类领先的体验。

companies.name: Forge Automation
companies.originalOneLiner: Software Enabled CNC Parts Supplier
companies.originalDescription: Forge Automation runs software enabled factories that deliver custom metal parts in four days or less. Instead of mechanical engineers having to wait two to three weeks for their low volume CNC parts, they can simply upload a CAD model on our platform and we will ship it out in four days or less. We aim to give mechanical engineers the "Amazon experience" for custom metal parts.
companies.story: 这是帮医疗机构跨语言沟通的公司。如果你是一家诊所的运营负责人，某天来了一位不会说英语的患者，等专业口译员要排时间，诊疗被拖慢，沟通还可能出错。Opalite 把语音人工智能做成医疗口译系统，嵌进现有临床流程，医生可以实时和患者交流，不用等口译服务，全天候可用。它来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，团队 3 人，正在招聘，值得关注的是它用软件替代传统口译服务，声称更可靠并能为机构每年省下可观费用，而医疗场景对准确与合规的要求恰恰很高。

companies.name: Hlabs
companies.originalOneLiner: US-Made Parts for Robots
companies.originalDescription: HLabs is making an industrial supply chain for building robots in the USA including electronics and actuators, with a focus on in-house manufacturing. Robotics is going to be one of the largest industries the world has ever seen. Teams have to buy what they can from overseas and then build everything else in house just to get something to move. HLabs is producing a plug and play set of robotic primitives to accelerate the early development and then working with larger scale production robots for bespoke designs. Early customers span across household robotics, humanoids, robot arms, quadrupeds, and defense. Hlabs is founded by Paul, a second time YC founder who also participated in the W21 batch with Mystic. He ran Mystic as CEO for 6 years.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是软件驱动的数控零件供应。假如你是一位机械工程师，设计改了一版，只需要少量定制金属件，却要等两三周才能拿到，整个项目节奏都被拖住。Forge Automation 运营由软件驱动的工厂，你只要在平台上上传三维模型，四天内或更短时间就能收到零件，它想给机械工程师一种像网购一样顺滑的定制金属件体验。它来自 YC 冬季 2025 批次，位于多伦多，团队 21 人，正在招聘，值得关注的是它把软件和自有工厂结合起来，直接压缩小批量数控件的交付周期。

companies.name: CellType
companies.originalOneLiner: The agentic drug company. We simulate human biology.
companies.originalDescription: CellType is building an agentic drug company. AI agents that run the full drug discovery pipeline on top of biological foundation models that simulate human biology. Our core technology, developed with Google DeepMind, has already discovered and validated a new cancer treatment signal. We’re working with Top 10 pharma.
companies.story: 这是给机器人做美国本土工业供应链的公司。想象你是一个机器人初创团队的硬件负责人，想让原型动起来，却发现电子件和执行器只能从海外零散采购，剩下的还得自己从头造。Hlabs 生产一套即插即用的机器人基础部件，先帮早期团队加快开发，再为规模化生产的机器人做定制设计，覆盖电子件与执行器并强调自研制造。它来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，团队 1 人，目前不招聘，早期客户分布在家庭机器人、人形机器人、机械臂、四足机器人和国防领域，值得看的是机器人行业正在扩张，而本土部件供应仍是明显缺口。

companies.name: Rovi Health
companies.originalOneLiner: AI healthcare concierge for employees
companies.originalDescription: We deliver high-quality, cost-effective healthcare to employees through text. Employers cut 10–20% of healthcare spend. Employees get concierge care that improves outcomes. Our AI agents analyze clinical data to identify care needs. We treat common conditions through our integrated virtual clinic. For more complex care, our agents find the best in-network providers using millions of price and quality data points, and handle end-to-end appointment booking.
companies.story: 这是给员工提供人工智能医疗管家的公司。假如你是一位公司的人力资源或福利负责人，每年医保支出不断上涨，员工却常因不知道去哪看病而拖延治疗。Rovi Health 通过短信提供医疗服务，智能体分析临床数据找出员工的照护需求，常见病症由自带的线上诊所处理，更复杂的情况则由智能体依据海量价格与质量数据匹配网络内合适的医生，并完成从预约到就诊的全流程安排。它来自 YC 秋季 2025 批次，位于纽约，团队 3 人，正在招聘，值得关注的是它同时面向雇主降低医疗开支、面向员工改善就医体验。

readings.title: Tesla goes all-in on the Cybercab with upcoming €3B Berlin Gigafactory expansion
readings.story: 一家车企宣布扩建工厂，通常意味着它押注某款车会真正量产、真正卖出去。特斯拉这次把柏林工厂的扩建和 Cybercab 绑在一起，读者自然会问：这笔钱是在为一个还没被市场验证的产品下注吗。这篇值得读，是因为它把公司层面的决心摆到了台面上，你能顺着看一家公司如何用产能表达判断。读的时候不妨留意作者怎么处理数字和预期之间的距离：三亿欧元、柏林、Cybercab，哪些是已确定的事实，哪些还只是规划。也看它有没有追问，如果这款车节奏不如预期，工厂和当地会承担什么。

readings.title: How MoEngage built agentic customer engagement on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
readings.story: 做客户触达的产品团队常会碰到一个尴尬：工具越接越多，活动越跑越细，但用户收到的东西还是显得机械。当大模型开始被塞进这类流程，问题就变成了怎么让自动化不只是换个说法发消息。这篇讲的是 MoEngage 在 Amazon Bedrock AgentCore 上搭建智能体式客户互动，适合正在评估要不要把 人工智能 放进营销或运营链路的人读。读的时候重点看他们怎么切分任务：哪些判断交给模型，哪些仍由规则和人来兜底，以及他们如何衡量这样做比原来的方式更值得。

readings.title: Show HN: Live security walkthrough for pre-SOC2 startups in protected cloud room
readings.story: 早期创业公司常遇到一个时间点：客户开始问安全合规，融资尽调也开始要材料，但公司还没到做 SOC2 的阶段。这时团队往往不知道该先补什么，也请不起专职安全人员。这条 Show HN 展示的是一个面向这类公司的现场安全走查服务，放在受保护的云环境里做演示。它值得看，是因为它反映了早期公司在合规压力下如何找轻量办法。读的时候可以留意它把哪些环节做成可演示的步骤，以及这种服务到底替创始人省掉了哪部分最费神的准备工作。

companies.name: Tasklet
companies.originalOneLiner: Agents that own the work
companies.originalDescription: AI chatbots can answer questions, but they can't do your work — they aren't connected to your tools, can't take actions, and stop running when you close the tab. Meanwhile, knowledge workers are still spending most of their day switching between dozens of SaaS apps, manually stitching together workflows that should be automated. Tasklet is the AI agent that actually does the work. It connects to every tool you use — via thousands of built-in integrations, any HTTP API, or MCP servers — and takes real actions on your behalf: pulling reports, updating CRMs, triaging emails, processing data, and more. When it needs a UI, it generates one on the fly. When it needs to crunch numbers or do bulk operations, it writes and runs code in a cloud sandbox. When it needs to interact with a website that doesn't have an API, it uses a real browser. And because it runs in the cloud 24/7, you can set up triggers to have it take ongoing responsibility for workflows — not just do something once, but handle it going forward. The product is deliberately simple: a chat interface where you talk to an extremely capable agent. But underneath that simplicity is a cloud-native agent runtime, best-in-class context engineering, a universal connections layer, and multi-model support that keeps us on the frontier as AI improves. We think legacy SaaS is being unbundled by agents, and Tasklet is the operating system that ties it all together.
companies.story: 这是做通用办公智能体的公司。假如你是一位负责运营的分析师，每天要在十几个软件之间来回切换，早上从系统里拉报表，中午更新客户记录，下午还要清理收件箱，真正动脑的时间被切得很碎。Tasklet 的智能体可以连上你常用的工具，替你执行这些动作，需要界面时临时生成一个，需要算数或批量处理时在云端写代码运行，遇到没有接口的网站就用真实浏览器去操作，而且它常驻云端，关掉页面也照常干活。这家公司来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队八人，正在招聘，适合关注智能体如何从问答走向真正动手的人。

companies.name: Synphony
companies.originalOneLiner: robots & software for farms
companies.originalDescription: Strawberry farming is a $3B industry in California alone with 60% labor cost using 40-year old software. Synphony provides strawberry picking robots and software services including: bed-level analytics, data pipeline integration, and agentic solutions. Synphony's "side hustle" is selling data, evals, and viral demos to robot foundation labs while building capacity for general robot deployments. We've started with strawberry farming for great margins and outdoor data moat, but also received requests for robots in semi-conductors and autonomous space labs. Synphony's team has won over 15 hackathons together (taking home 4 Jensen-signed GPUs!). Sean did ML research at NVIDIA and led AI products used by IRS and Citibank. Lucas' research spanned robotics, IoT devices, and neuromorphic computing. Alex architected an app with 400k users.
companies.story: 这家公司切的是农业机器人加农场软件。想象你是一位草莓种植园的负责人，采收季一到就为人工发愁，加州草莓产业里人工成本占到六成，而手里的管理软件还是四十年前的老样子。Synphony 提供采摘机器人，也提供苗床级数据分析、数据管道对接和智能体方案，让种植者能看清每一床的情况并减少对人手的依赖。团队拿过十五场以上黑客松，成员做过英伟达的机器学习研究，也主导过被税务和银行机构使用的产品。它从草莓切入，同时接到半导体和太空实验室的机器人需求，来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队十人。

companies.name: Unsiloed AI
companies.originalOneLiner: API for parsing multimodal unstructured data
companies.originalDescription: AI teams spend 6+ months building document workflows, yet fewer than 10% ever reach production. Generic LLM parsers and OCR collapse on multimodal documents with text, tables, images, and charts. Poor parsing and suboptimal chunking cripple RAG pipelines and downstream automation. Unsiloed AI has built state-of-the-art vision models which serves as the infrastructure layer for turning unstructured data into structured, queryable, and LLM-ready assets. Our APIs are already parsing hundreds of thousands of documents for startups and NASDAQ-listed enterprises, powering vertical AI solutions across industries. On public benchmarks, Unsiloed AI consistently outperforms solutions from LlamaIndex, Gemini, Mistral, and Unstructured.io among others.
companies.story: 这是做多模态文档解析接口的基础设施公司。如果你是一支人工智能团队的工程负责人，手上堆着成千上万份带表格、图片和图表的扫描件，通用解析器和文字识别一遇到这种混排就崩，切分做不好，后面的检索和自动化全被拖垮，项目做了半年还上不了线。Unsiloed AI 用自研的视觉模型把这些非结构化内容转成结构化、可查询、可直接喂给模型的资产，对外提供接口。它已经在为创业公司和纳斯达克上市企业解析数十万份文档，公开基准上表现优于多个同类方案。公司来自 YC 秋季 2025 批次，团队两人，正在招聘。

companies.name: screenpipe
companies.originalOneLiner: Turn your company's computer work into AI agents.
companies.originalDescription: Screenpipe records and learns how people in your company work and turns it into a searchable memory, documents, and AI agents. Model agnostic and data is stored on your device and/or where your team choose, source available.
companies.story: 这是把公司内部的电脑操作变成智能体的企业软件公司。一个工程负责人每天会看到同事在重复同样的操作，查日志、填表单、翻旧文档，这些经验散在各人手里，人一走就没了。screenpipe 记录并学习公司里人们怎么用电脑干活，把这些过程变成可搜索的记忆、文档和智能体，而且不绑定某一家模型，数据存在设备上或团队自己选的地方，代码开放可查。它来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队两人，正在招聘，值得看的地方在于它把日常操作本身当成可积累的资产，而不是再做一个孤立的工具。

companies.name: Adialante
companies.originalOneLiner: Cancer screening without barriers
companies.originalDescription: We know how to improve cancer outcomes by 8x-10x: you catch it early. MRI is the most robust and powerful cancer-detection tool in the world, yet systems cost millions to purchase, take months to install, and require high levels of technical skill to operate. We've redesigned MRI from the ground up with new physics, algorithms, and hardware, all to bring cancer screening to the entire world. Our mobile MRI is an imaging clinic on wheels. No equipment to buy, no infrastructure needed. For a flat per-scan fee, any medical site can offer MRI cancer screening. Starting with prostate cancer. Then everything else.
companies.story: 这是做移动癌症筛查影像的公司。假如你是一家基层医疗机构的负责人，想给病人做核磁筛查，却买不起动辄数百万的设备，安装要等几个月，还得配高水平技师。Adialante 从物理、算法和硬件重新设计了核磁，做成一辆车上的影像诊所，机构不用买设备、不用建机房，按次付费就能开展筛查，先从前列腺癌做起。它的判断是癌症早发现能把结果改善八到十倍，而核磁是最有力的检测工具之一。公司来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队四人，正在招聘，看点在于把昂贵的大型影像能力搬到病人身边。

companies.name: Plena Health
companies.originalOneLiner: Plena is the AI operating system for specialty medical practices
companies.originalDescription: Plena is the AI operating system for specialty medical practices. We automate the administrative workflows that keep clinics running — referrals, fax intake, scheduling, procedure compliance, and collections — end to end, across all the systems a practice already uses. Unlike point solutions that cover a slice of the problem, Plena becomes the operating layer across the entire practice, connecting the systems, teams, and workflows that keep it running. In 10 months we've grown 17x and crossed seven figures in committed ARR across six specialties and eight states, with 80% of growth through word of mouth.
companies.story: 这是做专科诊所后台运营系统的公司。如果你负责一家专科诊所的日常运营，每天会被转诊单、传真、排班、术前合规和收款追着跑，这些事分散在好几个系统里，前台和后台来回补漏。Plena Health 把这些流程端到端自动化，横跨诊所已经在用的系统，做成覆盖整个诊所的运营层，而不是只解决其中一小块。十个月里它增长十七倍，签约年收入超过七位数，覆盖六个专科、八个州，八成增长来自口碑。公司来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，正在招聘，值得关注的是它在真实诊所里跑出的增长节奏。

companies.name: DeepAware AI (Robotics Center of Silicon Valley)
companies.originalOneLiner: Robots, parts & RL envs & evals - delivered in 48 hrs / pickup in SF.
companies.originalDescription: DeepAware (Robotics Center of Silicon Valley, https://roboticscenter.ai/) is the fastest way for enterprises and researchers to get robots and robotics parts in the US — 72-hour delivery or Bay Area pickup. Beyond hardware, we help teams collect teleoperation data, build reinforcement learning environments, and deploy robots into production. Customers include AI labs, industrial operations, research teams, and event producers.
companies.story: 这是做机器人硬件与配套工程服务的公司。想象你是一位实验室研究员，论文要赶在截稿前跑完实验，可机械臂和零件下单后要等上几周，强化学习环境还得自己搭。DeepAware 把机器人和机器人零件在美国的交付压缩到七十二小时，湾区可以自取，还帮团队采集遥操作数据、搭建强化学习环境、把机器人部署到生产里。客户包括人工智能实验室、工业运营方、研究团队和活动制作方。它来自 YC 夏季 2025 批次，团队四人，正在招聘，看点在于它把机器人落地中最耗时间的采购和调试环节接了过去。

companies.name: Voquill
companies.originalOneLiner: The agentic OS for medical labs
companies.originalDescription: Voquill is the modern AI-native operating system for medical labs. This software manages the entire workflow of the lab (accessioning, workflow, reporting, coding, compliance, and revenue) and contains modern agentic AI tools to help each step. For example, pathologists can write reports 20% faster through our voice AI coworker. Incumbent lab operating systems are old, don't scale with how modern labs work, and can’t integrate existing AI solutions. As a result, labs are either building their own or paying millions for band-aid solutions and consultants. We're building an agentic platform to manage every aspect of the lab and displace the billions spent on legacy management systems.
companies.story: 这是做医学实验室操作系统的公司。设想一位病理学家，一天要看几十份样本，报告要一个字一个字敲，编码和合规检查还得另外核对，旧的实验室系统又老又难扩展，现成的人工智能工具也接不进去。Voquill 把收样、流程、报告、编码、合规和收入管理放进一套系统，并配上智能体工具，比如语音助手能让病理学家写报告快两成。实验室要么自建，要么花大钱请顾问打补丁，这家公司想直接替换掉这些老旧系统。它来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队三人，值得看的是它切进了长期被旧软件占住的实验室核心流程。

companies.name: TovenAI
companies.originalOneLiner: AI agents for compliance at institutional trading firms
companies.originalDescription: TovenAI builds a platform of AI agents that handle manual, data-intensive work for compliance teams at institutional trading firms, with six agents currently live. Our customers range from specialist firms to large global institutions, with our agents supporting multiple compliance workflows at a top-10 institutional brokerage. With prebuilt connectors to more than 30 systems—including Bloomberg, Cloud9, and NICE Actimize—firms can onboard to our platform and evaluate results using their own data in less than a week.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是机构交易公司的合规智能体。如果你是一名合规分析师，每天要在多个系统之间核对交易记录、筛查异常、整理留档材料，大量时间花在复制粘贴和比对数据上。TovenAI 用一组智能体接手这些手工且数据密集的工作，目前已有六个智能体上线，客户从专业机构到大型全球机构都有，其中一个前十大的机构券商在多个合规流程中使用它们。平台预置了三十多个系统的连接器，机构不到一周就能接入并用自己的数据评估效果。公司来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队两人，看点在于合规这种容错极低的场景也开始被智能体接手。

companies.name: ANORIA
companies.originalOneLiner: The first wearable that reads your emotions to enhance your EQ.
companies.originalDescription: We've spent decades tracking everything. Sleep. Recovery. Steps. All proxies for how we feel. Performance is 90% mental. And yet no one has built the feedback loop for our emotions. We close that loop by designing a device that understands how you feel, tells you why, and what you can do about it. Emotional intelligence becomes trainable, so you can better connect and create with those around you.
companies.story: 这是做情绪可穿戴设备的公司。想象一位每天会议排满的咨询顾问，白天要说服客户、安抚团队，晚上却说不清自己为什么累，睡眠、步数、恢复分数都记了一堆，没有一项告诉他此刻的情绪从哪来。ANORIA 做的是一个能感知情绪的设备，它不只记录，还解释原因并给出可以做的事，让情绪识别变成可以训练的能力。它不是手机应用，而是把传感器和能力放进随身佩戴的设备里，在真实场景中持续读取状态。公司来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队五人，值得看的是它把长期被忽略的情绪反馈补成了一个闭环。

readings.title: HubSpot Is Refounding as the “Customer Harness Company.” Here’s What That Means for Us, Right Now, in November 2026
readings.story: 很多做 SaaS 的团队都会遇到一个时刻：客户数据散在好几个工具里，销售、客服、市场各看各的，谁也说不清一个客户到底经历了什么。HubSpot 这次重新给自己定位，就是在这个背景下发生的。值得读，是因为它展示了一家成熟公司怎么回头改自己的叙事，而不只是换个口号。读的时候可以留意作者如何拆解这次重新定位：它到底是在回应客户行为的变化，还是在回应竞争压力，以及一个公司对外讲的故事和内部真正在做的产品之间，差距是怎么被处理掉的。

readings.title: US Has Lost Measles Elimination Status, Global Health Authorities Say
readings.story: 一条公共卫生新闻出现在技术社区的热门列表里，乍看有点意外。但工程师和创业者关心的往往不只是技术本身，而是数据、监测和预警这类能力在真实世界里怎么起作用。麻疹消除状态被取消这件事，背后是持续传播和监测体系的问题。读它的时候，不妨先看技术社区的人为什么把它顶上来：他们讨论的是信息如何被追踪、被上报、被信任，以及一个看起来遥远的公共卫生指标，和做数据产品的人之间有什么共通之处。

readings.title: Meta’s Muse: How we launched the most successful consumer product this year | Mona Sarantakos
readings.story: 做产品的人大概都经历过这样的时刻：东西做出来了，团队觉得不错，可用户就是不用，或者用了也留不住。消费级产品尤其如此，热闹的发布之后，真正的难题才刚开始。这篇讲的是 Meta 今年最成功的消费产品是怎么推起来的，值得读的地方在于它把注意力放在“发布”这件事本身：一个产品从内部做完到被大量普通人接受，中间要跨过哪些坎。读的时候可以留意作者如何拆解发布前的准备与判断，哪些取舍被证明是对的，以及在用户反馈到来时，团队怎么分辨哪些声音该听、哪些该放。这些细节对正在准备上线新产品的人会有直接参照。

companies.name: Synapse Semiconductor
companies.originalOneLiner: New semiconductors that merge compute and vision
companies.originalDescription: We want to push machines to where humans cant go. Presidential early career award winning Duke Semiconductor ECE Faculty Tania Roy and Sanjeev Chauhan are building a frontier semiconductor research lab. Their focus is on solving physical AI challenges from the semiconductor device level and building products around the moat of impossible to copy innovation. Their first work is on a new vision sensor that can run neural network filters right in the camera pixels and only collect data that machines care about. As physical AI develops, machines needs to understand the world around them if they aim to interact with them.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是边缘计算芯片，把计算和视觉能力合到同一块半导体里。假如你负责一台要在废墟或管道里自主行动的机器人，它今天遇到的麻烦是摄像头拍到的画面太多，传回后方既慢又费电，真正有用的信息却淹没在噪声里。Synapse Semiconductor 的做法是在摄像头的像素层面就运行神经网络滤波，只留下机器真正关心的数据，而不是先把一切拍下来再说。它来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队目前只有两人，正在招聘，方向覆盖机器人、国防等物理人工智能场景。值得看的地方在于它从器件层面切入，而不是在现成硬件上叠软件，这类创新一旦成立就很难被复制。

companies.name: Speko
companies.originalOneLiner: OpenRouter for Voice AI: one API, every call on the best speech model
companies.originalDescription: Speko is a router for voice models: one API key, and your voice agent runs on the speech-to-text, LLM, and text-to-speech models we measured as best for your language and use case. The measurements are public at benchmarks.speko.ai: we test new models the day they ship and re-route when the numbers change, so you rewrite nothing. We ran this bake-off by hand for four years at previous company, shipping production voice for Fortune 500s.
companies.story: 这家公司切的是语音智能体的模型路由层。想象你正在开发一个多语言的语音客服智能体，今天遇到的麻烦是语音转文字、大模型、文字转语音三段各要用不同供应商，每出一款新模型你就得重新评估、改代码、再上线。Speko 提供一个接口和一把密钥，按语言和使用场景自动把请求路由到它测出来表现最好的语音模型，测试结果公开在基准网站上，新模型发布当天就会测，数字变了就重新路由，开发者不用改任何东西。它来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队四人，正在招聘，团队称此前在一家公司手工做过四年这类模型对比，并为财富五百强交付过生产级语音。

companies.name: CharacterQuilt
companies.originalOneLiner: Computer use agents to deploy enterprise marketing campaigns
companies.originalDescription: CharacterQuilt builds computer use agents to deploy enterprise marketing campaigns. Marketers today don’t actually do much marketing at all. Today, over 80% of time spent on launching a marketing campaign is actually ops work: tweaking automation flows in Pardot, configuring audiences in LinkedIn, or wiring HTML emails in Marketo. What’s crazy about enterprise marketing is companies pay agencies millions of dollars just to deploy campaigns in their systems — and they still have to wait weeks for each one. CharacterQuilt is AI infrastructure for marketing teams: a brain that learns your brand, and agents that operate your existing tools. Marketing campaigns that used to take 3 agencies, 10 tools, and 6 weeks are now being built, designed, and deployed from CQ in an hour. Customers submit a brief like they would send to a human teammate or marketing agency, and they get back fully designed and deployed campaigns. Teams like 1upHealth, ABC Fitness, and Emplifi use us to: 1-) Build segments/audiences faster 2-) Create on-brand creative (AI is terrible at staying on-brand) 3-) Deploy campaigns automatically into HubSpot, WordPress, LinkedIn etc. We replicate your brand guidelines, deeply understand past campaigns, and work inside your systems. If you run demand gen or lifecycle at a B2B/B2C company and want to ship campaigns faster, send us a brief and we’ll build it in 15 minutes.
companies.story: 这是做企业营销活动部署的智能体公司。如果你是一名企业营销经理，今天要上线一场活动，麻烦在于真正花时间的不是创意，而是在 Pardot 里调自动化流程、在领英里配受众、在 Marketo 里拼邮件模板，八成时间都耗在这些运营杂活上，等 agency 交付还要好几周。CharacterQuilt 让营销人员像给同事或代理公司发简报一样提交需求，由学习过品牌调性的智能体直接操作企业已有的工具，把设计、搭建和部署一起完成。它来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队四人，正在招聘。值得关注的是它瞄准的是企业营销里长期外包给 agency 的那部分部署工作，而不是再做一个内容生成工具。

companies.name: Hue
companies.originalOneLiner: Test agents in realistic worlds built from production usage
companies.originalDescription: Hue turns production usage of agents into repeatable tests that preserve the tools, data, and state behind the real run. As AI agents take on real work, their behavior depends increasingly on the nuances of the world around them. With Hue, teams can test and improve their agents under conditions that mimic real usage.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是智能体的测试基础设施。假设你是一个工程负责人，手上的智能体已经在生产环境跑真实任务，今天遇到的麻烦是它在演示里表现很好，一换到真实工具、真实数据和真实状态组合下就出问题，而你很难把那次出错的运行原样复现出来。Hue 把生产环境里的实际使用记录转成可重复的测试，保留当时调用的工具、数据和状态，让团队在接近真实的条件下反复测试和改进智能体。它来自 YC 秋季 2026 批次，团队两人，目前不招聘。这个场景本身值得看，因为智能体越往真实工作里走，行为就越依赖周围环境的细节，能不能稳定复现就成了能不能上生产的关键。

companies.name: horizontal.
companies.originalOneLiner: AI agents that run factory operations end-to-end.
companies.originalDescription: Every factory will be run by AI agents. Horizontal is building them. Today, the work that keeps production moving is scattered across people, teams, and disconnected software. When plans change, materials run short, or quality issues appear, factory teams piece together the context and coordinate the response by hand. Horizontal's AI agents take on that operational work inside the systems factories already use. They replan production around a disruption, investigate quality issues and coordinate order releases across teams and tools. Manufacturers start with one process and add agents over time, building toward a system that coordinates the factory end to end. Factories are demanding environments for AI: every plant has its own systems and procedures, and every action must work in the context of real production. Our team combines mechanical engineering and shop-floor experience with a track record of building and deploying agentic AI in global industrial companies. Horizontal connects the people, software and machines that run production.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是工厂运营的智能体。假如你是一个工厂的运营负责人，今天计划突然被打乱，某种物料短缺，同时一条线出现质量异常，你的麻烦是要在几个人、几个班组和几套互不相通的软件之间手工拼出全貌，再一个个打电话协调。horizontal. 的智能体接手这类运营工作，在工厂已有的系统里重新排产、追查质量问题、跨团队协调订单放行，客户可以先从一个流程用起，再逐步增加智能体。它来自 YC 秋季 2026 批次，团队两人，目前不招聘。值得看的是它面对的是每个工厂各有一套系统和流程的复杂现场，团队把机械工程和车间经验与工程能力放在一起，这类场景恰恰是通用工具很难直接套用的。

companies.name: Origami Robotics
companies.originalOneLiner: Manipulate Anything Robot
companies.originalDescription: We are building a "manipulate anything" model with the robot hardware that embodies it. We designed a hand-based data-collection device and a high DOF, direct drive robotic hand that match each other exactly, enabling us to eliminate embodiment gap and collect real-world data and deploy it directly. We want to scale real world manipulation data by deploying our devices "in the wild" like manufacturing factories, logistic centers to collect Tesla like data, use these data to train our model and then provide automation solutions to these industries.
companies.story: 这家公司做人形操作机器人和配套的抓取模型。想象你在一家物流中心负责分拣，今天遇到的麻烦是货品种类太杂，形状、软硬、重量都不一样，靠预设动作的机械臂一遇到没见过的物件就停摆。Origami Robotics 的思路是让数据采集装置和机器人手在结构上完全对齐，消除采集与部署之间的差异，再把设备放到工厂、物流中心这类真实场景里持续采集操作数据，用来训练一个能操作各种物体的模型，最后向这些行业提供自动化方案。它来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，团队五人，目前不招聘。值得看的是它把硬件和数据采集绑在一起设计，而不是先做手再想办法补数据。

companies.name: Code Four
companies.originalOneLiner: Modernizing the police workflow.
companies.originalDescription: Code Four slashes the administrative burden on law enforcement through AI-driven automation. Officers spend up to a third of their shifts manually transcribing body camera footage, creating inaccuracies, reducing transparency, and cutting into frontline duties. We're here to eliminate these inefficiencies by integrating with body cameras, record management systems, and digital evidence management systems—acting as a software layer for data processing. We free the most overworked and underappreciated people in the world: police officers.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是警务流程的软件层。如果你是一名一线警员，今天值完班还有一堆文书要处理，麻烦在于随身摄像头拍下的内容要手工转写成报告，往往占掉当班时间的三分之一，既容易出错，也挤压了真正上街的时间。Code Four 通过接入随身摄像头、记录管理系统和数字证据管理系统，用人工智能自动完成这类行政处理，把数据加工这一层接过来。它来自 YC 春季 2025 批次，团队三人，正在招聘。值得关注的是它选的是一个长期被行政负担压住、又对准确性和透明度要求很高的公共部门场景，而不是泛泛的文档工具。

companies.name: Janeen
companies.originalOneLiner: Prior auths and benefits investigation for infusion clinics
companies.originalDescription: Janeen is built for infusion clinics. We handle prior authorizations and benefit investigations from start to finish (actually though!). Biologics are expensive medications that cost $80-$150K+ per year per patient, and often need to be administered in specific settings called infusion clinics. Medical providers buy these drugs up front to secure pricing deals and safer inventory - they are reimbursed for the cost of the medications through the patients’ insurance. Current medical workflows aren't built for infusion clinics. Inventory, storage, transport, and billing is still managed through paper and excel spreadsheets. And because they’re so expensive, these specialty medications are denied by insurers at a rate of 37% each year. When they are denied, when workflows fail, or patients are infused before paperwork is cleared, providers don’t get reimbursed for the medication and are left covering the costs. Ruma Care solves this so clinics get paid, patients get treated faster, and care teams spend less time fighting forms. We work with clinics across the country and have removed 95% of all manual labor in the process.
companies.story: 这家公司切的是输液诊所的 prior authorization 和福利调查。假设你在一家输液诊所负责运营，今天要给一位患者用生物制剂，麻烦在于这类药一年费用可达八万到十五万美元，诊所往往要先垫资采购，而保险公司每年的拒付率约为百分之三十七，一旦流程没走完就先输液，药费就收不回来。Janeen 把授权申请和福利调查从头到尾接过去做，针对输液诊所的库存、储存、运输和账单流程设计，而不是套用普通门诊的工作流。它来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，团队五人，正在招聘。值得看的是它盯住的是高价药垫资和拒付之间的现金流风险，这是诊所每天都要面对的现实问题。

companies.name: Rasyn
companies.originalOneLiner: Making chemicals 100,000x faster
companies.originalDescription: We build foundational AI models for chemistry. Almost nothing you buy is a single chemical. Products like datacenter coolant, GPU thermal paste, paint, and glue are formulations, which are mixtures of around ten ingredients each, and demand for them has grown quickly because of AI and EVs. Designing a new formulation is essentially a search problem, because there are more possible mixtures than anyone could ever test, and none of them can be predicted in advance. As a result, bringing a single formulation to market today takes three to five years of trial and error in a lab. Our models predict how a mixture will behave far faster than the standard methods used today, which lets us design new formulations in weeks rather than years, at a fraction of the cost. To prove this, we used them to invent three chemicals that never existed before, including a PFAS-free coolant for datacenters, and we have since synthesized and patented all three. We are already working with some of the largest manufacturers to design formulations for them, and we are building our own lab to generate the data that will train our next models.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是化学配方的基础人工智能模型。如果你在一家材料公司的研发部门工作，今天要为一款数据中心冷却液或导热膏找新配方，麻烦在于这类产品是十种左右成分的混合物，可能的组合比任何人能测试的都多，也无法提前预测，靠实验室试错把一款配方推向市场通常要三到五年。Rasyn 的模型能比现有标准方法快得多地预测混合物行为，把配方设计从数年缩短到数周，成本也大幅下降。它来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队三人，目前不招聘。值得看的是团队称已用模型设计出三种此前不存在的化学品，其中包括一款不含 PFAS 的数据中心冷却液，这是可验证的产品信号而不是空泛的愿景。

companies.name: Stoa
companies.originalOneLiner: The market behind AI hardware.
companies.originalDescription: Stoa provides pricing and trading infrastructure for AI hardware, live with an RFQ marketplace where companies buy and sell GPUs through vetted dealers real-time.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是人工智能硬件的定价和交易基础设施。假如你是一家正在扩算力的公司里负责采购的人，今天要临时补一批图形处理器，麻烦在于市场报价零散、交期和成色参差，你很难在短时间内判断什么价格算合理。Stoa 提供报价和交易的基础设施，已经上线一个询价市场，让公司在经过审核的经销商之间实时买卖图形处理器。它来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队三人，正在招聘。值得看的是它没有停在信息撮合上，而是把定价和交易流程本身做成基础设施，这在算力供需波动剧烈的阶段是一个真实存在的痛点。

readings.title: Show HN: A terminal-native idle factory game, written in Rust with ratatui
readings.story: 很多工程师都有过这样的时刻：想亲手做个小项目练手，又不想被图形界面和框架拖着走，于是把目光投回终端。终端游戏这类东西一直有人玩，因为它把界面压到最少，剩下的全是逻辑和手感。这篇值得读的地方在于，它把一个小游戏从想法做成了能跑起来的东西，而且选了 Rust 和 ratatui 这套组合，能看出作者对性能和简洁有自己的偏好。读的时候可以留意作者怎么划分游戏循环和界面刷新，怎么在终端这种限制很多的画布上安排信息，以及哪些设计是为了好玩、哪些是为了代码好维护。对想动手做第一个小项目的人，这种取舍过程比成品本身更有参考价值。

readings.title: SaaStr AI App of the Week: SciFin. The Nutanix and Cohesity Founder Raised $44 Million to Build AI for Sales Teams.
readings.story: 做销售的人大概都有过这种时刻：手里攒着一堆线索和客户往来记录，可真正要判断下一步该跟谁、该说什么，却总觉得信息散在各处，拼不出完整画面。这类“上下文缺口”在团队扩张后尤其明显，新人接手客户时最容易被卡住。这篇值得读，是因为它讲的不是又一个功能堆叠的工具，而是一个连续创业者带着大笔融资去做销售场景里的 人工智能。读的时候可以留意作者如何描述问题边界：他把缺口归到哪个环节，又认为什么样的公司会先为此买单。

readings.title: No Pilots. Few Air Traffic Controllers. What Could Go Wrong?
readings.story: 坐飞机时我们很少想到驾驶舱里坐着谁，也很少想到地面上还有多少人在盯着雷达屏幕。可当航空公司开始讨论减少飞行员、空管人手又长期紧张，普通人自然会问一句：安全这件事靠什么兜底。这篇报道值得看，是因为它没有停在技术能不能做到的层面，而是把注意力放到了人和制度上。读的时候不妨看作者怎么组织不同立场的声音，怎么在乐观和担忧之间保持分寸，以及他反复追问的到底是哪几个具体风险。

companies.name: Captain
companies.originalOneLiner: Self-tuning search for products and files
companies.originalDescription: Captain makes product catalogs and complex, multimodal files searchable for customers and AI agents. It syncs files from sources like S3, SharePoint, and Google Drive and tunes search to your data and workloads. Instead of stitching together parsers, embeddings, vector databases, rerankers, and retrieval infrastructure, developers use Captain to power product search and file retrieval through managed APIs. On evaluated file-search benchmarks, Captain’s tuning improved retrieval accuracy from roughly 78% with standard RAG to over 97%. Built for complex catalogs and demanding file-search workloads, including regulated and high-stakes applications.
companies.story: 这家公司切的是搜索基础设施，让产品目录和复杂文件变得可被检索。假如你是一名工程负责人，公司有一批散落在云存储、共享盘和内部系统里的产品资料与多模态文件，客户和智能体都想直接搜到答案，你却在拼接解析器、向量数据库、重排模型和检索服务，调来调去准确率还是上不去。Captain 把文件同步、解析和调优打包成托管接口，开发者用它就能撑起产品搜索和文件检索，官方说在评测里把检索准确率从约百分之七十八提升到百分之九十七以上。它值得关注的地方在于，它瞄准的是受监管、高风险的复杂检索场景，而不是简单的关键词搜索。它来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，团队两人。

companies.name: Minicor
companies.originalOneLiner: Scalable windows desktop automations
companies.originalDescription: Minicor connects AI startups to legacy desktop apps that have no API. Reliably, quickly and at scale. Describe a workflow and get an API endpoint. Each call triggers a self-healing desktop automation on a Windows VM. On-prem, cloud, or Citrix. Build through your coding agent via our MCP. Complete with the observability tools to manage your customer relationship: full video replay of every automation, granular logging, and slack enabled alerts.
companies.story: 这是做桌面自动化基础设施的公司，专门把没有接口的老旧桌面软件接进人工智能工作流。想象你是一家 人工智能 初创公司的工程负责人，客户的核心业务跑在一套只能人工点击的 Windows 软件里，你想让智能体自动完成流程，却要面对虚拟机、远程桌面和随时会崩的脚本。Minicor 让你用自然语言描述流程，换回一个接口地址，每次调用都会在一台 Windows 虚拟机上触发能自我修复的自动化，云端、本地或 Citrix 环境都支持，还提供每一步的视频回放、细粒度日志和 Slack 告警。它来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队九人，正在招聘，说明它已经要把这套能力铺到更多客户那里。

companies.name: Armorer Labs
companies.originalOneLiner: Continuous security verification for AI systems in regulated…
companies.originalDescription: Armorer helps companies in regulated industries ship their own AI systems faster and keep them secure in production. Most security tools flag an issue and file a ticket. Armorer assesses your agent and simulates attacks to find the real issues. Then it creates a verified fix that stops the attack without breaking the business, ready for your approval in about 4 hours. In production, Armorer checks every agent action in milliseconds, with no GPU needed. It detects malicious behavior such as prompt injection, goal hijacking and data leaks, then allows, holds or denies the action. Armorer's detection models beat every other detector we tested on six public benchmarks. Armorer is 22% more accurate than JEV while being 88x faster, so users won't feel the delay. We spent years building and evaluating AI security systems together at AWS, including its first customer-facing AI security agent, which scaled to 100k+ customers. Armorer is backed by Paul Vixie, an internet pioneer inducted into the Internet Hall of Fame in 2014.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是面向受监管行业的人工智能安全验证。如果你负责一家金融机构的智能体上线，最怕的不是模型答错一句话，而是它在生产环境里被提示注入劫持、偷偷泄露数据，而传统安全工具只会开一张工单让你自己查。Armorer 会先评估智能体并模拟攻击，找出真正能被利用的问题，再生成经过验证的修复方案，大约四小时就能交给你审批。上线后它逐次检查智能体的每个动作，毫秒级判断放行、拦截还是挂起，不需要 GPU。团队称其检测模型在六项公开基准上优于其他检测器，比 JEV 准确率高百分之二十二，速度快八十八倍。它来自 YC 秋季 2026 批次，团队两人。

companies.name: Agency Tool Company
companies.originalOneLiner: Reliable infrastructure to build, deploy and manage real-world robots.
companies.originalDescription: Agency Tool Company ships software to robots in the field 20x faster than a Docker pull with ATC Deploy, sending only the bytes that changed and resuming when the network drops. Deployment tooling is the connection between the lab & the field that continually bottlenecks robotics scaling and lacks a strong robotics-native solution. Deploy is live today with 3 launch partners across ag, construction, and logistics robotics. Our second product, ATC Build, offers embedded-compute as a CI service so devs can run tests and validate their software on the actual target hardware. Build supports the Nvidia Jetson lineup, Raspberry Pi, and a number of other embedded platform targets. Jack Morrison and Davis Foster founded and sold Scythe Robotics after deploying hundreds of autonomous mowers across the country; Agency Tool Company is building the robotics deployment platform across hardware and software they wish they had. Learn more at https://agencytool.com
companies.story: 这家公司做的是机器人部署的基础设施，让软件能可靠地送到野外作业的机器上。假如你是一家农业机器人公司的工程负责人，实验室里跑通的模型要推到全国各地的设备上，网络时断时续，一次完整镜像拉取慢得让人绝望。Agency Tool Company 的部署产品只传输发生变化的字节，断网后还能续传，官方称比 Docker 拉取快二十倍，目前已有三个农业、建筑和物流机器人领域的合作方在用。它的第二个产品把嵌入式硬件的编译测试做成持续集成服务，支持英伟达 Jetson 系列和树莓派等平台。两位创始人此前创办并出售过 Scythe Robotics，在全国部署过数百台自主割草机，这个背景让机器人部署这件事显得格外具体。它来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队三人。

companies.name: Taiga
companies.originalOneLiner: Autonomous medical billing
companies.originalDescription: Taiga automates medical billing for doctor's offices. A doctor uploads their visit data, our AI figures out the right billing codes, checks the claim for errors, and submits it to insurance, dealing with any denials. Faster billing, fewer rejected claims, less busywork. We're Nanda and Adam, friends since 3rd grade. Both of our parents are doctors with their own practices, and billing was always a source of stress and lost revenue for them. We want providers to treat patients while we handle the rest.
companies.story: 这是做医疗账单自动化的公司，帮医生诊所处理保险报销。如果你是一家小诊所的运营负责人，医生看完病人，剩下的编码、核对、提交和应对拒付全压在你身上，一个编码选错就是一笔收入打水漂。Taiga 让医生上传就诊数据，系统判断正确的账单编码，检查理赔有没有错误，再提交给保险公司，遇到拒付也由它处理。它想解决的是报销更慢、拒付更多、杂事更重这三件事。两位创始人从小是朋友，父母都经营自己的诊所，账单一直是家里的压力来源，这个出发点让产品场景显得很真实。它来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队两人，正在招聘。

companies.name: Harper
companies.originalOneLiner: AI-native commercial insurance brokerage
companies.originalDescription: At Harper, we are building a fully autonomous commercial insurance brokerage powered by AI. Our initial focus is on mid-sized businesses with complex insurance needs, but our vision is to eventually serve every business in the country. By leveraging AI to automate key workflows in the insurance process, we efficiently secure optimal coverage for each client's unique requirements at competitive prices and with rapid turnaround. Our AI system learns from the expertise of our brokers, accumulating not just knowledge but also the specific workflows, data, and capabilities that pave the way to full autonomy.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是人工智能驱动的商业保险经纪。想象你是一家中型企业的财务负责人，公司业务复杂，保险需求零散又专业，找经纪公司报价要等很久，条款还未必贴合实际风险。Harper 想用人工智能把保险流程里的关键环节自动化，先服务保险需求复杂的中型企业，再逐步扩展到更多企业，目标是更快、更便宜地拿到合适的保障。它的系统会从经纪人的专业判断里学习，不只积累知识，也积累具体的工作流和数据，朝完全自主的方向走。它来自 YC 冬季 2025 批次，团队二十五人，正在招聘，规模和招聘动作说明它已经在真实业务里跑起来了。

companies.name: Perseus Defense
companies.originalOneLiner: America's Golden Dome for Drones
companies.originalDescription: Perseus Defense is building a mass-manufactured Counter UAS solution for the Department of Defense and Department of Homeland Security. Current solutions are one-to-one, too dangerous for use on U.S. soil, and orders of magntiude more expensive than the threats they defeat. Our self-guided missile platform is man-portable and multi-domain capable. It senses, engages, and eliminates threats with drastically reduced cost per engagement over existing kinetic solutions. Solving this critical national security problem requires understanding complex DoD needs along with actual rocket science including aerodynamics, guidance, navigation, control, and much more. Jason and Steve met at Penn State while they pursued their PhD and MS in aerospace engineering, respectively. Their past experiences designing space helicopters for NASA, making Boeing airliners land autonomously, controlling swarms of unmanned autonomous systems, teaching aerospace engineering at Stanford, winning multiple ONR and DOE engineering competitions, and founding an international drone competition makes them the perfect team to create transformative solutions protecting our service members. "If you build this, it will be mandatory equipment for every truck, boat, and convoy in the U.S. Military. We're talking thousands of units." - Former DoD Procurement Officer The White House just released Executive Order, "Unleashing American Drone Dominance" which adds billions of dollars, government support, and streamlined regulations to enable the development of our product. Traction: Jason and Steve used more than 100 end-user interviews across the DoD and DHS to shape the product to something of critical need to both boots on the ground and DoD purchasers. In 8 short weeks following a strict 2-week design-build-test cycle, the team has gone through 4 major guided missile iterations with over 30 live-fire flight tests. They were invited to Ft. Hood to present their platform to the 1st Cavalry Division, and also briefed the Pentagon and U.S. congressmen on current U.S. vulnerabilities to advanced drone technology. Perseus Defense is actively standing up cooperative research agreements with U.S. Army DEVCOM's Applied Research Laboratory, Aviation and Missile Center, Armaments Center, and High Performance Computing Modernization Program.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是反无人机防御，面向美国国防部和国土安全部。假如你是一个前线小队的负责人，头顶出现敌方无人机，现有手段要么一对一拦截、成本高得离谱，要么危险到不适合在美国本土使用。Perseus Defense 在做可单兵携带、多域适用的自引导拦截弹，能感知、交战并消灭威胁，单次交战的成本比现有动能方案低得多。这件事难在既要理解国防部的复杂需求，又要真的懂空气动力学、制导、导航与控制这些火箭科学。两位创始人在宾夕法尼亚州立大学读航空航天博士和硕士时相识，此前做过为 NASA 设计太空直升机、让波音客机自主降落、控制无人机集群等工作。它来自 YC 夏季 2025 批次，团队三人，正在招聘。

companies.name: Kimpton
companies.location: New York City, NY, USA; Remote
companies.originalOneLiner: Live Evaluation Arenas for Financial Work
companies.originalDescription: In investment management, every decision gets graded. The market prints the answer on a date known in advance, and nobody gets to argue with it. Kimpton is financial AI that answers to reality. Kimpton OS is the AI-native operating system for investment teams: it does the research and hands PMs structured trades. EarningsBench is a public benchmark where models forecast quarterly earnings before companies report and the reported numbers do the scoring. Koliseum is the set of point-in-time financial environments we build from that work, for labs to train and evaluate models on. The whole industry is fighting underperformance. Active managers trail their benchmarks, and capital keeps bleeding into passive. AI was supposed to fix that, but it hasn't. Funds either stitch together a dozen point tools or babysit general agents all day, and neither gets them to the trade. Kimpton OS goes straight to it. It ingests a fund's mandate, strategy, and positions, connects to the institutional data the fund already runs on, and returns a structured trade proposal built for that fund. It's built to disagree, because consensus is poison for investment decisions. Instead of telling a PM what they want to hear, it surfaces the breaches and risks they'd otherwise miss. That same work is how we grade AI. Static benchmarks leak into training data. Simulations reward what their authors imagined. A forecast sealed before the outcome exists and scored when the company reports can't be rehearsed or backdated. We started in markets because they're the one place reality answers on schedule. We're two ex-Goldman engineers and an ex-SpaceX engineer. We left to start our own quantitative systematic hedge fund, raised $10M from a family office at 21 and 22, and scaled it to $35M over four years. We learned to trust live results over historical fit. We built Kimpton inside that fund, then productized the stack. We're live with our first institutional client, a $3.3B manager. Our first market is fundamental equity funds from $1B to $10B, and the labs that need to know whether their models can do this work.
companies.story: 这家公司切的是投资管理的人工智能工作台，让模型的研究结论接受市场打分。如果你是一名投资经理，每天早上要在十几个工具之间来回切换，或者盯着一个通用智能体等它给出结论，最后还是要自己拼出交易。Kimpton 的操作系统替团队做研究，直接把结构化的交易交到你手上。它还有一个公开基准，让模型在公司发布财报前预测季度盈利，再用真实数字评分，并据此构建带时间点的金融环境供实验室训练和评估模型。整个行业都在为跑不赢基准发愁，主动管理资金持续流向被动产品，而人工智能至今没有真正解决这个问题，这正是它值得看的地方。它来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队五人。

companies.name: Volaren
companies.originalOneLiner: The personal investing agent that comes to you
companies.originalDescription: Volaren is the personal investing agent that comes to you. It knows why your portfolio moved, suggests your next idea, and trades it for you. Connect your bank accounts & brokerage and Volaren tells you what changed and why, answers any question about your money, and turns any idea into a trade. You can copy the moves of famous investors, politicians, proven strategies and themed baskets in a tap, or set up your own AI agents to watch the market and act within the limits you choose. Everything works from the app, the web or a simple text, so managing your money feels like texting a portfolio manager who never sleeps.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是个人投资智能体，把管钱这件事搬到聊天和手机里。想象你是一个平时忙到没空看盘的上班族，账户里有一笔钱，你想知道组合为什么涨跌，也想跟着某个知名投资者的动作走，但打开券商应用就头大。Volaren 让你连上银行和券商账户，告诉你发生了什么、为什么发生，回答你关于钱的任何问题，还能把一个想法直接变成一笔交易。你可以一键复制知名投资者、政治人物、成熟策略或主题组合的仓位，也可以设置自己的人工智能体在限定范围内盯盘并行动。整个体验通过应用、网页或一条短信完成，像在给一个不睡觉的基金经理发消息。它来自 YC 秋季 2026 批次，团队四人，正在招聘。

companies.name: Earendil Robotics
companies.originalOneLiner: Drone swarm defence at a small-unit level
companies.originalDescription: Earendil Robotics builds cUAS solutions for the modern warfighter, enabling effective air defence at the small-unit level. We deliver spotting, engaging, and destroying capabilities through advanced sensors, autonomous interceptors, and integrated systems. Our product lineup covers every stage of the kill chain, complemented by the Drone Warfare Academy that trains soldiers to eliminate enemy drone threats in contested environments. Backed by worldwide frontline combat experience, we equip units with combat-proven tools to counter evolving aerial threats.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是小单位级别的无人机集群防御，服务现代战场上的士兵。如果你是一名步兵班组的指挥员，敌方无人机在头顶盘旋，你手里没有能同时发现、拦截和摧毁它的成套手段。Earendil Robotics 用先进传感器、自主拦截器和集成系统覆盖杀伤链的每个环节，还办了一所无人机作战学院，训练士兵在对抗环境中消除敌方无人机威胁。它的特点是能力落在传感器、拦截器和随身装备上，而不是一个手机应用，这意味着它要面对真实的空中对抗场景。团队称其方案有全球前线实战经验支撑，这在防御类硬件里是很少见的信号。它来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队七人。

readings.title: Show HN: Bwat turns what's said in Zoom meetings into todos for your agents
readings.story: 开会时大家聊得热闹，散会后却没人记得谁答应了什么，这几乎是每个团队都遇到过的尴尬。于是有人开始尝试让工具自动把会议里说过的话变成待办事项，甚至直接交给 人工智能 助手去跟进。这条在技术社区被讨论的项目就落在这个方向上，值得读，是因为它让人看到工程师正在怎么处理这个老问题。读的时候可以留意作者把会议内容拆成任务时做了哪些取舍，比如哪些话算承诺、哪些只是讨论，以及他如何判断一个待办该交给谁。

readings.title: Jensen Huang and the End of the Founder Fairy Tale
readings.story: 我们习惯听到创始人白手起家、凭一己之力改变行业的故事，但现实里的公司往往不是这样长起来的。当一家芯片公司被推到人工智能浪潮的中心，人们又开始追问：到底是谁在掌舵，故事该怎么讲。这篇来自 WIRED Business 的文章值得读，是因为它把注意力放在创始人神话本身，而不只是某家公司。读的时候可以看作者如何拆解这种叙事，哪些细节被放大、哪些被省略，以及他怎样判断一个传奇故事和真实经营之间的差距。

readings.title: 5 Interesting Learnings from Palantir at $9.3 Billion Run-Rate: 96% Growth, 165% NRR, and U.S. Commercial Passing Government for the First Time
readings.story: 做企业软件的人常常好奇，一家公司要长到多大，才不再只靠政府或大客户吃饭。当一家以政府项目起家的公司开始在美国商业客户上超过政府收入，这个转折点就变得值得琢磨。这篇来自 SaaStr 的文章值得读，是因为它把一个增长故事拆成几个可以对照自己公司的观察点。读的时候可以留意作者怎么解释高速增长和客户续约之间的关系，以及他如何从数字里判断哪些变化是暂时的、哪些可能改变公司接下来的打法。

companies.name: Voltair
companies.originalOneLiner: Autonomous Drones for Earth Observation
companies.originalDescription: Voltair is building the world's first globally distributed network of autonomous drones for Earth observation. Power utilities are the perfect first customer. Aging infrastructure and extreme weather drive the need for millimeter-scale inspection data on the power grid. Utilities spend tens of billions of dollars every year just looking at their own equipment. Autonomous drone fleets will enable utilities to inspect 7 million miles of infrastructure more frequently, quickly, and accurately. Our long-range, weatherized flying robots work with charging pads installed directly on utility poles. Each new pad unlocks 1000 square miles of coverage. With a charging network deployed on the power grid, we can serve existing multi-billion dollar data markets in road, rail and telecom inspection at 10x lower prices while enabling entirely new applications in hyperlocal weather monitoring, forestry, construction, search & rescue, and insurance. We envision a future in which drone "instances" are requested on-demand through our platform, enabling any application builder to serve these critical markets without ever operating their own hardware.
companies.story: 这是做自主无人机与地球观测基础设施的公司。如果你负责一家电力公司的电网巡检，每天要面对上百万英里线路和极端天气后的排查压力，靠人工和少量飞行器根本看不过来。Voltair 把长航程、耐候的无人机和直接装在电线杆上的充电垫配成一张网，每个新充电垫能解锁上千平方英里的覆盖范围，让巡检更频繁、更快也更准。它来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，团队五人，正在招聘，值得关注的是它先切电力行业这个愿意花大钱看自己设备的客户，再往道路、铁路和电信巡检延伸。

companies.name: Locus
companies.originalOneLiner: Payment infrastructure for AI agents
companies.originalDescription: We make your agents pay. As agents evolve from tools into dependable, autonomous actors, they’ll need the ability to execute open-ended workflows end-to-end. This inevitably means payments: accessing paywalled data, transacting for services or with other specialist agents. But autonomy requires guardrails. Businesses and developers will need a way to ensure their agents only spend how much and on what they’re supposed to. The machine economy is coming, and Locus (YC F25) is building the connector businesses will need to participate. We connect agents securely to funds, letting you define permissions and limits for every transaction. Each payment is traceable, auditable, and fully reconcilable with your existing financial stack.
companies.story: 这家公司切的是智能体的支付基础设施。想象你是一名负责把智能体接入业务流程的开发者，智能体要访问付费数据、购买服务或者和别的专业智能体交易，你却没法放心让它自己花钱。Locus 把智能体安全地连接到资金，让你为每笔交易设定权限和额度，每笔支付都可追踪、可审计，并能和现有财务系统对账。它来自 YC 秋季 2025 批次，团队两人，方向是让人工智能代理在开放流程里真正跑完端到端任务，而支付正是绕不开的一环，这个场景本身值得看。

companies.name: Spacesheep
companies.originalOneLiner: Documents of the future: the collaboration surface for people and…
companies.originalDescription: Agents now write faster than anyone can read. Spacesheep is where their work lands: any agent turns a session's output into a space that your team takes in at a glance. It works with the agents you already use, and has its own agent built in. Teams work on it together: comment on the exact spot, @mention a teammate, or ask @spacesheep and an agent makes the change live on every screen. Every change is a version, and every space is searchable by meaning, for people and agents alike. Spaces can show live data streamed from servers and sensors, and connect to the tools your team already uses. Teams use it for research, design docs, dashboards, slides and internal apps.
companies.story: 这是做团队协作文档与智能体输出落地的公司。如果你是一名研究员，智能体几分钟就写完一份材料，可团队没人读得完，讨论还散落在聊天记录里。Spacesheep 把任何智能体一次会话的输出变成一个空间，团队一眼就能看明白，还能在具体位置评论、@ 同事，或者让内置智能体当场改到所有人的屏幕上。每次改动都是一个版本，每个空间都能按语义搜索，人和智能体都适用。它来自 YC 秋季 2026 批次，团队两人，值得看的是它把智能体产出变成团队共同工作的界面，而不只是又一个聊天窗口。

companies.name: Paradev (formerly Superset)
companies.originalOneLiner: Building self-improving software
companies.originalDescription: Paradev (formerly Superset) is an open-source IDE that helps engineers run 100s of coding agents in parallel. Our desktop app is loved by tens of thousands of engineers, and we're scaling out our effort to build a collaborative, cross-platform tool to allow users to code anywhere.
companies.story: 这是做开发者工具的公司，方向是让软件自己越用越好。假如你是一名工程负责人，手头同时跑着几十个编码智能体，光切换和协调就够呛。Paradev 原名 Superset，是一个开源集成开发环境，帮工程师并行运行上百个编码智能体，桌面应用已经有不少工程师在用，团队正在把它扩展成跨平台、可协作的工具，让人在任何地方写代码。它来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队四人，正在招聘，值得关注的是它已经在真实工程师群体里获得使用，并继续往协作场景推进。

companies.name: Insurf
companies.originalOneLiner: The AI-Native Decision Layer for Health Insurance
companies.originalDescription: Insurf is the AI-native data and decision layer for health insurance. Our model Surely identifies the lowest-cost coverage for anyone, saving individuals, families, and companies thousands per employee. Our product Inveto collects the data from hospitals and clinics that informs Surely.
companies.story: 这家公司切的是健康保险的决策层。如果你负责一家公司的员工福利，每年续保时面对一堆方案和不断上涨的保费，很难判断哪个组合对员工和公司都最省钱。Insurf 用人工智能做数据和决策层，旗下 Surely 能为个人、家庭和公司找出成本最低的保障，另一款产品 Inveto 负责从医院和诊所收集数据来支撑判断。它来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队三人，值得看的是它把保险选择从比价表格变成有数据支撑的决策，直接落在每个员工的钱包上。

companies.name: MorphoAI
companies.originalOneLiner: Software tool for designing robots and machines
companies.originalDescription: MorphoAI builds hardware foundation models for mechanical engineering. Our GPU-accelerated design models that let engineers generate and explore hundreds of complete mechanical assembly designs in minutes, accelerating the invention of new hardware. Our models learns from a company’s prior CAD designs and generate editable assemblies from engineering requirements, incorporating standard and custom components and manufacturing constraints. This enables companies to design and ship the next generation of their hardware faster and better than competition. The models can generate assemblies with up to 500 parts in minutes, including a full bill of materials. Engineers can explore 100s of design options at the beginning of a project and refine and validate the outputs within their existing CAD. MorphoAI’s technology builds on research conducted by its team at MIT and Harvard, with support from ARIA, the UK’s Advanced Research and Invention Agency with a GBP 2.5M grant. Its customer list includes companies like ABB and other large OEMs in robotics and automation, electric, power and grid, consumer electronics, and industrial equipment. Ayna and Andy, the co-founders, met during their time at Harvard and started this in 2024. Our founding team is built of a prof. of ECE and robotics at Carnegie Mellon, Forbes u30 serial hardware entrepreneur, and an ex. Amazon Robotics scientist. Between them, they have written 65+ papers on algorithms for hardware design during their PhDs at Harvard and MIT. The team at large holds PhDs from Imperial, TU Wein, UCL and has worked across computational geometry, computer vision, ML, optimization, simulation, and the CAD space.
companies.story: 这是做机械工程设计与机器人硬件的软件公司。想象你是一名机械工程师，项目刚开始就要在几周内拿出几套完整装配方案，还得兼顾标准件、定制件和制造约束。MorphoAI 用加速的设计模型，从公司过往的计算机辅助设计里学习，按工程需求在几分钟内生成可编辑的装配体，最多五百个零件，还带完整物料清单，工程师能在现有设计软件里继续细化和验证。它来自 YC 春季 2025 批次，团队十二人，正在招聘，技术基于团队在麻省理工和哈佛的研究，值得关注的是它把生成式能力放进了硬件发明的早期阶段。

companies.name: Rhem Labs
companies.originalDescription: Rhem Labs builds smart home care devices that help older adults and people with complex care needs live independently.
companies.story: 这是做智能家居护理设备的公司，面向老年人和有复杂照护需求的人。如果你是一位要照顾年迈父母的子女，白天上班时总担心家里老人有没有按时起身、吃药或者遇到意外。Rhem Labs 把能力放进家里的设备和传感器里，而不是只做一个手机应用，让照护发生在真实生活场景中，帮助老人更独立地生活。它来自 YC 秋季 2026 批次，团队两人，正在招聘，值得看的是它切入的是居家照护这个既具体又长期存在的麻烦，硬件形态决定了它能感知手机看不到的事情。

companies.name: One Robot
companies.originalOneLiner: World models for robot evals and training.
companies.originalDescription: One Robot builds simulation environments that are realistic to see and realistic to interact with, so robotics teams can train and evaluate robot policies without being bottlenecked by robot time. Today, improving a VLA often means more real-world hours: setting up the scene, running trials, resetting, and repeating. This loop is slow, expensive, and hard to scale. For example, material handling and manufacturing assembly tasks, models need far more training and evaluation data than teams can collect in the real world.
