We use task-specific data to build world model-based simulation environments for hard manipulation tasks (for example, textiles and box folding). These environments help teams run more training and evals, find failure modes faster, and accelerate iteration on action policies with less dependence on real-world data collection and robot availability.
companies.story: 这是做机器人训练与评测仿真环境的公司。如果你在机器人团队负责训练操作策略，最头疼的是真实机器人时间不够用，摆场景、跑试验、复位再重复，一圈下来又慢又贵。One Robot 用任务数据构建基于世界模型的仿真环境，看得真实、交互也真实，专门针对布料处理、折箱子这类难操作任务，让团队多跑训练和评测，更快找到失败模式。它来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，团队两人，正在招聘，值得看的是它把机器人迭代的瓶颈从真机时间挪到仿真里，减少对现实数据采集的依赖。

companies.name: Clara
companies.originalOneLiner: AI primary care doctor
companies.originalDescription: Clara is an AI primary care and longevity practice from the team that founded and grew Circle Medical to $100M in revenue. Our mission at Clara is to add one billion years of healthspan to humanity. We do this with an AI with deep clinical knowledge, coupled with the ability to sift through medical data to detect trends and patterns that could be missed. Unlike Claude or ChatGPT, Clara can see your medical data and then act. Chat with Clara as you would a doctor and Clara can help with you make sense of symptoms, get medication refills, order and understand labs, and achieve health goals. Medical recommendations are preliminary until one of our human medical providers in the loop reviews and approves them.
companies.story: 这是做人工智能初级诊疗与长寿实践的公司。假如你最近总觉得疲惫，想弄明白症状、续个药或者看懂体检报告，却约不到医生或者要等很久。Clara 能像医生一样和你对话，看到你的医疗数据并据此行动，帮你理清症状、续药、安排并解读化验，朝着健康目标推进，所有建议在人类医疗提供者审核批准前都只是初步意见。它来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队九人，正在招聘，背后是曾创办并增长 Circle Medical 的团队，值得关注的是它让人工智能不只是回答问题，而是能接触数据并采取行动。

companies.name: Axis
companies.originalOneLiner: An AI Copilot for Trading Desks
companies.originalDescription: Axis is building an AI Native Trading System, allowing a trader to deploy models that monitor and analyze relevant markets and strategies. We've chosen commodities as our first market. Commodities make up a third of global goods exports, and physical commodities traders decide the movement and storage of metals, agricultural products, and energy across the globe. They trade in public markets and bilateral OTC agreements. Engaging in these markets is complexing, covering derivatives positioning, refinery data, storage inventory, import/exports, geopolitical events and more. Axis is building an AI driven analytical layer for these markets.
companies.story: 这家公司切的是交易台的智能助手。想象你是一名大宗商品交易员，每天要盯衍生品持仓、炼厂数据、库存、进出口和地缘事件，信息散在各处，判断靠人拼。Axis 在做人工智能原生的交易系统，让交易员部署模型去监控和分析相关市场与策略，先选大宗商品作为第一个市场。它来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，团队两人，值得看的是大宗商品占全球货物出口的三分之一，这个分析层面对的是真实且复杂的决策场景。

readings.title: FreeBSD Developer AI Survey Results
readings.story: 一个开源项目里，维护者往往是最先被新工具冲击的人：他们既要判断要不要接受外部贡献，又要担心自己熟悉的节奏被改变。当 人工智能 编程助手进入日常开发，这种犹豫会变得具体，比如某段代码到底是谁写的，出了问题该找谁。这篇调查把 FreeBSD 开发者对 人工智能 的真实态度摆了出来，值得读，因为社区里的分歧通常比产品发布会更早暴露问题。读的时候可以留意作者怎么设计问题、怎么区分不同岗位的回答，以及哪些担忧反复出现却没人给出解法。

readings.title: How do you hire a human? Q&A with Tom Harvey, Stack Overflow technical recruiter
readings.story: 很多团队在招人时都会遇到同一个问题：简历看起来都差不多，面试聊得也不错，可真正入职后才发现彼此期待并不一致。尤其是技术岗位，招聘方要在有限时间里判断一个人能不能合作、愿不愿意学、遇到问题会怎么处理，这些都不容易写进职位描述。这篇问答值得读，是因为它从一个长期做技术招聘的人的角度，讲他实际怎么判断候选人，而不是只给一份通用清单。读的时候可以留意他如何拆解招聘流程里真正卡住的地方：是需求没想清楚，还是面试问题问偏了，以及他如何看待经验与潜力之间的取舍。

readings.title: Whoop just launched a social network
readings.story: 做硬件或健康产品的团队，常常会在某个阶段冒出一个念头：用户每天都在用我们的设备，为什么不让他们彼此看见、互相比较。这个念头听起来顺理成章，但真要做成社交功能，问题就来了：用户愿意分享哪些数据，分享之后关系怎么建立，原来的产品节奏会不会被打乱。这篇报道值得读，是因为它记录了一家做可穿戴设备的公司真的迈出了这一步，而不是停留在设想。读的时候可以看作者如何呈现这个决定的背景，以及产品从个人工具走向人与人连接时，哪些取舍被摆上了台面。

companies.name: Replicas
companies.originalOneLiner: Run any coding agent harness in the cloud
companies.originalDescription: Replicas is a cloud coding agent that allows you to delegate tasks to Claude Code or Codex from the app, Slack, Linear, and more. Each task works inside of a sandboxed virtual machine, allowing teams to heavily parallelize work and burn through tickets. Replicas agents output higher quality PRs via feedback loops - each task automatically is notified and fixes CI failures and reads all code reviews. With Environments, engineering teams can configure agents to run their entire codebase locally, verify its work, and provide preview URLs.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是云端编程智能体的运行环境。假如你是一名工程负责人，早上打开任务列表，发现积压了几十个待修的问题和功能单，却没有人手逐个处理。Replicas 让你把任务直接派给 Claude Code 或 Codex，每个任务都在独立的虚拟机沙箱里运行，团队可以大规模并行推进。智能体会自动收到失败通知并修复持续集成的问题，还会读取代码评审意见，从而交出质量更高的合并请求。工程团队可以配置环境，让智能体在本地跑通整个代码库、验证结果并给出预览链接。它来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队只有两人且正在招聘，适合关注编程自动化落地方式的人留意。

companies.name: Multiplier
companies.originalOneLiner: Agent harnesses for asset managers
companies.originalDescription: Multiplier helps institutional investors research stocks and manage their portfolios. We're live with six hedge funds, and our users spend 4+ hours a day in the platform. Investors who try "nearly every tool on the market," to quote a client of ours, "wind up with an unwieldy collection of fragmented point solutions." Those who focus on building a great setup with general agents are instead "signing up for a full-time job." So we deploy a platform called Multiplier that unifies structured data, unstructured data, AI work, human work, and tacit firm knowledge in one secure, governed, customized application. Our first vertical: independent equity funds with $250M-$5B of assets. They know AI is essential for staying relevant, but they don't have the time or talent to figure out what to do about it. But once we deploy Multiplier––"We used to spend 80% of our time gathering information and 20% of our time acting on it," said one customer. "Multiplier has flipped those percentages."
companies.story: 这家公司切的是资产管理机构的研究与组合管理工具。想象你是一位独立股票基金的分析师，每天要在结构化数据、零散文档和公司内部经验之间来回翻找，真正用于判断的时间被大量挤占。Multiplier 把结构化数据、非结构化数据、人工智能工作、人工工作和机构内部积累的知识放进一个安全可控、按需定制的应用里。它目前已在六家对冲基金投入使用，用户每天在平台上停留四小时以上。公司先聚焦管理规模在 2.5 亿到 50 亿美元之间的独立股票基金，这类机构知道人工智能重要，却没有时间和人才去搭建。它来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队三人且正在招聘。

companies.name: Robby
companies.originalOneLiner: AI agents that grow revenue for home services businesses
companies.originalDescription: Robby is an AI growth engine for home services businesses that uncovers revenue opportunities and collects additional data from every technician visit. Our AI combines customer and third party data to generate dozens of new leads every day, and then arms the technicians with talking points to increase close rates, giving GMs a single command center to manage and drive revenue. We have several paying customers that are each uncovering 6 figures in additional revenue opportunities every week. On our first day of launch, we helped close $40k in new business within an hour. Our team has spent the last few months riding along with dozens of technicians and shadowing every position in the office to best understand the industry. We're also studying for the EPA 608 exam to become certified technicians ourselves. Vineet and Feroze have both built critical products and infra at prominent startups (Ironclad, Porter, Affinity, Uber, Cloud Health Systems). Joe previously consulted PE firms on software acquisitions and led home services growth projects at Bain. We all met at Harvard Business School, and dropped out to work on Robby full-time.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是面向家庭服务企业的人工智能增收工具。如果你是一家家政或维修公司的总经理，每天最头疼的是线索不够、技术员上门后成交率上不去，而每次上门收集的信息又白白流失。Robby 把客户数据和第三方数据结合起来，每天生成数十条新线索，再给技术员准备话术以提高成交率，让管理者在一个指挥中心里掌握并推动收入。它已有数家付费客户，每家每周能发现六位数的额外收入机会，上线首日曾在一小时内促成四万美元新业务。团队花了几个月跟随技术员上门、旁听办公室每个岗位，还在备考相关认证。它来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，团队三人且正在招聘。

companies.name: Hub Labs
companies.originalOneLiner: Deployment and data infrastructure for Embodied AI.
companies.originalDescription: Hub deploys hardware and embodied machines to collect data for robotics labs, to produce labor output for real world businesses.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是具身智能的部署与数据基础设施。想象你是一家机器人实验室的研究员，模型训练最缺的不是算力，而是真实世界里多样、持续、带场景的机器操作数据。Hub Labs 把硬件和具身机器部署到真实场所，一边为机器人实验室采集数据，一边为现实中的企业产出实际劳动。这种把设备放到现场的做法，意味着它不只是软件层面的数据平台，而是把采集能力装进机器、放进真实工作场景。它来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队已有五十人且正在招聘，规模在早期公司里不算小，值得关注它如何把数据采集和真实业务需求绑在一起。

companies.name: Revise Robotics
companies.originalOneLiner: Automating refurbishment of $1T in consumer electronics
companies.originalDescription: E-waste recycling facilities spend most of their time and effort sifting through discarded electronics, searching for valuable devices, refurbishing them, and reselling them in second-hand markets. Our first product is an AI-enabled robotic system that integrates with these facilities to assess and refurbish hundreds of laptops a day without any human intervention. The system tests laptops, wipes their hard drives, photographs them, and posts them on online marketplaces for resale, regardless of model, manufacturer, or operating system.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是消费电子翻新的机器人自动化。假如你是一家电子废弃物回收厂的负责人，每天面对成堆的旧设备，工人要一件件翻找有价值的机器，再测试、清空硬盘、拍照、上架，流程又慢又依赖人手。Revise Robotics 的第一款产品是一套带人工智能的机器人系统，接入回收厂后每天可无人干预地评估和翻新数百台笔记本电脑，不论品牌、厂商或操作系统，都能完成测试、擦除硬盘、拍照并发布到二手市场转售。它切的是规模巨大的电子废弃物与二手电子市场，来自 YC 冬季 2025 批次，团队三人且正在招聘，适合关注循环经济与机器人落地结合的人。

companies.name: Nori
companies.originalOneLiner: The most capable American-made humanoid robot for $1,688
companies.originalDescription: We manufacture Nori: A sub-$2000 bimanual mobile manipulator that can clean rooms, restock shelves, and fold clothes. Nori can handle basic tasks out of the box, and its software lets anyone teach Nori to automate work specific to their home or business. Nori aims to solve the robotics data bottleneck. By deploying affordable robots to customers around the world, we can gather the diverse data required to train the next generation of generalist robotic policies. Every user of Nori makes Nori smarter. Since launching 6 weeks ago we have already deployed our first robot and have over $440k+ in sales. We can bring general-purpose robotics to homes and businesses that could never afford it before. There are 132.7 million households and 8.4 million employer business locations in the U.S. At $1,688 per robot, selling just one Nori to 0.5% of them represents a $1.2B market opportunity in the U.S. alone.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是美国制造的人形机器人硬件。如果你经营一家小型仓库或民宿，想找人帮忙整理货架、打扫房间、叠衣服，却请不起动辄数万美元的机器人，Nori 就是冲着这个场景来的。它是一台售价 1688 美元的双臂移动操作机器人，开箱即可完成基础任务，软件还允许任何人教它自动化自己家里或生意里的特定工作。它不是手机应用，而是把感知和操作能力放进设备本身，因此能在真实空间里动手做事。公司希望靠大量部署收集多样数据，训练下一代通用机器人策略，每个用户都在让 Nori 变聪明。上线六周已交付首台机器人，销售额超过 44 万美元，来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队五人且正在招聘。

companies.name: Illume Labs
companies.originalOneLiner: 24/7 Personal Health & Longevity Companion
companies.originalDescription: Illume is a 24/7 AI personal health & longevity companion that connects your wearables, blood panels, and genomic data to text you personalized and actionable insights. We pull in your health data and fuse it into one secure model. You get daily text updates on what changed, what it means, and what to do next; conversational health Q&A like "What should I do to improve my bloodwork?"; cross-data trend detection that catches patterns individual platforms miss; and a full platform to dig deeper, explore your health data, and text your Illume agent anytime. We're 3 MIT grads & friends, with experience at Windsurf, MIT CSAIL, Eli Lilly, & the Broad Institute.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是个人健康与长寿管理服务。如果你是一位很在意健康数据的人，手上戴着可穿戴设备，刚做完血液检测和基因检测，却面对一堆分散的报告不知道从哪看起。Illume Labs 把这些数据接入并融合成一个安全模型，每天用短信告诉你哪些指标变了、意味着什么、下一步该做什么，还能像聊天一样问它如何改善血液指标，并发现单个平台容易漏掉的跨数据趋势。它不只是手机应用，而是把可穿戴设备、化验和基因信息串成随身可用的健康助手。团队是三位麻省理工学院的毕业生和朋友，曾在相关公司和研究机构工作，来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队三人。

companies.name: Amera
companies.originalOneLiner: Automating claims processing workflows for health insurance payers.
companies.originalDescription: Amera automates claims processing for health insurance payers. We turn messy claim inputs (PDFs, bills, receipts, EDI and non-standard submissions) into structured data that plugs into existing systems. This cuts manual entry and exception handling, speeding up operations and reducing cost. We are already working with payers / plan administrators representing ~100k members, giving them access to more affordable care options.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是健康保险支付方的理赔流程自动化。想象你是一名保险理赔员，桌上堆着格式各异的理赔材料，有 PDF、账单、收据，还有电子数据交换和不合规的提交件，只能一份份手工录入和核对。Amera 把这些杂乱的输入转成结构化数据，直接接入现有系统，减少人工录入和异常处理，让运营更快、成本更低。它目前与代表约十万名会员的支付方和计划管理机构合作，帮助人们获得更可负担的医疗选择。它来自 YC 秋季 2025 批次，团队十二人，暂未招聘，适合关注医疗保险后台效率的人了解。

companies.name: Ordo Labs
companies.originalOneLiner: The AI-native OS for regulated labs
companies.originalDescription: Ordo Labs is bringing AI into regulated labs. In paid pilots with labs in the US and Europe, Ordo cut post-analysis work by 90%+. CROs and CDMOs are a $314.8B industry, but they can't rely on generic AI tools, because every result must be traceable, every system validated, and every change QA-approved. Ordo is the AI-native OS for regulated labs: each lab gets its own deployment built to be validated, every output links back to its source data, and scientists and QA sign off on every result. Every workflow on Ordo inherits these controls. Live today: data analysis, quality review and reporting. We're advised by laboratory executives and have interviewed 100+ scientists. Our goal is to make regulated labs AI-native, so science can move at the speed of AI. Run a CRO or CDMO? Email us at founders@ordolabs.ai.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是受监管实验室的人工智能操作系统。如果你是一家合同研究机构的质量负责人，每个实验结果都必须可追溯，每个系统都要经过验证，任何改动都要质量部门批准，通用人工智能工具根本不敢用。Ordo Labs 为每家实验室单独部署可验证的系统，每个输出都能链接回源数据，科学家和质量人员对每个结果签字确认，所有工作流都继承这些控制。它目前在美国和欧洲的实验室做付费试点，后期分析工作量减少九成以上，已上线数据分析、质量评审和报告功能。团队访谈过一百多位科学家，并有实验室高管担任顾问，来自 YC 秋季 2026 批次，团队四人。

companies.name: Fort
companies.originalOneLiner: Strength Tracking Wearable
companies.originalDescription: Fort is a wearable that tracks strength training for people who care about longevity. Other wearables make you manually log every rep, set, and exercise, then provide unhelpful feedback or underestimate strength-related fatigue. We use heart rate and motion data to track your strength workouts for you, then provide thoughtful, actionable feedback that helps you achieve your goals.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是力量训练追踪可穿戴设备。假如你是一位重视长期健康的运动用户，每次训练都要手动记录每一组、每一次和每个动作，练完还得不到有用的反馈，疲劳程度也常被低估。Fort 用心率与动作数据自动追踪你的力量训练，不需要你逐条录入，然后给出可执行、贴合目标的建议。它不是单纯的手机应用，而是把感知能力放进戴在身上的设备里，让力量训练的记录发生在动作本身。它来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，团队四人且正在招聘，适合关注可穿戴设备如何从有氧走向力量训练的人留意。

readings.title: Accelerating product development with AI-driven lifecycle management (AI-PDLC) in AWS Quick
readings.story: 做硬件或实体产品的团队，常常在产品快要上市时才发现问题：需求改了一版，图纸没跟上，供应商拿到的还是旧版本，测试记录散在几个人的表格里。产品从想法走到量产，中间要经过太多人和环节，信息一断就容易返工。这篇讲的是把 人工智能 放进产品全生命周期管理这件事，值得读，是因为它讨论的不是某个单点工具，而是整条链路上信息怎么流动。读的时候可以留意作者如何描述一个产品从设计到交付要跨过哪些环节，以及 人工智能 被放在哪些位置才真正省下时间，而不是只多了一层演示。

readings.title: Flock starts to give campaign cash to local politicians
readings.story: 一个城市在路口和社区装上自动识别车牌的摄像头，最初的理由通常是安全和效率。但时间一长，围绕这些设备的公司开始参与地方政治捐款，事情就变得微妙了：谁在监管这些数据，谁又在影响监管的人。这条在技术社区被讨论，值得读，是因为它把注意力从技术本身移到了技术落地之后的权力关系上。读的时候不妨顺着时间线看，一家设备供应商如何一步步靠近决策者，以及当地居民和议员在什么节点上开始提出疑问，这样更容易看清争议真正卡在哪里。

readings.title: China’s Nvidia Honeypot Isn’t Surprising. Jensen Huang Fell for It Anyway
readings.story: 芯片公司的高管飞到各地谈生意，面对的是复杂的出口限制和各方诉求，这种场合里，热情接待和真实意图往往混在一起。普通人可能觉得这离自己很远，但一家公司如何判断风险、如何取舍市场，最后会影响到整个行业的走向。这篇值得读，是因为它没有停在谁对谁错的层面，而是把一次具体的商业互动摊开来看。读的时候可以注意作者如何还原决策者的视角：他看到了什么信号，忽略了什么信号，以及事后回看时哪些判断本可以更谨慎。

companies.name: Cyberdesk
companies.originalOneLiner: Self learning computer use agent for developers
companies.originalDescription: Cyberdesk is the first self learning computer use agent for developers to automate desktop workflows. For example, one of our customers is building an AI agent for hospital patient intake, and they’re using us to automate an entire team of people manually clicking and typing into a desktop app to book appointments. We launched mid July, and our agent is already operating in production environments, creating appointments in electronic health record apps and processing files in legacy ERPs. We’ve built the first computer use agent that memorizes tasks and repeats them quickly while still adapting to unexpected changes on the screen. A good analogy is to how humans use computers: once we get used to an app, we use it much faster, while still adapting to random popups and crashes. This new paradigm for computer use will be needed by every company automating human workflows on computers. Mahmoud previously built robotic process automation solutions impacting 20K+ employees at a Fortune 100 company. He also built AI & ML solutions at Baylor College of Medicine Neuroscience & Texas Children's Hospital + co-published a paper at the Rice Networks Group. Alan is ex-NASA and previously dropped out to be the first founding engineer at a PearX startup. He is a second time founder, having previously built and scaled a consumer AI app to thousands of paying users. Computer-use agents will automate the $6T dollars spent on enterprise knowledge work and Cyberdesk will be the platform to power this. We’d love to talk with you! https://cal.com/mahmoud-al-madi-klrs5s/30min
companies.story: 这是为开发者做桌面工作流自动化的公司。假如你在一家医院负责患者入院流程，每天要安排一整个团队在旧系统里反复点击和输入来预约，屏幕弹窗和卡顿总让人手忙脚乱。Cyberdesk 的智能体能够记住这些操作步骤，快速重复执行，同时适应屏幕上的意外变化，就像人熟悉软件后操作更快却仍能应对突发情况。它已经在生产环境中运行，在电子健康记录应用里创建预约，并在传统企业管理系统中处理文件。这家公司来自 YC 夏季 2025 批次，团队只有两人，产品于七月中旬发布，这种能记忆并适应变化的计算机使用智能体，正是自动化人工桌面流程所需要的。

companies.name: Autumn
companies.originalOneLiner: The people-intelligence company.
companies.originalDescription: Autumn builds research agents that answer questions about people and companies at scale. These AI agents are powered by a live index of over 1 billion people, 100 million companies, and state-of-the-art web research tools. Autumn is already in production with enterprise teams at Brex, Rippling, PostHog across sourcing, enrichment, and identity-verification workflows. We are a small, highly-technical team. Our vision is to be the search engine that agents use when they need to understand people, their networks, and professional lives.
companies.story: 这家公司切的是人才与公司情报搜索。如果你是一位负责招聘的工程负责人，需要在短时间内摸清某个技术领域里有哪些团队和关键人物，手动搜索往往费时又零散。Autumn 构建的研究智能体可以回答关于人和公司的大规模问题，背后是超过十亿人、一亿家公司的实时索引和先进的网络研究工具。它已经进入 Brex、Rippling、PostHog 等企业团队的生产流程，用于人才搜寻、信息丰富和身份验证。这家公司来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，团队仅四人且正在招聘，它的愿景是成为智能体理解人与职业网络时使用的搜索引擎。

companies.name: Sutrix
companies.originalOneLiner: Deployed AI to turn EHR data into study-ready datasets
companies.originalDescription: Sutrix turns messy data from EHRs, clinical notes, wearables, and surveys into clean, study-ready datasets allowing healthcare research teams to deliver tailored patient care faster. Before a clinical study can start, research staff spend weeks pulling patient data from disconnected systems like the EHR, REDCap, and wearable platforms, reading notes chart by chart, and reconciling conflicting entries in spreadsheets. Sutrix automates that work by deploying AI systems within each team’s own environment, linking patient records across sources, applying the study's rules, and flagging unclear cases for staff to review. Paying research teams at 10+ institutions cut data prep by 80% going from months per study to weeks. We're brothers who've built together for 4 years. We first solved this problem doing forward-deployed work at HSS, where we built an injury surveillance system now used by 700+ teams. Ritvik's clinical research at HSS and Emory showed us every research team has the same bottleneck. Supratik previously founded Kairo (a16z Speedrun, exited) and built production AI agents at Amazon.
companies.story: 这是做医疗研究数据准备的公司。想象你正在一家医院的研究团队工作，一项临床研究启动前，同事要花数周从电子健康记录、临床笔记、可穿戴设备和问卷等互不相通的系统里拉取患者数据，逐份读病历，在表格里核对冲突条目。Sutrix 把人工智能系统部署在团队自己的环境中，跨来源链接患者记录，应用研究规则，并标记不清楚的病例供人工复核，从而把数据准备时间缩短八成，从每项研究数月降到数周。它已经服务十多家机构的研究团队，来自 YC 秋季 2026 批次，团队是两兄弟，此前在 HSS 做前线部署工作时就解决过类似问题。

companies.name: Simantic
companies.originalOneLiner: Firmware simulation for AI agents
companies.originalDescription: Simantic is modernizing the embedded firmware industry with hardware simulation developed for the adoption of AI in hardware engineering. Simantic gives both humans and AI the visibility into hardware previously limited by the physical world.
companies.story: 这是为硬件工程做固件仿真的公司。一个嵌入式工程负责人每天可能遇到这样的麻烦：固件改动要等真实硬件到位才能验证，排队和调试拖慢整个节奏。Simantic 用为人工智能采用而开发的硬件仿真，让人类和智能体都能看到过去被物理世界限制的硬件内部情况。它不只是软件工具，而是把仿真能力放进硬件开发流程，帮助团队在流片或上板之前就发现问题。这家公司来自 YC 秋季 2026 批次，位于加拿大滑铁卢，团队四人且正在招聘，方向覆盖开发者工具、硬件、半导体和电子。

companies.name: Floracene
companies.originalOneLiner: Vibecode + deploy HIPAA-compliant internal tools, no eng team needed
companies.originalDescription: Floracene lets any healthcare operator describe the internal tool they need and deploy it in one click - connected to production data, with read and write access scoped by the user. Think Lovable or Retool, except purpose-built for the needs of healthcare business that has no engineering team. The bottleneck in healthcare isn't building anymore. Anyone can vibecode an 80% solution in an afternoon, custom to their own workflow, with people already on staff. The tool then dies locally on the builder’s computer, because IT (correctly) won't let anyone deploy a tool touching PHI without first-class authentication and permissioning. Our first customer had multiple employees who had each built useful tools and dashboards locally, but couldn’t actually share these with coworkers or connect to their core practice data. Within weeks of implementing Floracene, they were able to consolidate their BI tooling into Floracene and shipped 4 net-new to production. A staggering ~$200B is spent on administrative software in healthcare every year in the US. Tens of thousands of those companies still run core operations on spreadsheets, and we're at the top of the first inning of AI adoption. Asaph and Jonah met on the hospitals team at Palantir two years ago, and have each spent the last four years in the plumbing of US healthcare: claims, eligibility, and payor contracting. Asaph was an early PM at Garner. Jonah was a founding engineer at Metriport (YC S22) after starting his own fax-automation startup for fertility clinics.
companies.story: 这是帮医疗机构无工程团队也能部署合规内部工具的公司。假如你是一家诊所的运营负责人，同事用一下午拼出一个适合自己流程的小工具，却只能留在本机，因为信息技术部门不会允许未经身份验证和权限管理的工具接触患者健康信息。Floracene 让医疗运营者描述所需工具，一键部署并连接生产数据，读写权限按用户限定，相当于为没有工程团队的医疗企业量身定做的内部工具平台。它的第一个客户就有多名员工各自建了有用的工具和看板却无法共享，接入后几周内便整合了这些工具。这家公司来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队两人。

companies.name: HERA
companies.originalOneLiner: Agents for Industrials
companies.originalDescription: At Hera, we build physical AI tools that help heavy engineering teams bring products to market up to 20× faster. Today, we work with manufacturers of data center ancillary equipment, renewable energy systems, robotics, heat exchangers, power plants and pressure vessels.
companies.story: 这是为工业工程团队做智能体的公司。如果你是一家重型设备制造商的设计负责人，从概念到产品上市往往要经历漫长的建模、仿真和反复修改。HERA 构建物理人工智能工具，帮助重型工程团队把产品上市速度提升最多二十倍，目前服务于数据中心辅助设备、可再生能源系统、机器人、换热器、电厂和压力容器等制造商。它把能力放进工程设计与制造的真实环节，而不只是一个手机应用。这家公司来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队两人且正在招聘，方向覆盖企业服务、设计、设计工具和制造业。

companies.name: Intelligence Factory
companies.originalOneLiner: Human Intelligence for Robots
companies.originalDescription: Robotics is the new paradigm. With hardware converging, Intelligence is the biggest bottleneck. Our world was built for humans and we're giving robots the ability to reason and act like us. The way we learn any task - by seeing, doing, and feeling - is how we train robots. We're building general intelligence that works on any robot and fits seamlessly within our world.
companies.story: 这是为机器人提供通用智能的公司。想象你负责一条产线的机器人部署，硬件已经就位，但机器人面对为人类建造的世界仍然笨拙，换一个任务就要重新编程。Intelligence Factory 认为硬件正在趋同，智能才是最大瓶颈，于是用人类学习任务的方式，即看、做和感受，来训练机器人，目标是打造能在任何机器人上运行、并无缝融入我们世界的通用智能。这不是一个手机应用，而是把推理和行动能力放进机器人本体与随身场景。这家公司来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队十人且正在招聘，场景本身值得关注，因为机器人正成为新范式。

companies.name: twentyfour26
companies.originalOneLiner: Building Autonomous Factories in America, Starting with On-Demand CNC…
companies.originalDescription: At twentyfour26, we are developing standardized manufacturing cells that bring machines, tooling, workholding, and inspection under a single system. Our models are being developed to interpret CAD designs, plan machining strategies, select tooling and setups, and operate the machines. We're already manufacturing components for hardware companies in and around the Bay Area, with turnaround times as fast as ~48 hours. Operating our own machines allows us to develop and deploy automation against real production workloads. Our goal is to make manufacturing 100 different designs as easy as manufacturing 100 units of the same design. From individual components to complete assemblies, we want to abstract the entire manufacturing infrastructure into an API.
companies.story: 这是在美国建设自主工厂的公司，先从按需数控加工做起。假如你是一家硬件公司的工程负责人，需要小批量、多品种的零件，传统加工厂排期长、沟通琐碎。twentyfour26 开发标准化制造单元，把机床、刀具、工装和检测纳入同一系统，模型被训练来解读计算机辅助设计图纸、规划加工策略、选择刀具和装夹并操作机器。它已经在湾区周边为硬件公司制造零件，最快约四十八小时交付，用自己的机器在真实生产负载上开发和部署自动化。这家公司来自 YC 秋季 2026 批次，团队两人，目标是让制造一百种设计像制造一百件同款一样容易。

companies.name: RonanRx Inc.
companies.originalOneLiner: Full Stack Pharmaceutical Company for Personalized Peptides and GLP-1s
companies.originalDescription: RonanRX is a full-stack pharmaceutical company, starting with personalized peptides and GLP-1s. In our first 10 weeks, we went from having no pharmacy to being licensed in 33 states. Since launch, we’ve grown 50% week over week. We manufacture the medications ourselves, sell directly to patients, and eliminate the layers of middlemen that make prescription drugs more expensive. What makes this possible is AI. Traditional pharmaceutical companies are built to manufacture one drug for millions of people. RonanRX is purpose-built to personalize treatment for each patient: different biology, different response, different dose. Patients come directly to RonanRX or through doctors using our platform. Every patient completes our medical intake, meets with a licensed doctor through our telehealth platform, and receives a personalized prescription when appropriate. From there, we manufacture the medication ourselves and deliver it directly to the patient. Labs, wearables, medical history, treatment response, and other health data feed back into the platform so doctors can continuously refine treatment over time. Before AI, doing this for every patient at scale was impossible. We didn't invent the demand we are seeing. 80 Million people are on a GLP-1 and millions more are using Peptides. We're building a better way to manufacture, personalize, prescribe, and deliver them. Our founders have built and exited multiple companies, raised more than $100M, built a $50M U.S. medical manufacturing business, and spent years developing peptide therapeutics at companies including Eli Lilly and AbbVie. We’re just getting started with peptides and GLP-1s. Next comes hormone therapy and the rest of personalized medicine.
companies.story: 这是做个性化肽类和 GLP-1 药物的全栈制药公司。如果你是一位想获得个性化治疗的 patient，传统药厂为百万人生产同一种药，很难照顾不同生物学和不同反应。RonanRx 自己生产药物、直接面向患者销售，去掉推高药价的中间环节，患者通过远程医疗平台完成问诊，由持照医生评估后获得个性化处方。它在最初十周内从没有药房发展到在三十三个州获得许可，上线后每周增长五成，人工智能让为每位患者定制治疗成为可能。这家公司来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队五人。

companies.name: Maywood
companies.originalOneLiner: The first finance-compliant proactive AI that runs 24/7
companies.originalDescription: Maywood is the first finance-compliant proactive AI that runs 24/7, working across your network, pipeline, and active processes, running constantly in the background and surfacing things you'd otherwise miss. It tracks relationships and sector context to flag when a target is gearing up for a process (and drafts the outreach in your voice), watches network activity across LinkedIn, news, and conference follow-ups, and surfaces where active processes stand, including what's at risk since you last looked. It also auto-updates CRMs and trackers and creates meeting briefs that includes relationship history, recent activity, deal context, external research, talking points that can pull from internal and external data sources. Dealmakers interact with it over email, Teams, or the platform itself.
companies.story: 这是做金融合规的主动式人工智能的公司。一个交易撮合者每天要盯网络、管道和进行中的流程，稍不留神就错过目标公司启动交易程序的信号。Maywood 的人工智能全天候在后台运行，跟踪关系和人脉动态，在目标准备启动流程时提醒并代拟外联邮件，监视领英、新闻和会议跟进中的网络活动，汇总进行中流程的状态和风险，还会自动更新客户关系管理系统和跟踪表，生成包含关系历史、近期活动、交易背景和外部研究的会议简报。用户可以通过邮件、Teams 或平台本身与它互动。这家公司来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，团队五人且正在招聘。

readings.title: Gemini 4 Carbon is now available
readings.story: 每隔一阵，团队里就会有人问：我们到底该用哪个模型，换一个会不会更好？这类问题看似只是选型，背后其实牵着算力、成本和上线节奏。当新模型发布的消息传来，产品经理和工程师往往要在很短时间内判断它跟自己手上的事有没有关系。这篇值得读，是因为它来自模型发布方本身，能帮你看清一次发布在讲什么、承诺了什么。读的时候不妨留意作者如何介绍能力边界和适用场景，以及哪些说法是明确给出的，哪些还需要你自己去验证。

readings.title: NVIDIA Expands Open Source Commitment With OpenShell Donation and New AI Infrastructure
readings.story: 做基础设施的人常有一种体会：真正让人头疼的不是买不到芯片，而是软件那一层怎么接、怎么维护、怎么不被一家厂商绑住。开源项目在这种时候就成了很多团队的备选方案，但谁来长期投入、谁来保证方向，又成了新的疑问。这篇来自 NVIDIA 的文章正好落在这个节点上，它讲的是把项目交出去、同时继续加码基础设施。读的时候可以看作者如何解释捐赠的动机和边界，以及一家公司公开承诺开放时，读者该从哪些细节判断这份承诺的分量。

readings.title: Apple TV makes sign language interpretation a built-in accessibility feature
readings.story: 看剧的时候，听障观众常常只能等字幕，而字幕未必能传达语气和现场感。手语翻译一直存在，但大多藏在单独的画面或外挂服务里，用起来多一道门槛。当一个平台把这件事直接做进播放体验，讨论的就不只是功能多少，而是谁被默认包含在内。这篇值得读，因为它记录了一次把无障碍从补丁变成默认设置的选择。读的时候可以留意作者怎么讲这个功能落在哪一层、对内容方和观众各自意味着什么，以及做这个决定时要权衡哪些现实约束。

companies.name: Klaimee
companies.originalOneLiner: Liability insurance for AI Agents. You deploy agents, we cover you.
companies.originalDescription: Klaimee is the first insurance for your AI agents. It covers what traditional E&O and cyber explicitly carve out, so you can deploy agentic AI at scale with real peace of mind. Built for companies deploying agentic AI, self-serve from day one. The problem: AI agents are taking actions autonomously buying, emailing, modifying sensitive data. AB 316 already holds deployers liable. EU AI Act enforces in August. Cyber and E&O insurance are excluding AI claims. Companies shipping agents have zero coverage and no third-party proof their agent is safe. Enterprise legal asks "who pays if your agent breaks something?" and there's no good answer. We built the answer. Critical-category risk evaluation, certification, financial guarantee, liability insurance and the documentation enterprise procurement needs to sign off. Team: Ines (ex-General Manager at SafetyWing, grew insurance product from $5M to $60M revenue, 5 years launching insurance products from scratch and structuring a TokioMarine MGA into its own carrier) + Julien (AI software engineer + corporate strategy, enterprise compliance). We understand how insurance works, what enterprises require, and why startups can't wait 6 months for either.
companies.story: 这是为人工智能智能体提供责任保险的创业公司，专门覆盖传统职业责任险和网络安全险明确排除的智能体行为风险。假如你是一家公司的法务负责人，企业采购部门问你，如果部署的智能体在自动采购或修改敏感数据时出了错，谁来赔，你翻遍现有保单也找不到答案。Klaimee 的做法是对智能体做关键类别风险评估和认证，再提供财务担保与责任保险，并生成企业采购能签字认可的文件。它值得关注，因为公司处于 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队只有两人且正在招聘，产品从第一天就支持自助购买，而加州第 316 号法案和欧盟人工智能法案正在把部署者的责任变成现实压力。

companies.name: Standard Physics
companies.originalOneLiner: Fast Physics Simulations for Rapid Design and Real Time Control
companies.originalDescription: Standard Physics (formerly Inviscid AI) builds AI that does real physics. Most AI tools approximate physical behavior and get it wrong in ways engineers can’t see. Ours run actual numerical solvers, so the results are accurate enough to make real engineering decisions on. We have three products built on one engine. Reynolds runs computational fluid dynamics for you. An engineer describes the flow in plain language, and Reynolds writes the OpenFOAM case, builds the mesh, runs the solver, and returns the figures, the numbers, and a case they can rerun. It’s open source. Archimedes searches the design itself. Swarms of agents try thousands of layouts in parallel, simulate each one through Reynolds, keep what the physics rewards, and redraw the search space when the best answer was never in the original plan. We sell it as outcome-based engineering: customers pay for a better design, not for compute. Inviscid AI (now a product!) points the same engine at a running building. It holds a data center within its thermal limits in real time, computed continuously from live telemetry. Our platform optimizes airflow patterns and ventilation strategies to eliminate dead zones, improve air distribution, and reduce the load on mechanical systems. On the energy side, we minimize HVAC power consumption, reduce cooling costs, and lower overall operational expenses while maintaining optimal thermal comfort and indoor air quality. We work with hardware startups and engineering teams on data center cooling, drones, energy systems, piping, and electronics. Reynolds earns engineers’ trust in daily use, and Archimedes and Inviscid AI turn that trust into large contracts.
companies.story: 这家公司切的是工程仿真基础设施，用人工智能驱动真实的数值求解器来做物理计算。一位负责流体设计的工程师每天要花大量时间手写仿真算例、划网格、跑求解器，改一个参数就得重来一遍。Standard Physics 的 Reynolds 让工程师用日常语言描述流动，自动生成算例、网格和结果，而且开源可复跑；Archimedes 则让成群的智能体并行尝试成千上万种布局，用物理结果筛选方案。它值得关注，因为团队来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，产品按结果收费，客户为更好的设计付费，而不是为软件席位付费。

companies.name: Valgo
companies.originalOneLiner: Insurance risk layer for physical AI
companies.originalDescription: Insurers struggle to price autonomous systems because the historical data simply doesn't exist. Your car insurance draws from over 30 billion claims records, but autonomous trucks and robots have nearly zero. Valgo is the risk quantification platform that closes that gap. We are building probabilistic models of routes, tasks, and environments from the bottom up. We output a simulated loss estimate that insurers need to price coverage. Valgo is the foundational layer that gives insurance providers confidence to properly price autonomy risk. Our team combines expertise in risk estimation for autonomy with deep experience in the insurance industry. Sydney and Robert are Stanford PhDs with leading expertise in safety of physical AI systems. Sydney wrote the textbook on validating safety-critical systems and teaches the course at Stanford. Robert spent 7 years at MIT Lincoln Laboratory on the core team that designed and validated an FAA-certified aircraft collision avoidance system, now a worldwide standard. Jon is a Sloan Fellow from the Stanford GSB and an actuary who spent over 12 years in insurance leadership and led over $5 billion in M&A as head of corporate development for one of the largest insurers in Asia-Pacific.
companies.story: 这是给物理世界人工智能做风险量化的平台，方向是让保险公司能对自动驾驶卡车和机器人定价。一个保险公司的精算师今天要为一支自动驾驶车队报价，却发现历史理赔数据几乎为零，传统车险背后有三百多亿条理赔记录，而自主系统没有。Valgo 从路线、任务和环境出发自下而上建立概率模型，输出模拟损失估计，供保险公司定价。它值得关注，因为团队来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，两位创始人是斯坦福博士，在物理人工智能系统安全验证方面有专业积累，其中一位在斯坦福讲授相关课程。

companies.name: Caution
companies.location: George Town, George Town, Cayman Islands
companies.originalOneLiner: Hosting platform for software you can't afford to have hacked
companies.originalDescription: Caution is a hosting platform for software you can't afford to get hacked. It simplifies and extends confidential compute, and lets developers deploy workloads to secure enclaves in minutes and give customers, auditors, and counterparties cryptographic proof that production is running the exact reviewed source code, build, configuration, and runtime - not an opaque binary controlled by a cloud operator or internal admin. Confidential computing hardware exists, but the tooling is too fragmented and incomplete for most teams to use well. Today, attestation often proves only that a binary has a certain hash; it does not prove what source code produced that binary. Building the missing deployment, reproducibility, and verification layer requires specialized security engineering and often locks teams into one cloud or hardware stack. Caution turns that into a simple git-based workflow that builds reproducible enclave images, provisions infrastructure, and lets anyone independently verify what is running. We built Caution after years securing high-risk systems through Distrust, where we worked with hedge funds, custodians, blockchain teams, cloud platforms, and critical grid operators on systems responsible for more than $600B in assets. Again and again, the same problem showed up: teams running mission-critical infrastructure could not reliably prove what was executing in production. As AI, fintech, healthcare, and regulated data collaboration move into the cloud, "trust us" is no longer enough. Caution is a general-purpose platform: if it runs on a server, it can run verifiably on Caution. We're starting where trust failures cost the most, but we believe verifiable compute will become the default way software runs, the same way HTTPS became the default way it's served. Infrastructure you can verify, not trust.
companies.story: 这是做高安全托管基础设施的公司，面向那些承受不起被入侵后果的软件。如果你是一家金融科技公司的工程负责人，审计方要求你证明生产环境跑的正是经过审查的那份源代码，而不是云厂商或内部管理员手里的不透明二进制文件，你很难拿出证据。Caution 把机密计算封装成基于 git 的简单工作流，让开发者在几分钟内部署到安全飞地，并向客户、审计方和交易对手提供密码学证明。它值得关注，因为公司处于 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队五人，专注网络安全与云基础设施，补上了现有证明工具只能验证二进制哈希、无法追溯源码的缺口。

companies.name: Preload
companies.originalOneLiner: Sensorimotor context for physical AI
companies.originalDescription: Designing and iterating a multimodal hardware stack (currently ego + tactile gloves + EMG) to collect rich and scalable datasets for physical AI. Also interested in how we can use this technology to advance surgery. Built by PhD founders (Johns Hopkins, Caltech) with world-class expertise in brain-computer interfaces (Neuralink, Meta, Paradromics)
companies.story: 这家公司做的是物理人工智能的传感器运动上下文数据采集，把能力放进可穿戴设备而不是手机应用里。一个机器人学习研究员需要训练机械臂完成精细操作，却苦于缺少带触觉和肌肉信号的真实动作数据，光靠摄像头拍不到手上的力。Preload 正在迭代多模态硬件栈，目前包括第一视角设备、触觉手套和肌电传感器，用来收集可扩展的数据集，并探索把这项技术用于外科手术训练。它值得关注，因为团队来自 YC 秋季 2026 批次，创始人是约翰霍普金斯和加州理工的博士，在脑机接口领域有专业背景，这类随身传感硬件正是纯软件方案拿不到的数据入口。

companies.name: Arlo Industries
companies.originalOneLiner: Track drones and missiles without radars - Accurate, Passive, Scalable
companies.originalDescription: Arlo Industries is building a network of sensors that precisely tracks stealthy drones and aerial threats better than radars. This capability does not exist yet because traditional radars are built on past war doctrines designed to protect single, centralised assets. Modern warfare, however, demands wide-area, persistent coverage that is both passive and economically scalable. By utilising a mesh architecture, Arlo Industries unlocks unprecedented asymmetric economics. The network is fundamentally built to scale: the cost of adding sensors grows linearly, but the tracking accuracy increases exponentially, delivering highly resilient, persistent coverage for a fraction of the cost of legacy systems. Deo founded Arlo Industries after spending over 6 years in the Israeli defence ecosystem, where he lived through multiple conflicts and experienced the Iron Dome and other systems in action against ICBMs and the infamous Shahed drones. Learning exactly how these defence systems could be improved after a Shahed exploded close to his apartment, he built Arlo Industries around the core philosophy that conflict should be concise & precise. The people behind Arlo1 includes a PhD in drones and autonomy and military experts. Arlo Industries has actively showcased this technology directly to Ukrainian militaries on the frontlines, as well as to operators across Europe and the USA.
companies.story: 这是做防空探测硬件的公司，用被动传感器网络追踪无人机和导弹，而不依赖雷达。想象你负责一处关键设施的防空值班，传统雷达对低空小型目标探测吃力，而且单点部署一旦被针对就整片失明。Arlo Industries 用网状架构铺设大量传感器，单个传感器成本线性增加，追踪精度却呈指数提升，提供广域持续覆盖。它值得关注，因为公司处于 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队三人且正在招聘，创始人曾在以色列防务生态工作六年多，亲历多次冲突并见证铁穹等系统的实际运行。

companies.name: Ignition Benefits
companies.originalOneLiner: The AI-Native Benefits Brokerage
companies.originalDescription: Ignition is an AI-native employee benefits brokerage for companies with under 200 employees. Health insurance is one of the largest line items these companies carry, and employers absorb 15 to 40% rate increases year after year without ever seeing their own numbers. We have rebuilt the sales and back office to be AI-first. This market represents about $500B of market cap, and those businesses have not fundamentally changed in over 50 years. While scaling Plated, I wore every HR hat from doing payroll myself, to managing a PEO, to eventually hiring an employee benefits broker on our way to 1,500 employees. We wasted over $4M on benefits over 5 years, and I'm building Ignition to help companies under 200 employees avoid making my mistakes.
companies.story: 这是做员工福利经纪的人工智能原生公司，服务两百人以下的企业。如果你是一家小公司的运营负责人，每年续保时面对百分之十五到四十的保费涨幅，却始终看不到自己公司的理赔数据，只能被动接受。Ignition Benefits 把销售和后台流程重做成人工智能优先，帮小企业看清自己的数字并做出更合理的福利决策。它值得关注，因为公司处于 YC 秋季 2026 批次，团队十二人且正在招聘，创始人曾在 Plated 从自己跑工资单一路做到一千五百人规模，五年里在福利上浪费了超过四百万美元，这个市场约五千亿美元市值且五十多年没有根本变化。

companies.name: Waddle Labs
companies.originalOneLiner: LLMs that control robots
companies.story: 这家公司做的是用大语言模型控制机器人，属于机器人自动化与开发工具方向。一个工厂自动化工程师今天想让机械臂完成新的抓取任务，传统做法要重新写程序、调参数，动辄几天。Waddle Labs 的方向是让语言模型直接理解指令并驱动机器人动作，把自然语言变成控制信号。它值得关注，因为公司处于 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队两人且正在招聘，这个方向正处在语言模型与真实硬件交汇的位置，场景本身说明通用指令控制机器人是自动化落地的关键一步。

companies.name: Versine
companies.originalOneLiner: Let your agents send and receive money. We're Venmo for agents.
companies.originalDescription: Versine lets your agents send and receive money. We’re Venmo for agents. Connect it to ChatGPT, Claude, Muse or your own agent through our MCP. Then send your agent a dinner receipt and it splits the bill. Tell it “if I don’t run 10k tomorrow, pay Jake $10” and it checks Strava and pays out if you miss. It can also pay invoices that land in your inbox, or split rent and utilities with your roommates every month. Recipients don’t need an account: they get a link to cash out to their bank. Banking and payout services are provided by licensed partners.
companies.story: 这是做智能体支付工具的金融科技公司，让智能体能收发钱，定位是给智能体用的 Venmo。想象你是一个运动用户，跟朋友打赌明天跑不完十公里就付他十美元，你把这条件告诉智能体，它去查 Strava 记录，没跑够就自动付款。Versine 通过接口接入 ChatGPT、Claude 等智能体，能分账单、付发票、和室友分摊房租水电，收款方无需注册，收到链接就能提现到银行。它值得关注，因为公司处于 YC 秋季 2026 批次，团队三人，银行与出款服务由持牌合作方提供，把智能体从只会说话推进到能真正动钱。

companies.name: Risely AI
companies.originalOneLiner: AI agents that automate administrative work across college campuses.
companies.originalDescription: Risely’s AI agents will form the new operating system for universities, improving retention, staff productivity, and efficiency. Our platform integrates directly into existing university systems (SIS, LMS, CRM), learns each institution’s unique workflows, and deploys specialized AI agents. This dramatically reduces the $735 billion universities spend annually on administrative labor, expands staff capacity without increasing headcount, and improves the student experience. This hasn't been done before because university workflows require nuanced, autonomous judgment, exactly what agentic AI was designed to solve. Our team uniquely combines deep expertise in higher education, enterprise-scale AI, and regulated enterprise sales. Sadia previously built Salesforce’s Education Cloud from scratch, creating the core Student Information System widely used across higher education. She deeply understands university operations and maintains trusted relationships with hundreds of higher-ed CIOs and Provosts. Danial was one of DoorDash’s earliest engineers, where he architected and scaled complex systems from zero to billions of transactions, including their search, recommendation, and Voice AI platforms. He knows how to build robust AI solutions that reliably perform at enterprise scale. Shahryar was a GM at Airwallex, where he built the entire Americas business from 0 to 1 and drove 11x revenue growth. He’s also a master closer, single-handedly securing over $17M in enterprise deals at NerdWallet. He’s a relentless startup executor with deep expertise launching and scaling go-to-market machines in highly regulated industries. We launched six weeks ago and are already at $8k MRR, growing 55% week-over-week -- one of the fastest ramps ever in higher ed. Universities urgently need solutions that expand labor capacity and efficiency, especially as they face unprecedented budget pressure and staffing shortages. With unmatched buyer access, deep technical expertise, and rapid early traction, we are perfectly positioned to own this enormous market.
companies.story: 这是给大学校园做行政自动化的公司，用智能体处理教务和运营中的重复工作。一位大学教务管理者每天要面对大量学生咨询、选课调整和跨系统录入，人手不够却又要提升留存率。Risely AI 直接接入学校已有的学生信息系统、学习管理系统和客户关系管理系统，学习每所院校的独特流程，再部署专门的智能体分担行政事务。它值得关注，因为公司处于 YC 夏季 2025 批次，团队八人，创始人曾在 Salesforce 从零搭建教育云并做出被广泛使用的学生信息系统核心，而高校每年在行政人力上的支出高达七千三百五十亿美元。

readings.title: Ninja’s AutoBarista is impressively versatile, but one feature was a dealbreaker for me
readings.story: 家里想喝一杯像样的咖啡，从磨豆到打奶泡要摆弄好几样机器，收拾起来也麻烦。于是不少人会想，有没有一台机器能把这些事都包了。这篇评测讲的就是这样一台多功能咖啡机，作者用下来觉得它确实能干不少活，但有一个功能让他最终没法接受。值得读的地方在于，它没有停在参数和功能清单上，而是把一台机器放进日常使用里，看哪些设计真正省事，哪些反而添乱。读的时候可以留意作者是怎么区分“功能多”和“用着顺手”的，以及那个让他放弃的细节，究竟卡在使用的哪一步。

readings.title: What it actually takes to build frontier models | Tulsee Doshi (Head of Product for Gemini)
readings.story: 现在很多团队都在谈做模型，但真正从零训练一个前沿模型，和调用现成接口完全是两回事。一个产品经理或工程师第一次参与这类项目时，常会发现难点不在某个聪明的想法，而在大量琐碎又互相牵制的决定。这篇访谈的对象是负责 Gemini 产品的负责人，聊的正是这件事背后实际要付出什么。它值得读，是因为能让人看到光环之外的取舍。读的时候可以注意她怎么把一个大目标拆成可推进的问题，以及在资源、时间和质量之间，她和团队是怎么做判断的。

readings.title: How to make a CNC plasma cutter with high-frequency start
readings.story: 喜欢动手的人常会遇到一个门槛：想做一台能切金属的数控等离子切割机，但点火这一环总是不太听话。技术社区里这类自制项目的讨论，往往就卡在这种看似不起眼的地方。这篇讲的是用高频起弧来做这台机器的做法，对没接触过的人也有意思，因为它展示了一个爱好者怎么把问题一步步解决。读的时候不妨跟着作者的思路走，看他先碰到什么故障，怎么判断原因，又为什么选这条路线而不是别的。这样读比只看最终成品更有收获。

companies.name: DeepReach Inc.
companies.originalOneLiner: Network for Physical AI Data Business
companies.originalDescription: Physical AI — robots and world models — is bottlenecked on one thing: diverse, real-world data at massive scale showing how humans actually do work in the physical world. It was never written down, and you can't buy it, because no one has ever captured it. Only real local experts, the people who do this work every day, can produce data this authentic and valuable. DeepReach builds the network that reaches them. We design and manufacture wearable stereo capture devices, then place them with local data partners who run collection as their own business — in warehouses, workshops, farms, kitchens and repair shops. They own the local relationships; we supply the hardware, the software platform, the quality pipeline and the payments. Anyone can run a data business. That structure is what produces diversity. Instead of thousands of hours inside one environment, we deliver hours spread across thousands of environments — which is what actually makes robot policies generalize. 475 devices in the field and 100+ data partners are live across 7 countries, adding new partners every week. They've collected nearly 150,000 clips in the past three months, with volume roughly doubling month over month. Our data is in production with multiple frontier model and robotics companies, and we're scaling to 10,000+ devices across 50 countries.
companies.story: 这是做物理世界人工智能数据网络的公司。假如你是一家仓库的运营负责人，每天看着熟练工人在货架间快速拣货、绕开障碍、处理各种意外，你会意识到这些动作细节从来没有被完整记录下来，而训练机器人和世界模型恰恰最缺这种真实数据。DeepReach 的做法是自己设计和制造可穿戴的立体采集设备，再交给本地数据合作方，让他们把采集当成自己的生意来经营，场景覆盖仓库、车间、农场、厨房和修理店。合作方负责本地关系，公司提供硬件、软件平台、质量流程和结算。这种结构让数据分散在不同环境里，而不是集中在少数几个场地。它来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队六人，正在招聘，物理世界数据这个方向本身就值得关注。

companies.name: Workers IO
companies.originalOneLiner: Simulation environments for verifying mission-critical software
companies.originalDescription: Workers IO is building simulation environments to catch failures in mission-critical software before they reach production. We run your entire system through millions of simulated production scenarios to verify its correctness and performance properties. Coding agents can now generate code faster than teams can review it. Meanwhile, software and the infrastructure it runs on keep getting more complex. Tests check a small set of cases in isolation, in environments that are different from production. Some of the most expensive failures only surface when customers encounter them. We run your entire system unmodified and simulate network faults, disk failures, crashes, and clock drift. We build the fault models for you and check your system’s requirements across millions of scenarios. Every failure we find can be perfectly reproduced.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是为物理世界人工智能采集数据的生意。假如你是一位在仓库里干了十几年的老手，每天靠经验判断哪批货该先上架、哪条通道容易堵，这些本事从来没被写下来过，也没人买得到。DeepReach 设计和制造可穿戴的立体采集设备，交给本地数据合作方，让他们把采集当成自己的生意来跑，仓库、车间、农场、厨房、修理店都可以，合作方负责本地关系，公司提供硬件、软件平台、质量流程和付款。这样数据才能分散在不同环境里，而不是堆在同一个场景中。它来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队六人，正在招聘，值得关注的是它把硬件和本地网络结合起来解决物理世界数据稀缺的问题。

companies.name: IMPACT Drones
companies.originalOneLiner: Air Defense as a Service for Civilian Infrastructure.
companies.originalDescription: IMPACT builds autonomous interceptor drones that ship in sealed containers. The box sits at the site it protects, data centers, power grids, airports, bases, with no crew on the pad. When sensors cue a hostile drone, an interceptor pierces its own frangible lid, launches, and rams the target, guided by onboard vision that keeps working when GPS is jammed. Legacy effectors cost $1M+ per shot against $30k threats; ours cost less than the threat and scale with the swarm, the same class of interceptor already downing Shahed drones over Ukraine. Sites subscribe to protection instead of buying missiles, hardware, reloads and monitoring included: Air Defense as a Service. 180M+ USD in signed letters of intent.
companies.story: 这是做无人机防空拦截的硬件公司。想象你负责一座数据中心或变电站的安保，某天夜里传感器报警说有不明无人机逼近，而现场没有值班机组，传统防空导弹一发上百万美元，打几千美元的来袭目标根本不划算。IMPACT 的做法是把自主拦截无人机装进密封箱里，箱子就放在要保护的地点，传感器发现敌意无人机后，拦截机自己顶破易碎盖升空，靠机载视觉在卫星定位被干扰时仍能追踪并撞毁目标。它把防空变成订阅服务，硬件、补弹和监控都包含在内，客户不用买导弹。这家公司来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队只有两人且正在招聘，已签下超过 1.8 亿美元意向书，场景本身也说明关键基础设施面对廉价无人机蜂群时的防护缺口值得关注。

companies.name: Aucert
companies.originalOneLiner: A team of expert AI agents that test mobile apps on their own.
companies.originalDescription: Top apps need weeks and multiple teams to test every release. Aucert does it in hours, and plugs into agentic coding workflows so issues get fixed in the same loop. Agents: Functional QA · Accessibility · Google Play Policy · App Store Policy Next: Performance · Security. DM if you need either.
companies.story: 这是做移动应用测试智能体的公司。想象你负责一个头部应用的发布，每次上线前要花好几周、拉上好几个团队把功能、无障碍、应用商店政策逐项过一遍，问题还是常常漏到用户手里。Aucert 用一组专家智能体替团队跑这些检查，几小时内完成，还能接进智能体编程流程，让问题在同一个循环里被修掉。目前覆盖功能测试、无障碍、谷歌应用商店政策和苹果应用商店政策，性能和安全的检查在计划中。它来自 YC 秋季 2026 批次，团队两人，暂不招聘，场景本身说明了发布测试这件事有多费人。

companies.name: Blue
companies.originalOneLiner: AI rebuilt coding. We’re rebuilding the phone
companies.originalDescription: AI changed coding when it got its own environment instead of a chat window. Developers stopped typing every line and started handing off whole tasks. The phone is next, and it needs the same rebuild. Blue is that rebuild: a phone that’s also your chief of staff. It reads every notification, text, and email for you. Then it either handles each one and leaves you an FYI, or drafts a reply and waits for your OK. Anything else is one button away: say what needs doing, and Blue gets it done in the background, using the right apps. It knows you from day one. Switch from your iPhone and Blue brings over your apps, messages, photos, and passwords, so it already knows who matters to you, how you write, and which card to use. No logins to hand over, no context to explain. An app can’t do this; it takes owning the phone. Blue runs our own OS on Google Pixel today, with our own hardware in development. We sold out our first batch at YC’s Alumni Demo Day in September. The team brings complementary experience at scale: Omar Abdelaziz led Google Assistant’s transition to LLMs and holds one of the earliest patents in LLM-based computer control; Peter Krogh spent decades designing voice-first dialog systems and before Blue was a design lead at Google DeepMind building actions for Gemini Live; Muhammad Farhan Hossain helped ship Apple Vision Pro, is named on dozens of hardware and systems patents, and has led products from prototype to mass production. We’ve built systems used by billions. Now we’re building the phone that comes next.
companies.story: 这家公司切的是手机这个入口，想把人工智能直接放进你随身带的设备里。如果你是一位每天被通知、短信和邮件淹没的人，Blue 会替你读每一条，能处理的就处理掉，只给你留个知会，需要回复的就先起草好等你点头，其他事情按一下键说清楚，它在后台调用合适的应用去办。它不只是一个手机应用，而是跑在自己的系统上，今天装在谷歌 Pixel 上，自有硬件在开发中，换机时能把应用、消息、照片和密码带过来，所以它一开始就知道谁重要、你怎么写字、用哪张卡。它来自 YC 夏季 2025 批次，团队七人，正在招聘。

companies.name: Discovered Materials
companies.originalOneLiner: AI scientists to discover materials for the semiconductor industry.
companies.originalDescription: We use AI to discover new materials for the semiconductor industry - specifically datacenters and fabs. Finding novel materials today takes 10+ years of lab work. We aim to compress that timeline to months, using a swarm of AI agents. Akash completed his PhD at Stanford on material discovery for semiconductors. The materials he discovered for nanoscale interconnects have been adopted into the roadmaps of Intel and TSMC. Advaith was the founding applied scientist at Persona AI (acquired by Luma Labs), where he built long horizon autonomous agents for major telecom and crypto companies. Power consumption and heat release from AI chips is doubling every year. The semiconductor industry needs new materials to keep this exponential going - Discovered Materials will help find them.
companies.story: 这是用人工智能为半导体行业寻找新材料的公司，重点指向数据中心和晶圆厂。假如你在一家芯片厂负责工艺，眼下最头疼的是功耗和散热每年翻倍，现有材料快撑不住这条增长曲线，而找一种新材料过去要在实验室里耗上十年以上。Discovered Materials 想用一群智能体把这段时间压缩到几个月。输入资料提到，联合创始人 Akash 在斯坦福读博期间研究半导体材料发现，他为纳米级互连找到的材料已被英特尔和台积电纳入路线图；另一位联合创始人 Advaith 曾是 Persona 人工智能 的创始应用科学家。它来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队四人，正在招聘。

companies.name: Faraday
companies.originalOneLiner: Industrial AI coordinating humans, agents, and machines
companies.originalDescription: Industrial enterprises still rely on people to coordinate disconnected software and machines, with critical knowledge held by a few experienced employees. Faraday builds self-improving systems that take on this operational work. We connect to existing software and machines and build training and evaluation environments around each company’s workflows and data. Continuous learning turns each company’s expertise into a compounding asset. Completed work, corrections, and employee feedback improve the agents, and those improvements carry into future jobs. The business preserves its knowledge while becoming more capable over time. As these agents take on more workflows, Faraday will be the shared runtime coordinating work between humans, agents, and robots across the business.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是工业场景里协调人、智能体和机器的软件。如果你是一家工厂的运营负责人，会发现关键知识往往只装在几位老员工脑子里，软件和机器彼此不通，全靠人去串。Faraday 接上企业现有的软件和设备，围绕每家公司的流程和数据搭出训练与评估环境，完成的活、纠正和员工反馈都会让智能体变好，并且带到后面的任务里，企业的经验因此留了下来，还越用越强。它来自 YC 秋季 2026 批次，团队两人，暂不招聘，值得看的是它把知识沉淀和自动化放在同一套系统里。

companies.name: Evergrove
companies.originalOneLiner: Instant healthcare for all, starting with work comp
companies.originalDescription: We've built voice agents for the largest work comp managed care orgs and specialist PT networks in the country, making >500K calls annually and accelerating the speed at which they coordinate care. On average, our customers see a 40% increase in workflow completion, 10x decrease in cycle times, and >60% reduction in cost. We think voice agents are the starting point for solving slow and fragmented care coordination in this market. Companies that manage an injured worker's care rely on short-staffed contact centres and archaic methods of info exchange: phone, fax, and email. Every delay along the path of care leads to slower rehab of the injured worker, lower throughput for providers, and higher expense for the insurer/employer.
companies.story: 这是做工伤医疗保险领域护理协调的公司，用语音智能体切入。想象你在一家管理受伤工人护理的机构负责理赔协调，手下的呼叫中心人手不够，信息还在靠电话、传真和邮件来回传，每拖一天，工人康复就慢一天，医疗机构吞吐下降，保险公司和雇主的花费也往上走。Evergrove 的语音智能体已经在为全美最大的几家工伤管理护理机构和专科康复网络打电话，每年超过五十万通，客户平均看到流程完成率提升四成、周期缩短十倍、成本下降六成以上。它来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队两人，暂不招聘。

companies.name: Omanta
companies.originalOneLiner: A research lab for one
companies.originalDescription: Omanta is a personalized research lab for patients who have exhausted standard options, want to prepare proactively for recurrence, or are living with an unresolved diagnosis. We direct the full operational infrastructure, personnel, expertise, and technology of a large research program toward understanding and addressing the challenges of individual patients across oncology, rare disease, and undiagnosed conditions. For clinicians, we act as a collaborative partner, providing a living roadmap for ongoing patient care built on a rigorous and evolving scientific evidence base. We fully operationalize patient-specific research programs, covering tissue logistics, diagnostic follow-up, data integration, multiomic analysis, therapeutic strategy development, and more. Omanta brings context and clarity to complex cases, helping clinicians see more of the scientific picture as they decide how best to care for their patients.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是面向单个患者的个性化研究服务，覆盖肿瘤、罕见病和未确诊疾病。假如你是一位临床医生，手上有一位已经用尽标准方案的患者，或者一位想为复发提前做准备的人，你需要在庞杂且不断更新的科学证据里替这一个病人找出路，却很难调动一整套研究资源。Omanta 把大型研究项目所需的运营、人员、专业能力和技术都指向单个患者，包办组织物流、诊断跟进、数据整合、多组学分析和治疗策略制定，并作为临床医生的协作伙伴，给出随证据演进的路线图。它来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队六人，暂不招聘。

companies.name: Copperlane
companies.originalOneLiner: Agentic Mortgage Origination
companies.originalDescription: Copperlane helps mortgage lenders accelerate the loan process and reduce mistakes in an application. We use AI agents to understand an applicant's profile, verify their documents, and complete initial underwriting tasks.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是房贷发放环节的智能体自动化。如果你是一位房贷机构的承销或运营负责人，每份申请都要人工看懂申请人的情况、核对文件、做完初步承销，慢一步客户就可能流向别家，错一处后面还要返工。Copperlane 用智能体去理解申请人画像、验证材料并完成初步承销任务，帮贷款机构加快流程、减少申请里的错误。它来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，团队三人，正在招聘，值得关注的是它把智能体放在房贷这种文件密集、容错率低的流程里。

readings.title: Gartner Sees Software Growing 14.6% to $1.68 Trillion in 2027: Models at 117%, AI App Platforms at 39%, and Price Increases Doing a Lot of the Work
readings.story: 每年到了做预算的时候，很多团队都会盯着软件账单发愁：明明用量没涨多少，支出却一年比一年高。这时候各种市场预测报告就显得格外重要，因为它们会影响公司怎么分配下一年的钱。这篇值得读的地方在于，它把增长数字拆开来看，指出其中有多少来自真实的用量扩张，又有多少只是价格上调带来的账面变化。读的时候可以留意作者怎么区分这两类增长，以及他如何判断哪些品类是真需求、哪些只是涨价撑起来的数字。

readings.title: Every Windows 11 app should kill Electron, and Discord just showed why
readings.story: 如果你在 Windows 上同时开着聊天软件和浏览器，任务管理器里那一排吃内存的进程大概让你印象深刻过。很多桌面应用为了跨平台方便，套了一层网页外壳，代价就是资源占用居高不下。这条讨论之所以在技术社区里热起来，是因为它拿一个具体产品做了对照，让人看到换一种做法之后差别有多大。读的时候不妨看作者怎么摆数据、怎么比较两种实现方式的取舍，以及评论区里工程师们争论的到底是什么：是性能，是开发成本，还是别的什么。

readings.title: Sequoia shutting down its Scouts program marks the end of an era
readings.story: 在创业圈里，早期项目怎么被发现、谁来牵线，一直是个不太透明的话题。大机构过去常靠一批分散在各处的人帮忙留意苗头，这种安排既省钱又能铺开网络，但也带来管理上的麻烦。这篇讲的是一个知名机构结束这类安排，值得读是因为它牵出的问题很实际：当市场变冷、回报变慢时，机构会怎么重新算这笔账。读的时候可以注意作者如何交代背景、如何判断这一变化意味着什么，以及它可能影响哪些正在找钱的创业者。

companies.name: Fire Wallet
companies.originalOneLiner: Fire Wallet is a privacy-first crypto wallet designed to just work,…
companies.originalDescription: 🔥FIRE WALLET 🔥 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JeXDDegwhgA TL;DR: Fire Wallet is a fast, end-to-end encrypted, non-custodial stablecoin wallet with built-in payment processing and fiat on/off ramps, built by the team that created MobileCoin, the cryptocurrency inside Signal. Hey Bookface! We're Josh, Michael, and Manny and we're building Fire Wallet! 🔥Why we built this Most wallets and payment processors don’t work FOR you. They're slow, route your payments in the way that earns them the most, and they leak your financial life to anyone asking. Worse: every single one hold the keys to your money. We believe your financial tools should act in your interest and, frankly, that your money should be yours. 🔥What Fire does Multi-chain, non-custodial, end-to-end encrypted wallet. Your keys, your money, your assets: you are in full control of your funds at all times. Least Cost Routing. Every swap and payment takes the cheapest path, not the one that pays a middleman the most. Self-sovereign payment processing. Send an invoice straight from the wallet. Get paid from your web checkout. No middleman. Easy fiat on/off ramps. Move stablecoins to USD and back without the pain. Built for agentic commerce. Manage per-agent sub-wallets for agentic workflows. Encrypted by default. Protecting you from bad actors and surveillance capitalism. 🔥Early traction Signed our first major LOI with @Trustboop (founded by Justice Laub of Drone Racing League and Rob Rhinehart of Soylent). Onboarding our first enterprise customer in ecommerce packaging and marketing, doing about $1.5M/month in volume. They've connected us to 10 more companies in the same vertical at similar volume, roughly a $100M/yr GMV opportunity. 🔥Why us Josh and Manuel led the creation of MobileCoin, the cryptocurrency in Signal Messenger: $100M+ raised, $1.16B peak valuation, $4B+ peak coin market cap, acquired in 2026. They understand what it takes to build a cryptographic business. Michael runs product and design. He's an internationally exhibited artist with two published art books, and he builds beautiful products. Manuel runs operations and orchestrates systems that actually work at scale. 🔥Asks Intros to businesses moving $1M+/month in payments, especially cross-border, ecommerce, and DTC, who want lower fees and more control over their funds. Strategic partners in fintech and payments interested in integrating our infrastructure. Tell us what's broken. Reply here or email founders@fire.co. We're looking for our first 100 customers. If that's you or someone you know, we'd love to talk.
companies.story: 这是做加密支付钱包的公司。假如你是一名需要经常收付稳定币的独立开发者，今天要给海外客户结一笔款，却发现常用钱包又慢又悄悄把你的交易路由给能赚手续费的一方，还担心自己的资金流向被第三方看光。Fire Wallet 把多链、非托管、端到端加密放进一个钱包里，私钥始终在你自己手上，同时内置支付处理和法币出入金通道，并尽量选择成本最低的路径来路由付款。它来自打造过 Signal 内置加密货币 MobileCoin 的团队，属于 YC 秋季批次，团队三人，场景本身说明钱包的速度、隐私和自主控制对日常收付的人有多实际。

companies.name: 0.security
companies.originalOneLiner: The autonomous cybersecurity team
companies.originalDescription: 0.security builds an autonomous offensive security team that finds and fixes vulnerabilities as fast as AI writes code and before attackers exploit them. We've found and fixed dozens of previously unknown vulnerabilities (0-days) in government software across multiple countries and in software running on 3+ billion devices. Today we work with EY (Ernst & Young), leading tech companies and defense organizations. Our AI agents hack into any software, verify every vulnerability they find, and ship the fix. They run 24/7 across the full stack, from web apps and dependencies down to operating systems and the Linux kernel. We offer two products: 0cloud, where developer teams connect their repos and get security handled 24/7 at the speed of their coding agents, and our open-source harness, which we deploy & run for tech companies, enterprises and critical infrastructure providers.
companies.story: 这家公司切的是企业安全里的自动化攻防。想象你是一家科技公司的工程负责人，代码由智能体越写越快，可安全团队还是那几个人，漏洞报告堆在队列里，你分不清哪些真能被利用。0.security 让自主智能体去攻击软件、逐一验证发现的漏洞，然后直接提交修复，覆盖从网页应用、依赖库一直到操作系统和 Linux 内核的整条栈。它提供两条产品线，一条是开发团队接入代码仓库后全天候处理安全，另一条是开源的运行框架，由公司为企业和关键基础设施部署。团队称已在多国政府软件和运行在三十亿以上设备上的软件中发现并修复数十个此前未知的漏洞，并与安永等机构合作，属于 YC 秋季批次。

companies.name: Operon
companies.originalOneLiner: Agentic data layer for manufacturing & process industries.
companies.originalDescription: Operon is the data intelligence layer for heavy industry. We ingest the messy documents a plant runs on (P&IDs, schematics, datasheets, scans) and turn them into one structured, queryable model of the facility. On top of it, engineers query their plant in natural language and build agentic workflows for safety, compliance, and design.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是重工业的数据底座。一个工厂的工程负责人每天要面对成堆的管道仪表图、电气原理图、设备数据表和扫描件，想查某个阀门连接到哪里，只能翻图纸或问老师傅。Operon 把这些杂乱文档吃进去，整理成一份结构化、可查询的整厂模型，工程师用自然语言就能向自己的工厂提问，还能在此基础上搭建面向安全、合规和设计的智能体工作流。它属于 YC 夏季批次，正在招聘，团队规模在输入里没有给出，但对流程工业来说，把图纸变成可查询的数据本身就是长期存在的痛点，值得关注。

companies.name: Reason Machines
companies.originalOneLiner: Reason is the AI teammate for work and code.
companies.originalDescription: Reason is an AI teammate for work and code that runs autonomous cloud agents with a frontier harness on cost per task. It delivers the same performance with 22% lower costs than Codex. By operating with a harness outside the sandbox, it acts seamlessly across cloud computers and local devices. Reason runs work from start to finish: from an issue to a finished pull request, on a schedule, or from a Slack alert. It is available as a Mac app, on the web, from the CLI, in Slack, and through a REST API, with about 100 integrations and shareable skills. Bring your own keys and subscriptions, and work rolls over to the next one when limits are hit.
companies.story: 这是做开发与办公智能体的公司。如果你是一名每天在工单、代码和消息之间来回切换的工程负责人，早上打开电脑就有一串问题等着你，从修一个缺陷到提交一个合并请求，全都要你亲自盯着。Reason 让云端智能体自主跑完整个流程，可以从一个工单一路做到完成的合并请求，也能按计划运行或由 Slack 告警触发，并以 Mac 应用、网页、命令行、Slack 和接口等多种形式提供，约有上百个集成和可分享的技能。它称在同等表现下比 Codex 的任务成本低百分之二十二，还支持自带密钥和订阅，额度用完后工作可以接着往下走。它属于 YC 秋季批次，正在招聘，团队两人。

companies.name: Rindler
companies.originalOneLiner: The IDE for Tokenmaxxers
companies.originalDescription: We build Maxxwell, a desktop app for people who run several coding agents at once. Past two or three sessions, you become the bottleneck. Every session asks you something, most of it small, and you spend the day answering instead of deciding. It is also hard to tell which sessions are making progress, which are stuck on something trivial, and which have quietly started building the wrong thing. Maxxwell puts every session in one window and marks each one working, idle, or waiting on you. On top of that sits an orchestrator, a real coding-agent session of its own that reads the others and reports back. You talk to it instead of to twelve terminals. It tells you what landed, what it decided for you, and what actually needs your call. Every worker is your own tool, unmodified. Claude Code, Codex and Cursor Agent run in real terminal sessions you can attach to and take over at any point
companies.story: 这家公司做的是同时管理多个编程智能体的桌面工具。一个工程负责人如果同时开着十几个编码会话，很快就会发现自己成了瓶颈，每个会话都来问点小事，一天下来全在回答而不是做决定，也看不出哪个在推进、哪个卡在琐事上、哪个已经悄悄做错了方向。Maxxwell 把所有会话放进一个窗口，标出每个是在工作、空闲还是在等你，并在上面放一个自己的编排会话，替你读其他会话并汇报进展，告诉你什么已经落地、它替你决定了什么、哪些才真需要你拍板。每个执行会话都是你自己未改动的工具，Claude Code、Codex 和 Cursor Agent 都能在可随时接管的真实终端里运行。它属于 YC 夏季批次，团队两人。

companies.name: Harbor
companies.originalOneLiner: AI-native CRO for clinical trial operations
companies.originalDescription: Harbor is building an AI-native contract research organization (CRO) for clinical trials. We started with an AI-native system of record for clinical trial data (electronic data capture system), grew the software business to seven trials and ~$187k in contracted software revenue over the next twelve months, then expanded into full-service trial execution and signed our first CRO contract worth $1.93M over three years. Clinical trials consume 45% of all new drug and device development spend. While some of that goes to software, sites, and patients, the largest line items are services: project management, monitoring, data management, site coordination, source verification, query resolution, record reconciliation, and analysis. Today, drug and device companies outsource clinical operations to legacy CROs and their massive teams, which is why the CRO market is $82B annually. Harbor delivers the regulated services companies buy from legacy CROs, but built around our AI-native system of record from day one. Our software already automates the core data workflows: study build, data capture, query generation, monitoring, signing, and database lock. Because we own the system of record, we can expand into the surrounding service workflows: site contracting and billing, subject engagement and retention, statistics, reporting, and more. We built Harbor because we lived through the problem. Albert spent four years in clinical trials and regulatory strategy at a medical device startup, taking an unproven wearable from first-in-human trials to FDA authorization. Nate brings the technical depth, having built scalable software at Google and Ramp and served as employee #1 at a previous YC startup.
companies.story: 这是做临床试验运营的公司。假如你在一家药物或器械企业负责试验推进，最头疼的往往不是科学问题，而是项目管理、监查、数据管理、中心协调、源数据核对、疑问解决这些服务性工作，它们占掉了新药和器械开发支出的一大部分，而传统合同研究组织靠庞大团队来完成。Harbor 先做面向临床试验数据的原生记录系统，把软件业务做到七个试验、约十八万七千美元的签约软件收入，随后扩展到全流程试验执行，并签下首份三年一百九十三万美元的合同研究组织合约。它属于 YC 春季批次，团队四人，这个从软件走向服务的路径本身值得看。

companies.name: Infera
companies.originalOneLiner: Control lab instruments with natural language.
companies.originalDescription: Describe an experiment in plain English, and Infera turns it into a validated, instrument-ready run across the equipment your lab already uses. Infera handles the protocol logic, vendor-specific scripts, data, inventory, and institutional knowledge in one system. An AI-native compiler for the lab: one system from intent to execution.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是实验室仪器的自然语言控制。一个研究员今天想跑一个新实验，却要分别对付不同厂商的脚本、协议逻辑、数据记录和库存信息，光把想法翻译成仪器能执行的步骤就要花掉半天。Infera 让人用平实的语言描述实验，再把它变成经过验证、可直接在实验室现有设备上运行的一轮流程，协议逻辑、厂商专用脚本、数据、库存和机构内的经验知识都收在同一个系统里。它属于 YC 春季批次，正在招聘，团队两人，对每天被仪器和脚本割裂的研究人员来说，从意图直接走到执行是长期存在的麻烦。

companies.name: Dispatch
companies.originalOneLiner: Satellites for Manufacturing in Space
companies.originalDescription: Dispatch is building refurbishable reentry vehicles that host and return payloads for companies making ultra-high-value materials (semiconductors, biotech, and pharma) that can only be manufactured in space. Right now, these companies have no practical way to manufacture and get their products back to Earth. We solve this bottleneck. We just returned from the Mojave Desert testing our first full-scale reentry heat shield designed to protect the satellite as it returns from space at Mach 20+, built in an apartment for 100x cheaper than competitors. To test, we held it behind a rocket engine to simulate the forces of atmospheric reentry. IT WORKED! Watch here - https://youtu.be/dhlQmnIoptg To scale, we anchor permanent infrastructure in orbit - building high power Autonomous Space Stations designed from day one for "lights-out" manufacturing serviced by the reentry vehicles.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是太空制造与返回的硬件。想象你是一家半导体或生物医药公司的工艺负责人，你的材料只有在外太空才能做得更好，可眼下几乎没有实际办法在轨生产再把产品带回地面。Dispatch 造可翻新的再入飞行器，用来搭载并带回这些高价值载荷，同时计划在轨道上布置高功率的自主空间站，从第一天就为无人化制造设计。团队称已在莫哈韦沙漠测试首个全尺寸再入隔热罩，在公寓里造出来，成本比同行低约一百倍，并用火箭发动机尾焰模拟再入受力。它属于 YC 春季批次，正在招聘，团队四人，这是把能力放进飞行器和轨道设施而不是软件里的硬科技方向。

companies.name: Ascenix
companies.originalOneLiner: Custom software for senior care facilities.
companies.originalDescription: Ascenix is building one custom interface for running senior homes. We combine reusable building blocks into workflows tailored to each home's existing processes, from incident reporting to reimbursement. Homes get custom software without hiring an engineering team. Living in a retirement home convinced us that the best way to improve residents' lives is to improve the systems staff rely on. As the older population grows, care teams need more time and resources. Repetitive reporting, missed reimbursement, and compliance problems take those away. Disconnected products that solve each of these individually add costs and leave staff moving information between systems. Our building blocks gather information from EHRs like PointClickCare and other sources, process it, apply rules, and produce reports, tasks, or emails. Incident reporting and reimbursement reviews usually come from two separate vendors. Ascenix builds both from the same blocks, in one interface, so data isn't stuck in silos. Homes start with their biggest bottleneck and add workflows as priorities change.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是养老院运营的定制软件。如果你是一家养老院负责运营的人，每天要在事件上报、报销审核和合规之间来回搬信息，系统彼此不通，员工只能手工把数据从一个地方抄到另一个地方，漏报和漏报销就这样发生。Ascenix 把可复用的模块拼成贴合每家院现有流程的工作流，从事件上报到报销审核都能覆盖，还能从 PointClickCare 等电子健康记录和其他来源取数、处理、套用规则，再产出报告、任务或邮件，让院方不必自建工程团队也能拿到定制软件。它属于 YC 秋季批次，团队七人，随着老龄人口增长，把员工的时间还给照护本身是值得看的方向。

companies.name: Libra Robotics
companies.originalOneLiner: The robot workforce for infrastructure of the AI era
companies.originalDescription: Infrastructure faces rapid expansion and labor shortages. Today, robots struggle to scale to meet customers’ high-mix work needs. Libra builds AI that engineers robots for new tasks across embodiments. We go from each new infra task to field-deployable robots 10x faster. Today, our robots are working on solar farms and piloting in data centers. Contractors pay for completed work as a service, not robots.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是基础设施施工的机器人劳动力。一个承包商今天接了太阳能电站或数据中心的活，工期紧、人手缺，而现成机器人很难适应高混合、常变化的任务。Libra 做的是为不同任务和不同机体设计机器人的智能，让每种新的基础设施任务到可现场部署的机器人之间快上十倍，目前机器人已在太阳能电站作业，并在数据中心试点。承包商按完成的工程量付费，而不是买机器人。它属于 YC 夏季批次，团队两人，这是把能力放进真实工地和设备里而不是纸面方案的方向，劳动力短缺与建设扩张同时存在让这个场景值得看。

readings.title: Show HN: Botel – always reachable agents you pay for only while they're working
readings.story: 如果你用过那种按订阅收费的自动化助手，大概会有一种别扭：没人找它的时候，钱照样在扣。团队里负责采购的人最容易碰到这个问题，预算批下来，用不用都得付。Botel 这个项目想试的是另一种算法，只在智能体真正干活时计费，平时保持随时能找到。这值得读，因为它把定价和可用性这两个平时分开谈的东西放到了一起。读的时候可以留意作者怎么定义“在工作”，是按调用次数、时长还是别的口径，以及这个口径对使用方和提供方分别意味着什么。

readings.title: Controlling Biology - Fabian Theis, Helmholtz Munich
readings.story: 生物研究里有个老难题：实验能做，但变量太多，改一个条件往往要等很久才知道结果，更别说把多个条件组合起来看。做计算生物学的人、药企里负责早期探索的团队，都会在某个阶段卡在这里。这期对话请到 Helmholtz Munich 的 Fabian Theis，谈的是怎么用模型去理解和干预生物过程。值得读的地方在于，它讨论的不只是某个模型多准，而是控制这件事本身：知道该动哪里，比预测更难。读的时候可以看作者如何区分预测和控制，以及他判断哪些环节还差得远。

readings.title: ToyBlocks: A controlled world for robot learning and evaluation
readings.story: 做机器人学习的人常遇到一个尴尬：算法在实验室里表现不错，换一批任务或者换间屋子就失灵，而且很难说清是哪里出的问题。评测标准不统一，团队之间也没法比。ToyBlocks 来自 Hugging Face 上 AllenAI 的分享，想提供一个受控的环境，让训练和评测有共同的参照。它值得读，因为这类基础设施看起来不起眼，却决定了大家能不能判断进展是真是假。读的时候不妨看它怎么划定环境和任务的范围，哪些因素被固定住，哪些被故意留出变化，以及作者如何解释这套设定能回答什么问题、不能回答什么问题。

companies.name: Graphify Labs
companies.originalOneLiner: On-device Knowledge Graph engine for Enterprise Software
companies.originalDescription: Graphify is a Knowledge Graph control plane for enterprise software. The open-source tool has 116K+ GitHub stars and 6.5M+ downloads, and is used in production by engineers at Shopify, Datadog, JP Morgan, American Express, Harvey, Automation Anywhere, and Vanguard. On top of that graph, our enterprise layer reviews every pull request and formally verifies each code change: it proves the new behavior matches the old, or hands back the exact input that breaks it. That makes it built for the changes teams fear most, like refactors, framework upgrades, and large-scale migrations, where you need proof that nothing broke, not a guess. The graph updates itself as the code changes and keeps context instead of forgetting it, so your whole team and their coding agents work from one shared, always-current view of the codebase instead of a thousand private threads. It runs entirely inside your perimeter, fully air-gapped on-premise or self-hosted in your own cloud, so no code or data ever leaves your environment.
companies.story: 这是做企业软件开发工具的公司，方向是代码知识图谱。假如你是一个工程负责人，团队正准备把核心系统升级到新框架，几百个文件要改，谁也不敢保证没有改坏。Graphify 先为整个代码库建一张知识图谱，再在每次代码合并请求上做形式化验证，要么证明新行为与旧行为一致，要么直接给出让程序出错的输入。它的开源工具已经积累了大量使用，企业版则把能力放进企业自己的环境里运行。对最怕重构和迁移的团队来说，这提供的是证据而不是猜测，值得关注的是它背后已有大量开发者在实际生产中使用。

companies.name: Ploid
companies.originalOneLiner: The people data company for the agent era
companies.originalDescription: Ploid is the AI-native people data infrastructure for developers and companies building products, workflows, and agents around people. We've built an index of 2B+ people across professional and social sources, giving developers one API to search for people, enrich profiles, find emails and phone numbers, resolve identities, and retrieve up-to-date information from across the web. Unlike traditional people databases built around static records, Ploid combines its massive people index with real-time retrieval and identity resolution, delivering fresh, reliable information whenever it's needed. From sales and recruiting to customer intelligence, trust and safety, and AI agents, Ploid replaces fragmented data providers with a single infrastructure layer. 2B+ people. One API. Built for AI.
companies.story: 这家公司切的是面向智能体时代的人员数据基础设施。想象你正在带一支销售团队，需要快速找到某家公司的采购负责人并拿到可靠联系方式，过去要在好几个数据供应商之间来回切换。Ploid 把专业和社交来源里的人整合成一个索引，开发者通过一个接口就能搜索人员、补全档案、查找邮箱电话、核对身份，并实时获取网上最新信息。它的特点是索引规模大，同时结合实时检索，让信息保持新鲜。从销售、招聘到信任与安全团队都能用同一层数据，值得关注的是它把零散的数据供应商收拢成单一基础设施，且明确面向人工智能应用。

companies.name: OctaPulse
companies.originalOneLiner: OctaPulse builds computer vision and robotics for fish farms and…
companies.originalDescription: OctaPulse is building the robotics layer for seafood production. Aquaculture is the fastest-growing food sector and already produces more seafood than commercial fishing, yet the people who breed and process fish still make thousands of decisions a day with almost no data about the fish in front of them, and much of the most important work is still done by hand, one fish at a time. We put cameras where fish are already handled, turn every image into measurements, and give farms and plants the tools to act on them. Today that is two products: Phenotyping, which measures every fish for shape, size and condition and links it to its family for breeding decisions, and Digital Twin, which places cameras on processing lines and farm sites onto the floor plan with live views, automatic counts and a built-in AI assistant. The same per-fish measurements are the foundation for Plant Robotics: robot cells that handle whole fish on the processing line, working alongside the people there. Fish are wet, slippery, soft and never the same twice, which is exactly why this work is still manual and why it needs measurement-driven robots built for food plants rather than rigid grippers and tabletop demos. We are now selecting processing plants for the first pilots on real lines. We signed a 6-figure paid pilot with the largest trout producer in the United States, and every deployment adds labeled images to a proprietary multi-species dataset that improves our models across species and becomes the brain for autonomous seafood production.
companies.story: 这是把计算机视觉和机器人带进水产养殖与加工的公司。一个养殖场的育种负责人每天要判断哪条鱼长得更好、该和哪条鱼配对，可过去几乎只能凭经验一条条看。OctaPulse 把摄像头放在鱼本来就要经过的地方，把每张图像变成可用的测量数据，记录每条鱼的体型、大小和状态，并与其家系关联，帮助做出育种决定。它还有数字孪生产品，把加工线和养殖场画在平面图上，给出实时画面、自动计数和内置助手。这不是手机应用，而是把感知能力放进真实的鱼处理场景，值得关注的是它正在招聘，说明团队在扩张落地。

companies.name: Mirrors
companies.originalOneLiner: Fix recurring AI agent mistakes with real-time guidance
companies.originalDescription: Production AI agents keep making the same mistakes. The usual fix is another line in the system prompt. Over time, the agent carries instructions for dozens of situations, even when it's doing something simple, and every correction becomes another thing to maintain. Mirrors helps developers maintain production agents by turning recurring mistakes into targeted corrections. Mirrors surfaces recurring mistakes across your production runs. You write a correction, choose the situations where it applies, and preview which past conversations it would have reached. Once activated, Mirrors adds it to your agent only in those situations. You can then compare outcomes with and without the correction to see whether it helped. Unlike skills, the agent doesn't decide what to load. The scope you set does. Corrections live in one place, scoped to the right accounts and workflows. Mirrors connects through an SDK and works with any agent framework, and your application keeps control of its model calls and tools. We're building Mirrors for engineering teams running customer-facing agents.
companies.story: 这是帮开发者维护生产环境智能体的工具。如果你负责一个已经上线的智能体，最头疼的往往是它反复犯同样的错，而常见的做法是往系统提示里不断加规则，时间一长，简单任务也背着一堆指令。Mirrors 会找出生产运行中反复出现的错误，你写一条纠正，选定它适用的场景，还能预览这条纠正会影响哪些过去的对话。启用后它只在那些场景里加入纠正，并可以对比有无纠正的结果。它和技能机制不同，加载什么由你设定的范围决定，不由智能体自己判断。值得看的是它把纠错集中管理，而不是让提示词无限膨胀。

companies.name: Locata
companies.originalOneLiner: AI Referral Automation for Primary Care Clinics
companies.originalDescription: Locata is an AI referral management platform for Primary Care. We deploy AI agents to automate every step of the referral process that back-office staff face daily, from submitting prior authorizations to broadcasting updates and following up with patients. This frees up staff to focus on patient care. Primary care back-offices are severely understaffed and overburdened by administrative work associated with referrals. Additionally, patients suffer navigating the complex referral process, which can have disastrous health effects if they don’t get the care they need. These factors point to a glaring gap in the system—where out of over 100 million specialist referrals issued annually in the US, only half are actually completed.
