Locata is tackling this problem head-on, saving administrative staff hours each week and ensuring that the referral process goes as smoothly as possible for patients and their providers. Alejandro and Josh met at Stanford where they graduated with BS degrees in Computer Science. Alejandro was a senior software engineer at Meta’s Reality Labs where he led development of several AI features for wearable products and prior to that conducted AI research at Stanford Medicine. Josh graduated with a masters in Computer Science, specializing in AI, before working as a software engineer at Google where he developed AI products that served over 1 billion users. Within two weeks of building our product, we signed a major regional health center and have saved them over 100 hours of work in our first month live.
companies.story: 这是做基层医疗转诊自动化的公司。一个诊所的后台运营负责人每天要面对大量转诊：提交事先授权、通知患者、反复跟进，人手不够，事情却一件不能少。Locata 用智能体把这些步骤自动跑起来，让后台人员腾出时间照顾患者。这个问题不小，美国每年发出上亿次专科转诊，真正完成的只有一半左右，患者卡在流程里可能耽误治疗。它来自 YC 夏季 2025 批次，团队目前四人并在招聘，说明产品已经在真实诊所场景里推进，需要更多人一起做。

companies.name: Kita
companies.originalOneLiner: Underwrite borrowers around the world in minutes
companies.originalDescription: In emerging markets, open finance is still nascent. Most of the population is traditionally unbanked, banking APIs don’t exist, and a borrower’s financial history lives in documents: e-wallet records, bank statements, utility bills, and more. Because this data is unstructured, credit and risk teams are forced into manual review. This slows decisioning, increases costs, and caps lending volume. Kita is the AI platform for global lending operations. We help lenders in emerging markets automate application completion, document verification, and underwriting from messy financial documents — using AI to extract fraud-checked data and localized risk signals that power faster, better credit decisions. Under the hood, Kita is a learning engine. We link document-level signals to repayment outcomes, allowing our models to continuously improve fraud detection and risk assessment over time. This creates a compounding advantage for lenders as their distinct underwriting decisions feed back into the system. We’re Carmel and Rhea. We met before Stanford and have been building together ever since. Carmel is from Manila, is a repeat founder, and spent three years in product at Apple. Rhea has a research background in computer vision and received the highest honor in Stanford Computer Science. Together, we combine deep local context with strong technical execution to build the infrastructure that expands access to credit in emerging markets.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是新兴市场的信贷审核平台。一个风控分析师每天收到的不是规整的银行数据，而是一堆电子钱包记录、银行对账单和水电账单，只能人工一张张看，速度慢、成本高，放贷规模也上不去。Kita 用人工智能从这些杂乱的财务文件里提取经过反欺诈核验的数据，并给出本地化的风险信号，帮贷款机构自动完成申请补全、文件核验和授信判断。它还会把文件层面的信号与还款结果关联起来，让模型随时间不断改进。值得关注的是它切中了开放金融尚不成熟的市场，那里多数人没有传统银行账户，文件就是信用历史。

companies.name: Applied Kinetics
companies.originalOneLiner: AI-native manufacturing for data center and energy projects
companies.originalDescription: Applied Kinetics is an AI-native, end-to-end manufacturer for data center and energy developers. We supply the transformers, switchgear, generators, cooling systems, and other critical equipment needed to bring new power and compute capacity online. Every unit is built to project specifications, and we manage the process from technical requirements through production and delivery. We shorten lead times and accelerate projects forward, removing the physical bottlenecks holding back the next generation of technological progress.
companies.story: 这是做数据中心和能源项目制造供应的公司，走的是人工智能原生、端到端的路线。假如你是一个能源开发商的工程负责人，项目已经拿到地、拿到电，却卡在变压器、开关柜、发电机和冷却系统上，交货周期长得让整个进度往后拖。Applied Kinetics 按项目规格生产这些关键设备，从技术需求一路管到生产和交付，目标是缩短交期、把项目往前推。它解决的是算力和电力扩容路上实打实的物理瓶颈，值得看的是它选择自己承担制造环节，而不是只做软件层面的协调。

companies.name: Risklytics
companies.originalOneLiner: AI-Native Insurance for Frontier Tech
companies.originalDescription: Risklytics is the insurance company for frontier tech such as physical AI, robotics, and data centers. Companies answer 6 questions and we bind a tailored policy that other insurance companies won’t.
companies.story: 这是给前沿科技公司做保险的保险公司，覆盖物理人工智能、机器人和数据中心这类新风险。想象你是一家机器人公司的运营负责人，拿着业务去询价，传统保险公司看不懂你在做什么，要么拒保，要么给不出合适的条款。Risklytics 的做法是让企业回答六个问题，然后直接出具一份量身定制的保单，承保那些别家不愿接的风险。它来自 YC 秋季 2026 批次，团队两人，切入点是保险行业长期存在的空白：新技术跑得比承保经验快。值得看的是它把承保流程压得很短，同时敢碰别人回避的风险类型。

companies.name: Molagri
companies.originalOneLiner: Resistance free pesticides.
companies.originalDescription: Molagri develops safer, more effective pesticides for agriculture. We design biopesticides that hit a precise molecular target unique to pest insects, knocking out pests while sparing pollinators, beneficial insects, and the wider ecosystem. By modeling how pests are likely to evolve, we stay a step ahead of resistance, keeping our products effective against the pests of today and tomorrow. The higher efficacy and biobased production will also contribute to emissions reductions in both manufacturing and field use. Our founders are PhD lab mates from the University of Toronto who have worked together for six years and published in Nature Communications and Nature Microbiology.
companies.story: 这是做农业生物农药的公司，目标是抗性更低的害虫防治方案。一个种植园的技术负责人每年都会发现，同一款药喷下去效果越来越差，害虫慢慢有了抗药性，而广谱农药还会误伤授粉昆虫。Molagri 设计的生物农药作用于害虫独有的分子靶点，只打害虫，尽量不伤蜜蜂和益虫，同时通过建模预测害虫可能如何演化，力求在抗性出现前就做好准备。它的生产基于生物方式，也有助于减少制造和田间使用中的排放。值得关注的是创始人是多伦多大学的博士同窗，合作六年，并在相关期刊发表过研究。

companies.name: Prescience, Inc.
companies.originalOneLiner: Superintelligent health insurance that keeps employees healthy
companies.originalDescription: Prescience is the preeminent health benefits platform for the world's most ambitious companies. We save employers 20-50% on health insurance while offering best-in-industry health benefits: www.getprescience.com About us: Prescience is building a new healthcare system for America. We train AI systems to: create, operate, insure, and deliver healthcare for employer health plans. Prescience Time Machine – an AlphaGo-like system – steers patients towards “Move 37 health trajectories” that deliver dramatic cost savings for employers. Rishab Jain and Aditya Jain, M.D. are serial entrepreneurs and brothers from Harvard & Harvard Medical School with backgrounds in machine learning and medicine. We believe abundant intelligence will bring an opportunity to fundamentally rebuild the $4.5T healthcare industry around proactive (prescient) health and wellness.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是面向企业的健康保险平台。如果你是一家快速扩张公司的运营负责人，每年续保时看到保费上涨，员工却觉得保障一般，这种两难很常见。Prescience 声称能帮雇主在医疗保险上节省两到五成，同时提供业内水准的福利。它的思路是用人工智能系统去创建、运营、承保并交付雇主健康计划，其中一套被称为时间机器的系统会把患者引向更省钱的健康路径。创始人是哈佛与哈佛医学院背景的兄弟，此前有过创业经历。它来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队五人并在招聘，值得看的是它试图从保险这一端重建雇主医疗的运转方式。

readings.title: Datadog Degradation, but No Incident?
readings.story: 很多团队都遇到过这种时刻：监控面板上的曲线开始变得难看，延迟升高、错误变多，可翻遍告警记录，却没有任何一条被正式标记为事故。值班的人一边盯着屏幕，一边犹豫要不要叫醒别人。这篇讨论值得读，是因为它把这种说不清的中间状态摆到了台面上：服务确实在变差，但流程里没有任何一个环节承认它。读的时候可以留意作者怎么界定“降级”和“事故”的边界，以及在这种边界模糊时，团队是靠什么信号决定要不要升级处理。

readings.title: Axiom Math wants to keep AI slop out of mathematics
readings.story: 数学研究一向被认为需要严密推导，一步错，后面全错。可当越来越多论文和证明借助 人工智能 生成，审稿人和同行就面临一个新麻烦：文字看起来完整，论证却可能经不起推敲。这篇报道讲的正是有人想处理这个问题。它值得一读，因为你能从中看到一类新公司如何在旧有标准和新工具之间找位置。阅读时可以注意作者如何描述问题被发现的场景，以及这家公司主张用什么方式区分可靠内容和看似可靠的填充物。

readings.title: Don’t Build the Reusable Component Yet
readings.story: 写前端或做产品的人大概都有过这种冲动：同一个按钮、同一张卡片出现了第二次，就想立刻抽成一个可复用的组件。这个念头很自然，因为重复看起来就是浪费。但这篇来自 Stack Overflow Blog 的文章标题提醒人先停一下。它值得读的地方在于，它讨论的是判断时机，而不是反对复用本身。读的时候可以看作者如何区分“现在就该抽”和“再等一等”的情形，以及过早抽象会在后续需求变化时给维护者带来什么具体麻烦。

companies.name: Visibl Semiconductors
companies.originalOneLiner: Custom silicon for power electronics
companies.originalDescription: Visibl Semiconductors makes custom silicon accessible to hardware companies, starting with power electronics. We are an AI-native custom-silicon design partner that cuts ASIC development cost and timeline on mature nodes, helping teams deliver better performance and lower BOM cost. We work with data-center and AI-infrastructure power, motor drives, industrial automation and robotics, industrial power supplies and conversion, battery systems and e-mobility powertrains, EV charging, solar, energy storage, grid power, HVAC, heat pumps, and appliances. V1 boards built from off-the-shelf parts are great for getting to market quickly, but scaling to v2+ volume requires optimizing cost, size, and manufacturability. Visibl folds those parts into custom silicon built around the product: a simpler BOM, reclaimed board space, fewer supply constraints, and automation-ready assembly. We manage the full path from architecture and design through verification, fabrication, packaging, and production-ready silicon, working alongside hardware teams so they do not need an in-house chip team.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是电源电子领域的定制芯片。假如你是一家机器人或储能设备公司的硬件负责人，产品第一版用现成元器件拼出来顺利上市，可到了第二代要上量，板子太占地方、物料清单太杂、成本压不下来，你既想优化又怕定制芯片的周期和费用拖垮项目。Visibl 把那些分立器件折叠进围绕产品设计的定制硅片里，简化物料清单、腾出板面空间、减少供应限制，还让组装更适合自动化，并且全程管理开发流程。它来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，团队只有三人且正在招聘，说明它押注的是硬件公司从第一版走向量产时那道真实的坎。

companies.name: Zatanna
companies.originalOneLiner: Building the infrastructure for AI to interact with software
companies.originalDescription: Zatanna is building the infrastructure for AI to interact with software. AI agents are increasingly capable of performing work that was previously done by humans, but they're still constrained by software interfaces designed for people. Today, agents rely heavily on clicking buttons, navigating pages, and interacting with UIs to get things done. At Zatanna, we're changing that by reverse engineering applications to turn their underlying workflows and actions into reliable, read-and-write APIs, regardless of whether those applications offer APIs themselves.
companies.story: 这家公司切的是让人工智能与软件交互的基础设施。想象你正在搭建一个智能体，让它替员工完成报销或对账这类重复工作，结果它只能像人一样在网页上点按钮、翻页面，界面一改就出错。Zatanna 的做法是反向解析应用，把底层的工作流和操作变成可靠的读写接口，哪怕这个软件自己根本没提供接口。它来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，团队两人且正在招聘，值得看的地方在于智能体能力越来越强，卡住它们的往往不是脑子而是软件界面。

companies.name: Wondersearch
companies.originalOneLiner: Instant semantic search over your data without embeddings.
companies.originalDescription: Our mission is to give every AI agent the right context, from any amount of data. WonderSearch is search built for AI agents. We let developers make all of their data searchable by meaning, without embeddings, servers or ingestion, so agents can pull the right context and cite where it came from. Unlike vector databases and RAG stacks, there's no pipeline to build or maintain: connect your files and data, and they're searchable right away. It runs on our own search model, and you pay only per query, whatever the size of your data. Teams use WonderSearch across their own documents and knowledge, and build it into their products, help centres and AI features, connecting through MCP, our API, the CLI or the Python SDK. (Evokoa, Inc. is the company behind WonderSearch.)
companies.story: 这是做人工智能搜索基础设施的公司。如果你是一名开发者，正给自家产品加智能问答功能，用户问的问题散落在成千上万份文档里，你不想搭向量数据库、不想维护数据摄取管道，更不想回答里找不到出处。Wondersearch 让开发者把文件和数据接进来就能按语义搜索，不需要嵌入向量、服务器或摄取流程，智能体可以取到正确上下文并标明来源，按查询次数付费，数据多大都一样。它来自 YC 秋季 2026 批次，团队两人，场景本身值得看：给智能体找对资料，正在成为每个做人工智能产品的团队都绕不开的一步。

companies.name: Tesora
companies.originalOneLiner: Frontier AI for Actuaries
companies.originalDescription: Tesora builds frontier AI agents for actuaries at P&C carriers, reinsurers, and MGAs. The agents handle the assembly, pulling the data, running the method, and deploying the rater, while you review the work and make every call. We deploy inside the stack you already run, on your infra and under your IT team's control, with no shared servers and nothing to rip out. Your data never trains our models, or anyone else's. We treat this as a partnership so we stay hands-on until the work is live and holding up in production. That standard runs through our security posture too: SOC 2 Type II certified, with a full audit trail behind every change. The part of the job that matters is actuarial judgment, and we automate everything around it so you get back to the work only you can do. Built by AI technologists and actuaries who want to see this exist and backed by Y Combinator & other top investors.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是面向精算师的人工智能智能体。一个财产险公司的精算分析师每天要拼费率、拉数据、跑方法、部署评分器，大量时间耗在搬数据和重复操作上，真正需要判断的部分反而被挤压。Tesora 的智能体接手这些组装工作，人只负责审阅和拍板，而且部署在客户自己的基础设施上，由客户的信息技术团队掌控，数据不用于训练模型，公司也通过了相关安全认证。它来自 YC 夏季 2025 批次，团队五人且正在招聘，由人工智能技术者和精算师共同打造，值得关注的是它把自动化放在判断之外，而不是取代判断。

companies.name: HABU
companies.originalOneLiner: Like Crosby, but for real estate development
companies.originalDescription: HABU is an AI-native real estate development firm that helps real estate investors deploy capital to build housing faster, at lower cost, and with higher yield. We're building an internal AI-native operating system that completes 90%+ of development tasks at 95% faster processing speeds while delivering the same outcomes customers expect externally: high yield, low risk projects. We're selling the outcome, not the inputs to the outcome. Developers are service providers for white-collar investors: they find land, construct buildings, and operate and sell them for a profit. Our customers don't care how the projects are sourced or managed, only that they are completed on time and produce the forecasted returns. We use agentic workflows, geospatial analysis and mapping, and development-specific workflow automation to manage the end-to-end process. The result is 5x more projects per FTE compared to a non-AI developer, 20% faster project schedules, and 10-15% lower total project costs. We're *not* long term property owners, strictly the service provider (fee/merchant developer). $160B was deployed into multifamily in 2025 and $534B into commercial real estate overall. Developers naturally have high operating margins and we are building to be the most operationally and capital efficient developer in the country. Starting first with multifamily in Phoenix and then expanding nationally.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是人工智能驱动的房地产开发。假如你是一位手里有资金、想投住宅项目的投资人，你真正在意的只有项目能否按时完工、回报是否达到预期，可找地、建设、运营、销售这一长串环节全靠开发商层层转包，速度慢、成本高。HABU 把自己定位成用智能体工作流、地理空间分析和开发专用自动化跑完整流程的开发公司，声称能完成九成以上的开发任务，让每位全职员工管理的项目数量成倍增加。它来自 YC 秋季 2026 批次，团队两人，卖的是结果而不是过程，这种把服务本身产品化的思路值得看。

companies.name: Arctic Health
companies.originalOneLiner: AI-native credentialing and contracting for healthcare
companies.originalDescription: Arctic Health is building AI-native credentialing and contracting for healthcare organizations. We automate the full workflow, from establishing payer contracts to enrolling each provider. We collect and validate organization and provider data according to each state and payer’s requirements, and submit on the organization's behalf. We then monitor status and compliance on an ongoing basis. Tools on the market today either perform small pieces of the workflow or price out small and mid-sized organizations. We handle the process end-to-end regardless of organization type or size. Our browser automations enable AI agents to submit and monitor across hundreds of payer portals, and our system is trained by experienced industry experts who handle every edge case. Healthcare organizations get one simple platform. We handle the rest.
companies.story: 这是做医疗资质认证与合同签约自动化的公司。如果你负责一家诊所的运营，新医生入职前要跟各家保险支付方签合同、逐个完成登记，每个州和每家支付方的要求都不一样，团队只能一遍遍登录几百个门户网站填表、查状态，小机构常常被工具报价挡在门外。Arctic Health 把从签约到登记的整个流程接过来，按各地要求收集核验机构和医生数据并代为提交，之后持续跟踪状态与合规，浏览器自动化让智能体能在数百个支付方门户上操作，系统还由熟悉各种边缘情况的行业专家训练。它来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队四人，值得看的是它不分机构类型和规模，把一整条琐碎流程收进一个平台。

companies.name: 9 Mothers
companies.originalOneLiner: Counter Drone Systems. $1.6m sales. We delivered for the DoW.
companies.originalDescription: We have sold $1.6m of systems to the DoW. Multiple systems delivered to the DoW. Our first product - EDDA - is a counter drone system - small, low power, low cost fully autonomous-capable. It's designed to be used on vehicles, bases, or carried - to stop group 1 suicide drones. We have multiple contracts, sales, etc. We have 3 more products with demand in various stages of development. More details at https://9mothers.com
companies.story: 这家公司做的是反无人机系统。想象你是一名负责基地或车队防护的安保主管，最担心的是那种小型自杀式无人机成群逼近，传统手段要么太贵要么太笨重，车上、营地里、甚至随身都难以部署。9 Mothers 的第一款产品 EDDA 就是为拦截这类小型无人机设计的，体积小、功耗低、成本低，具备完全自主运行能力，可以装在车辆上、放在基地里或由人携带。这家公司来自 YC 春季 2026 批次，团队十九人且正在招聘，已经向国防部门交付多套系统并实现一百六十万美元销售额，另有三款产品在开发中，真实交付记录是它最值得看的地方。

companies.name: Beyond Reach Labs
companies.originalOneLiner: Space solar arrays that grow to the size of a football field in orbit
companies.originalDescription: At Beyond Reach Labs we are building solar panels for Space that grow from the size of a dining table to a football field in orbit. Mitch and Pele met 13 years ago as freshmen at UPenn studying mechanical engineering. Mitch recently got his PhD at Carnegie Mellon working with NASA on kilometer-scale deployable structures, and Pele spent seven years at SpaceX leading Dragon parachute engineering, safely returning astronauts from space. The collective satellites today use around 20MW, roughly the output of a datacenter on earth, but by 2030 there is a demand for over 10GW, a 500x increase, largely driven by orbital datacenters, space stations, and lunar outposts. If you want more power, your only option is to launch larger solar panels, which quickly become fragile or impractically expensive. As a result, power constraints already determine whether missions or industries can exist at all. But at Beyond Reach Labs we have introduced a new class of deployable solar panels giving satellites 10x more usable power without increasing launch mass or volume. This works because our patented deployable design changes geometry in space, allowing for us to reach 10x longer while remaining rigid.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是太空太阳能阵列。如果你负责一颗卫星或未来轨道数据中心的电源方案，你会发现今天的卫星总用电量大约只相当于地面上一个数据中心，而到二零三零年需求可能翻上几百倍，想多发一点电就只能发射更大的太阳能板，很快变得脆弱或贵得离谱，电力直接决定任务能不能成立。Beyond Reach Labs 造的是能在轨道上从餐桌大小展开到足球场大小的太阳能板。两位创始人是十三年前在宾夕法尼亚大学相识的机械工程同学，其中一位在卡内基梅隆大学师从美国航天局研究公里级可展开结构，另一位在太空探索技术公司七年负责龙飞船降落伞工程。它来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，团队十五人且正在招聘，可展开结构这个方向本身就很值得看。

companies.name: Flai
companies.originalOneLiner: We Bring Customers to Your Dealership
companies.originalDescription: The problem we solve: 56% of dealership leads arrive after business hours, and most dealers lose these potential customers to competitors who happen to be available 24/7. Missing after-hours calls alone costs the average dealership $1M annually in lost revenue. We built Flai to fix this - AI assistants that answer dealership calls 24/7, scheduling test drives, oil changes, or running outbound recall campaigns so no opportunity slips away. The result: No more missed opportunities, no more losing customers to competitors. Our founding team has built voice AI products at HappyRobot, scaled infrastructure at Uber for millions of users, and applied data science at Netflix to solve operational challenges. We're not just answering phones, we're helping dealerships win in an AI-first world where availability determine who gets the sale.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是汽车经销商的人工智能电话接待。假如你是一家经销商的销售主管，晚上九点还有客户打电话问试驾，没人接，第二天这位客户已经在竞争对手那里下了单，单是漏接非营业时间来电，一家经销商一年就可能损失上百万美元收入。Flai 的人工智能助手全天候接听电话，帮客户预约试驾、换机油，还能主动外呼做召回活动，让机会不再悄悄溜走。它来自 YC 夏季 2025 批次，团队四十人且正在招聘，创始团队做过语音人工智能产品、在优步负责过大规模基础设施、在奈飞做过数据科学，值得看的是它把营业时间这个老问题当成销售胜负手。

companies.name: Jcode
companies.originalOneLiner: High performance coding agents
companies.originalDescription: Jcode is a high-performance coding-agent harness that makes it possible for developers to scale up multi-agent/swarm workflows. It's built from the ground up with a different architecture to solve the memory bottleneck (it's 20x more memory efficient than Claude Code) that has kept agent swarms from going mainstream. It has 20K GitHub stars, and throughputs $1mil per month of inference spend
companies.story: 这是做高性能编程智能体工具的公司。如果你是一名工程负责人，想让多个智能体分工协作写代码，很快会撞上内存瓶颈，任务一多机器就撑不住，所谓智能体集群只能停留在演示阶段。Jcode 从底层换了一套架构来做这件事，据其介绍内存效率比 Claude Code 高二十倍，让开发者能把多智能体协作真正规模化。它在 GitHub 上已有两万颗星，每月承接的推理开销达到一百万美元，来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队一人。值得看的是它已经用真实使用量证明，智能体集群的瓶颈可能不在模型而在工具层。

readings.title: Here’s what ‘renoa’ — the first new fiber in 25 years — feels like
readings.story: 你有没有过这种时刻：明明家里网速标着千兆，视频会议还是卡成幻灯片，路由器重启了三次也没用。宽带这件事，大多数人平时不会想它，只有在它出问题的时候才意识到，自己每天的工作和生活都压在一根细细的线上。这篇讲的是二十五年来第一种新光纤，标题里那个词你可能从没听过。值得读的地方在于，它把一项实验室里的材料变化，放回到普通人能感知的层面：摸起来、用起来到底有什么不同。读的时候可以留意作者是怎么把技术细节翻译成体感的，以及他如何判断这种新东西是真突破，还是又一次被夸大的宣传。

readings.title: Show HN: IsSiteDown – Chrome extension to check current site availability
readings.story: 做网站的人大概都经历过这种尴尬：用户说打不开，你打开浏览器一试一切正常，于是双方开始互相怀疑。查来查去，问题可能出在某个地区的网络、某个运营商的线路，或者只是对方公司防火墙的规则。这类排查往往靠猜，靠问，靠一遍遍让人刷新。所以当 Hacker News 上出现一个浏览器插件，能随手查一下某个站点当前是否可访问，它引起的讨论就不只是工具本身。读的时候不妨看看社区里的人在追问什么：他们真正想要的是检测，还是想把这种说不清的故障变成可以共享的事实。留意作者怎么定义问题边界，以及哪些需求被明确排除在外。

readings.title: How a 19-year-old intern built the growth engine behind this $2B AI company | Hector Serrano
readings.story: 很多公司在增长早期都会遇到同一个难题：产品有人用，但说不清用户为什么留下，也说不清该往哪个方向加力。这时候往往需要一个能把零散信号拼起来的人，而不一定是一个头衔很响的人。这篇的主角是一个十九岁的实习生，他给一家估值二十亿美元的 人工智能 公司搭起了增长引擎。这个组合本身就让人好奇：一个刚入行的年轻人，凭什么在这样规模的公司里找到自己的位置。读的时候可以重点看作者如何还原他做判断的过程，他先盯住了哪个环节，又放弃了哪些看起来更热闹的机会。对带团队的人来说，也能从中看到一件事：把机会交给经验不多的人，前提是什么。

companies.name: Shepherd Robotics
companies.originalOneLiner: Robots for high skilled labor powering AI infrastructure
companies.originalDescription: Shepherd Robotics builds general purpose robots for skilled physical work across AI infrastructure and advanced manufacturing. Our robots are powered by robot foundation models and use modular, flexible hardware designed to adapt to different environments and tasks. We train our systems on a combination of real world and simulation data so they can learn complex manipulation skills and generalize across workflows. We also provide integration into customers’ existing workflows, starting with data center construction and operations, electrical manufacturing and testing, and electronics manufacturing, where traditional automation struggles with variability, dexterity, and changing environments.
companies.story: 这是做通用机器人的公司，方向是把机器人放进人工智能基础设施和先进制造这些需要熟练体力活的场景。假如你是一家数据中心的施工负责人，今天现场要赶一批电气安装和测试，可熟练工人排不开，环境又一直在变，传统自动化设备根本应付不了这种灵活度要求。Shepherd Robotics 的做法是让机器人依靠机器人基础模型，用模块化硬件去适应不同环境和任务，训练数据来自真实世界与仿真，还提供接入客户现有工作流程的整合服务，先从数据中心建设与运营、电气制造与测试、电子制造切入。这家公司来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队只有 4 个人，它值得看的地方在于直接盯住了传统自动化最难处理的多变、精细和换环境问题。

companies.name: Kestrel AI
companies.originalOneLiner: AI Agents for Platform Engineering
companies.originalDescription: Kestrel is the AI automation layer for platform engineering teams. Platform teams use Kestrel to automate incident response, cloud provisioning, CI/CD, security, and developer requests across their stack. Kestrel turns natural-language prompts into deterministic, production-ready workflows with 40+ integrations, 200+ pre-built actions, and support for custom HTTP and webhook actions. Developer-first, with a CLI, Python SDK, and MCP server to manage workflows from where platform teams already work.
companies.story: 这家公司切的是平台工程团队的人工智能自动化层。想象你是一个平台工程负责人，凌晨被告警叫醒，一边要处理线上事故，一边还有开发同事在排队等云资源开通和权限申请，日常的持续集成、安全配置也压在你身上。Kestrel AI 让平台团队用自然语言描述需求，转成确定性的、可直接上生产的工作流，内置 40 多个集成和 200 多个预置动作，也支持自定义网络请求和回调动作，并提供命令行工具、Python 开发包和 MCP 服务器，让团队在原本的工作环境里管理流程。它来自 YC 秋季 2025 批次，团队 2 人，值得关注的是它把事故响应、云资源开通、持续集成与安全这些零散工作收进一个自动化入口。

companies.name: Channel3
companies.originalOneLiner: Database of every product on the internet
companies.originalDescription: Channel3 is building a database of every product on the internet. Google and OpenAI maintain vast product graphs, but keep that valuable data to themselves. Channel3 gives every developer access, opening a world of possibility for new shopping experiences across any vertical. For instance, developers could build AI fashion stylists or give their agents shopping capabilities. We don’t just collect product data; we actually understand it. With the latest image classification and reasoning models, we can match products across merchants—even when listings and images differ—recognize variants, and surface the perfect matches for every search. As we grow, we’ll capture unique insights into what users want, click, and buy. As AI models get smarter and cheaper, our flywheel accelerates: our catalog will improve, and it will be even easier for developers and vibe-coders to build on our infrastructure. To further incentivize building on Channel3, we provide built-in monetization; developers earn commissions on sales they drive. Alex discovered this need while building an AI tutor that could recommend products and earn affiliate revenue. When no solution existed, he persuaded his smartest friend from Duke and former co-founder George to leave Palantir and build Channel3 together.
companies.story: 这是做电商商品数据库的公司，目标是收录互联网上的每一件商品。如果你是一个正在开发购物助手的开发者，用户发来一张街拍照片问哪里有同款，你手里没有可靠的商品数据，只能一个个商家去爬，图片和标题还对不上。Channel3 用图像分类和推理模型去理解商品，即使不同商家的商品页面和图片有差异，也能把同一件商品匹配起来，识别出不同款式，并为每次搜索给出合适的匹配结果。它的思路是谷歌和 OpenAI 各自维护着庞大的商品图谱却只留给自己用，而它把这份能力开放给每一个开发者，让时装搭配助手或带购物能力的智能体都能建起来。这家公司来自 YC 夏季 2025 批次，团队 5 人，正在招聘。

companies.name: Tenor
companies.originalOneLiner: Infrastructure for building and scaling AI-native businesses.
companies.originalDescription: Tenor is a full-stack infrastructure for building and running AI-native businesses. We’re not just an agent framework, we manage the entire loop from how AI executes work to how every action, decision, and business outcome is captured and learned from. Owning the full stack lets companies deploy governed AI workflows, understand what actually drives results, and continuously improve how their business operates without building the infrastructure themselves.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是让人工智能原生业务得以搭建和扩张的全栈基础设施。假如你是一家公司的运营负责人，已经让智能体接手了不少实际工作，可每个动作、每次决策和最终业务结果散落在不同系统里，没人说得清到底是什么在推动结果，想改进也无从下手。Tenor 不只提供一个智能体框架，而是把从人工智能执行工作到记录并学习每个动作、决策和业务结果这一整条链路都管起来，企业因此可以部署受治理的人工智能工作流，看清真正驱动结果的因素，并持续优化业务运转，不必自己从头搭这套基础设施。它来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队 3 人，正在招聘，值得看的是它把治理和结果学习一起放进了基础设施里。

companies.name: Egoist Machines
companies.originalOneLiner: Your personal context, securely portable across every AI app.
companies.originalDescription: Egoist Machines is building infrastructure for a world where your personal context belongs to you, rather than to the apps and AI companies you use. Today, every assistant and consumer app builds its own version of you. We think that architecture is backwards. Your context should live with you, persist across products, and be available to any model, app or agent you choose. AI Passport is the first layer of that infrastructure. It brings the context you generate across AI assistants and everyday apps into one portable profile you control. Tell ChatGPT something and Claude can already know it, for example. Switch to a new product and it can understand you from the first interaction, without the new company needing to own the underlying data. Apps integrate through Sign in with AI Passport, requesting only the context they need for a specific purpose and duration. Users can see what is being accessed and revoke that access later. Underneath, we have built our own memory infrastructure for fast, compact per-user retrieval and permissioned access. We are distributing AI Passport directly to consumers through first-party products, while integrating it into consumer applications with existing distribution. Every new product that uses Passport gives users another reason to maintain their context there, and every additional Passport holder makes the context layer more useful to developers. The next step is to build a true Egoist Machine: an intelligent system whose memory, incentives and actions are governed by the individual it represents. We call it Digital Domovoy, the hardware extension of AI Passport. Instead of your most personal context ultimately living on somebody else's servers, it lives and is processed locally on hardware you control. AI Passport becomes the permission layer between that private local context and the cloud models and internet services you choose to use. Our North Star is the Egoist Machine: an intelligent system whose memory, incentives and actions are governed by the individual it represents.
companies.story: 这是做个人上下文基础设施的公司，想让你的个人信息归你自己所有，而不是散落在各个应用和人工智能公司手里。如果你是一个常用多个人工智能助手的普通用户，你在一个助手那里说过自己的偏好和经历，换到另一个产品又得从头解释一遍，每个应用都在悄悄构建一个版本的你。Egoist Machines 推出的 人工智能 Passport 把这些助手和日常应用里产生的上下文汇成一个可携带、由你掌控的个人档案，比如你在 ChatGPT 里说过的事，Claude 也能知道，换到新产品第一次交互它就能理解你，而新公司不需要拥有底层数据。应用通过 人工智能 Passport 登录接入，只申请特定用途和时长所需的上下文。它来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队 2 人，值得看的是它把隐私和可携带性做成了产品本身。

companies.name: Qlo
companies.originalOneLiner: Legora for commercial insurance carriers
companies.originalDescription: Qlo builds AI agents to run commercial insurance underwriting. We start by fully automating the operational work around risk decisions, become the system of record, and earn autonomy workflow by workflow toward the autonomous AI underwriter. We’re rebuilding underwriting infrastructure from the ground up so human underwriters and AI agents can share the same accounts, rules, documents, permissions, and workflow state. We believe every commercial insurance program will eventually be built and operated end to end by AI agents on Qlo.
companies.story: 这家公司切的是商业保险承保环节，用智能体来跑承保运营。想象你是一名商业保险公司的核保人员，桌上堆着不同格式的投保材料，风险判断前后还有大量录入、核对和流转工作，系统和规则又各管一摊，人跟机器很难在同一份账户上协作。Qlo 先从风险决策周边的运营工作做起，把这些环节自动化，再成为记录系统，然后一个工作流一个工作流地获得自主权，朝自主人工智能核保员推进。它从底层重建承保基础设施，让人工核保员和智能体共享同一套账户、规则、文档、权限和工作流状态。这家公司来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队 2 人，值得关注的是它选择从运营切入而不是直接喊全自动。

companies.name: b12 Labs
companies.originalOneLiner: Making hard molecules for Pharma and Biotech
companies.originalDescription: b12 makes high-value molecules that are otherwise hard to make. We help pharma companies plan and make new drugs, accelerating early-stage drug discovery from years to months. Andres built the first AI agent that can autonomously think and make molecules in a robotic lab, published in Nature Machine Intelligence (1000+ citations), and won the best paper award at the NeurIPS AI for Science conference. Zlatko is a 3x National Chemistry Olympiad champion, competed at IChO level, and medicinal chemist who has worked at Roche and leading lab robotics companies. Combined, we have an extensive network of hundreds of chemists, automation scientists, and AI 4 Science researchers. We run paid pilots with big pharma companies, demonstrating that our platform planned a set of experiments that achieved full conversion in a single attempt, eliminating the iteration cycle.
companies.story: 这是做难合成分子、服务药企和生物科技公司的公司，把人工智能和机器人实验室结合起来。如果你是一家药企早期研发的负责人，手里有一批结构复杂、传统路线很难做出来的候选分子，每试一轮都要等很久，迭代周期一拖就是几年。b12 Labs 帮药企规划和合成这些高价值分子，把早期药物发现从数年压缩到数月。团队方面，Andres 做过第一个能在机器人实验室里自主思考和合成分子的智能体，成果发表在 Nature Machine Intelligence，引用超过一千次，还拿过 NeurIPS 人工智能 for Science 会议的最佳论文奖，Zlatko 则是三次国家化学奥林匹克冠军，在罗氏和领先实验室机器人公司做过药物化学。他们正在与大药企做付费试点，平台规划的一组实验一次就达到完全转化，省掉了反复迭代。它来自 YC 夏季 2025 批次，团队 3 人，正在招聘。

companies.name: Alt-X
companies.originalOneLiner: Building the best venue for private markets exposure.
companies.originalDescription: Alt-X is building the AI-native liquidity layer for private markets. Private markets have created trillions of dollars in value, yet remain fragmented, illiquid, and inaccessible. While public markets benefit from exchanges, market makers, brokerages, and data infrastructure, private markets still rely on brokers, spreadsheets, and manual workflows to connect buyers and sellers. Alt-X uses AI to automate the core functions required to make private assets liquid. We streamline diligence, valuation, investor matching, and transaction execution, reducing the friction that makes private-market transactions slow, expensive, and opaque today. Our initial focus is venture-backed secondaries. We source opportunities from founders, employees, and early investors while building a network of accredited investors seeking exposure to the world's most valuable private companies. Over time, we believe every private asset—from startup equity to private credit and alternative investments—will require modern liquidity infrastructure. Building trusted infrastructure for private markets is difficult. Transactions involve complex diligence, fragmented information, transfer restrictions, and significant compliance requirements. Alt-X is focused on creating systems that can support real transactions at scale, not just marketplace listings. Ryan Samadi (Stanford CS/AI, former Citadel commodities trader) and Michael Wachsman (Cornell CS, infrastructure engineer) are building Alt-X because they believe ownership of innovation should be more liquid, transparent, and accessible. Today, Alt-X has sourced over $1.5 million in transaction opportunities and assembled a network of 40 accredited investors representing hundreds of millions of dollars in investable assets. Our mission is to democratize ownership of innovation by building the financial infrastructure that private markets have never had.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是私募市场的流动性层，用人工智能把原本靠人撮合的交易流程自动化。假如你是一名持有创业公司股权的早期投资人，想在有生之年把一部分份额变现，可买家在哪里、怎么估值、尽职调查怎么做，全靠经纪人和表格来回拉扯，一笔交易又慢又贵还不透明。Alt-X 用人工智能去处理尽职调查、估值、投资人与标的匹配和交易执行这些核心环节，降低摩擦，最初聚焦创业公司支持的二级份额，从创始人、员工和早期投资人那里获取机会，同时搭建一个寻求接触全球高价值私有公司的合格投资人网络。它来自 YC 冬季 2026 批次，团队 2 人，值得看的是它把公开市场早就有的交易所和数据基础设施思路搬到了私募市场。

companies.name: Pacific
companies.originalOneLiner: Mass-producing and financing micro data center incredibly quickly.
companies.originalDescription: We mass-produce modular data centers that deploy on stalled infrastructure projects losing billions per week. Delayed infrastructure projects hemorrhage $1B a week in the US alone - Pacific mass-produces modular data centers that deploy on those sites in days and turn their unused power into revenue. Data centers are stuck for years waiting for power, while delayed construction sites across the world sit on unused interconnects, losing billions of dollars per week in interest on trillions of dollars of debt. Our pods deploy on those sites and generate revenue for them in days. They use diamond wafers in the cooling system so pods run anywhere on earth, even a desert. We'll use the same mechanisms we're building today to deploy compute across the galaxy.
companies.story: 这家公司做的是模块化数据中心的量产和融资，把闲置电力变成算力收入。如果你是一个基建项目的负责人，工地因为各种原因停摆，接入的电容量就那样空着，每周都在为债务付利息，损失以十亿美元计。Pacific 量产模块化数据中心，几天内就能部署到这些停滞的站点上，把原本用不上的电力变成收入，冷却系统里用了金刚石晶圆，所以舱体在地球上任何地方都能运行，沙漠里也行。他们的判断是数据中心常常要等好几年才能拿到电力，而全球各地延迟的工地正握着闲置的接入容量。这家公司来自 YC 夏季 2026 批次，团队 6 人，值得关注的是它把算力供给和停滞基建这两个看似无关的痛点接在了一起。

companies.name: ChemPilot.ai
companies.originalOneLiner: Discover novel defense related materials/molecules.
companies.originalDescription: ChemPilot accelerates the discovery and development of next generation defense materials using AI and data from our automated wet lab. Developing a new material today takes 10+ years of trial and error. We compress that to months by screening for what can actually be made, then closing the loop: every lab result feeds back into the models so the next round is faster and smarter. Sam, Ofir and Maor spent two years researching these materials at the Technion lab of our CSO, Prof. Alon Grinberg Dana (former MIT postdoc), working directly with defense primes and government R&D agencies. Together we bring chemical engineering, computational chemistry and AI, plus the production systems to put them to work. ChemPilot spun out of that research. The West’s defense and dual-use industrial base runs on materials with fragile, sole-source and often adversarial supply chains. Demand for new capability is surging, and materials still take decades to develop. We’re building a new kind of chemical prime: one that can discover, develop and ultimately manufacture the materials the West needs, securely, fast and at cost.
companies.story: 这是做国防相关新材料和新分子发现的公司，用人工智能加上自动化湿实验室的数据来加速研发。如果你是一家国防承包商或政府研发机构的材料研究员，要为一款新装备找一种能用的材料，按今天的做法得花十年以上反复试错，而供应链上很多关键材料只有单一来源，甚至来自对手。ChemPilot 先筛选哪些材料真的做得出来，再让每一轮实验结果回流到模型里，下一轮更快更准，把十年压缩到几个月。三位创始人在首席科学顾问、前麻省理工博士后 Alon Grinberg Dana 教授的技术ion实验室里研究了两年这类材料，直接与国防主承包商和政府研发机构合作，公司从这项研究中分拆出来。它来自 YC 秋季 2026 批次，团队 3 人，值得看的是它瞄准的是西方国防工业基础里供应链脆弱的材料环节。

readings.title: AI startup hacks Anthropic, gains access to employee details, internal messages
readings.story: 很多做 人工智能 产品的团队，平时最担心的往往不是模型效果，而是自己手里那些员工信息、内部聊天记录到底安不安全。一旦有人公开说攻破了某家知名公司，讨论就会迅速热起来。这篇值得读的地方，在于它把安全事件放进了创业公司的语境里：一家年轻公司做了什么、对方的防线在哪里松动。读的时候可以留意作者怎么描述攻击的入口和时间线，哪些细节是确证的，哪些只是转述，这样更容易判断这类消息该信几分。

readings.title: Meta’s Muse Could Upend All Kinds of Businesses. It Hasn’t Yet
readings.story: 当一个平台公司推出一项新能力，外界常常先替它想象出一连串被颠覆的行业，可现实里这些变化往往迟迟不发生。做产品或者看市场的人，都会在某个时刻遇到这种落差：发布会讲得很热闹，真正用起来的人却不多。这篇值得读，是因为它没有停在预测上，而是去追问为什么还没发生。读的时候不妨看作者如何区分能力本身和落地条件，比如谁有动力先用、什么环节挡住了它，这比记住结论更有用。

readings.title: A Spark Of Color In November’s Gray (2026 Wallpapers Edition)
readings.story: 每到换季，设计师和普通用户都会碰到一件小事：屏幕上的壁纸看久了想换一张，可挑来挑去总觉得差点意思。这类月度壁纸合集看起来轻，却常常是很多人打开设计站点的理由。它值得读的地方，不在于信息量，而在于可以当作一个观察口味的样本：同一批创作者在同一个月份里怎么处理颜色和情绪。读的时候可以留意每张图的构图和配色选择，想想它们分别适合什么场景，也许能给自己手头的界面找点灵感。
